name: Dumbbell Lunges
instructions: Berdirilah dengan tegak sambil memegang dua dumbbell di samping tubuh. Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.

Langkahkan kaki kanan ke depan sekitar 60 cm, turunkan tubuh sambil menjaga torso tetap tegak dan seimbang. Tarik napas saat turun. Pastikan lutut tidak melebihi jari kaki dan tulang kering depan tetap tegak lurus dengan lantai.
Dorong tubuh kembali ke posisi awal menggunakan tumit kaki depan sambil membuang napas.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai repetisi yang ditentukan, lalu lakukan dengan kaki kiri.
instructions_en: Stand with your torso upright holding two dumbbells in your hands by your sides. This will be your starting position.

Step forward with your right leg around 2 feet or so from the foot being left stationary behind and lower your upper body down, while keeping the torso upright and maintaining balance. Inhale as you go down. Note: As in the other exercises, do not allow your knee to go forward beyond your toes as you come down, as this will put undue stress on the knee joint. Make sure that you keep your front shin perpendicular to the ground.
Using mainly the heel of your foot, push up and go back to the starting position as you exhale.
Repeat the movement for the recommended amount of repetitions and then perform with the left leg.
instructions_id: Berdirilah dengan tegak sambil memegang dua dumbbell di samping tubuh. Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.

Langkahkan kaki kanan ke depan sekitar 60 cm, turunkan tubuh sambil menjaga torso tetap tegak dan seimbang. Tarik napas saat turun. Pastikan lutut tidak melebihi jari kaki dan tulang kering depan tetap tegak lurus dengan lantai.

name: Dumbbell Lying One-Arm Rear Lateral Raise
instructions: Berbaringlah dengan dada menghadap bangku yang diatur miring (sekitar 15 derajat). Pegang dumbbell dengan satu tangan dan gunakan tangan lainnya untuk berpegangan pada kaki bangku agar stabil.
Posisikan telapak tangan menghadap torso (neutral grip) dengan lengan lurus dan siku sedikit menekuk. Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.

Angkat lengan ke samping hingga siku setinggi bahu dan lengan sejajar dengan lantai sambil membuang napas. Pastikan lengan tetap tegak lurus dengan torso. Tahan kontraksi selama satu detik di puncak gerakan.
Turunkan dumbbell secara perlahan ke posisi awal sambil menarik napas.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai repetisi yang ditentukan.
instructions_en: While holding a dumbbell in one hand, lay with your chest down on a slightly inclined (around 15 degrees when measured from the floor) adjustable bench. The other hand can be used to hold to the leg of the bench for stability.

Position the palm of the hand that is holding the dumbbell in a neutral manner (palms facing your torso) as you keep the arm extended with the elbow slightly bent. This will be your starting position.

Now raise the arm with the dumbbell to the side until your elbow is at shoulder height and your arm is roughly parallel to the floor as you exhale. Tip: Maintain your arm perpendicular to the torso while keeping your arm extended throughout the movement. Also, keep the contraction at the top for a second.
Slowly lower the dumbbell to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_id: Berbaringlah dengan dada menghadap bangku yang diatur miring (sekitar 15 derajat). Pegang dumbbell dengan satu tangan dan gunakan tangan lainnya untuk berpegangan pada kaki bangku agar stabil.

Turunkan dumbbell secara perlahan ke posisi awal sambil menarik napas.

name: Dumbbell Lying Pronation
instructions: Berbaringlah tengkurap di atas bangku datar (flat bench). Satu tangan memegang dumbbell, dan tangan lainnya ditekuk di atas bangku sebagai alas untuk menyandarkan kepala Anda.
Tekuk siku lengan yang memegang dumbbell hingga membentuk sudut 90 derajat antara lengan atas dan lengan bawah.

Angkat lengan atas hingga lengan bawah tegak lurus dengan lantai dan lengan atas tegak lurus dengan tubuh Anda. (Tips: Lengan atas harus sejajar dengan lantai dan membentuk sudut 90 derajat dengan tubuh Anda. Ini adalah posisi awal).

Sambil mengembuskan napas, lakukan rotasi eksternal pada lengan bawah sehingga dumbbell terangkat ke depan dengan tetap menjaga sudut siku 90 derajat. Lanjutkan rotasi ini hingga lengan bawah sejajar dengan lantai. Tahan kontraksi selama satu detik pada posisi ini.
Sambil menarik napas, turunkan kembali dumbbell secara perlahan ke posisi awal.
Ulangi gerakan ini sesuai jumlah repetisi yang direkomendasikan.
instructions_en: Lie on a flat bench face down with one arm holding a dumbbell and the other hand on top of the bench folded so that you can rest your head on it.
Bend the elbows of the arm holding the dumbbell so that it creates a 90-degree angle between the upper arm and the forearm.

Now raise the upper arm so that the forearm is perpendicular to the floor and the upper arm is perpendicular to your torso. Tip: The upper arm should be parallel to the floor and also creating a 90-degree angle with your torso. This will be your starting position.

As you breathe out, externally rotate your forearm so that the dumbbell is lifted forward as you maintain the 90 degree angle bend between the upper arms and the forearm. You will continue this external rotation until the forearm is parallel to the floor. At this point you will hold the contraction for a second.
As you breathe in, slowly go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_id: Berbaringlah tengkurap di atas bangku datar (flat bench). Satu tangan memegang dumbbell, dan tangan lainnya ditekuk di atas bangku sebagai alas untuk menyandarkan kepala Anda.
Tekuk siku lengan yang memegang dumbbell hingga membentuk sudut 90 derajat antara lengan atas dan lengan bawah.

Angkat lengan atas hingga lengan bawah tegak lurus dengan lantai dan lengan atas tegak lurus dengan tubuh Anda. (Tips: Lengan atas harus sejajar dengan lantai dan membentuk sudut 90 derajat dengan tubuh Anda. Ini adalah posisi awal).

Sambil mengembuskan napas, lakukan rotasi eksternal pada lengan bawah sehingga dumbbell terangkat ke depan dengan tetap menjaga sudut siku 90 derajat. Lanjutkan rotasi ini hingga lengan bawah sejajar dengan lantai. Tahan kontraksi selama satu detik pada posisi ini.
Sambil menarik napas, turunkan kembali dumbbell secara perlahan ke posisi awal.
Ulangi gerakan ini sesuai jumlah repetisi yang direkomendasikan.

name: Dumbbell Lying Rear Lateral Raise
instructions: Pegang dumbbell di kedua tangan, lalu berbaringlah tengkurap di atas bangku miring (incline bench) dengan sudut kemiringan rendah (sekitar 15 derajat dari lantai).
Posisikan telapak tangan saling berhadapan (posisi netral) dengan lengan lurus ke bawah dan siku sedikit ditekuk. Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.

Sambil mengembuskan napas, angkat kedua lengan ke samping hingga siku setinggi bahu dan lengan hampir sejajar dengan lantai. (Tips: Jaga agar lengan tetap tegak lurus dengan tubuh dan tetap lurus selama gerakan. Tahan kontraksi di posisi atas selama satu detik).
Sambil menarik napas, turunkan kembali dumbbell secara perlahan ke posisi awal.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang direkomendasikan, lalu lakukan untuk lengan yang lain.
instructions_en: While holding a dumbbell in each hand, lay with your chest down on a slightly inclined (around 15 degrees when measured from the floor) adjustable bench.
Position the palms of the hands in a neutral manner (palms facing your torso) as you keep the arms extended with the elbows slightly bent. This will be your starting position.

Now raise the arms to the side until your elbows are at shoulder height and your arms are roughly parallel to the floor as you exhale. Tip: Maintain your arms perpendicular to the torso while keeping them extended throughout the movement. Also, keep the contraction at the top for a second.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and then switch to the other arm.

name: Dumbbell Lying Supination
instructions: Berbaringlah menyamping di atas bangku datar. Satu tangan memegang dumbbell, dan tangan lainnya dilipat di atas bangku sebagai tempat untuk menyandarkan kepala Anda.
Tekuk siku lengan yang memegang dumbbell hingga membentuk sudut 90 derajat antara lengan atas dan lengan bawah.

Angkat lengan atas sehingga lengan bawah sejajar dengan lantai dan tegak lurus dengan tubuh Anda (Tips: Lengan bawah akan berada tepat di depan Anda). Lengan atas harus tetap diam di samping tubuh dan sejajar dengan lantai (selalu sejajar dengan tubuh). Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.

Sambil mengembuskan napas, lakukan rotasi eksternal pada lengan bawah sehingga dumbbell terangkat ke atas dalam gerakan setengah lingkaran, dengan tetap mempertahankan sudut siku 90 derajat. Lanjutkan rotasi ini hingga lengan bawah tegak lurus dengan lantai dan tubuh mengarah ke langit-langit. Tahan kontraksi selama satu detik pada posisi ini.
Sambil menarik napas, kembalilah secara perlahan ke posisi awal.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang direkomendasikan, lalu ganti ke lengan satunya.
instructions_en: Lie sideways on a flat bench with one arm holding a dumbbell and the other hand on top of the bench folded so that you can rest your head on it.
Bend the elbows of the arm holding the dumbbell so that it creates a 90-degree angle between the upper arm and the forearm.

Now raise the upper arm so that the forearm is parallel to the floor and perpendicular to your torso (Tip: So the forearm will be directly in front of you). The upper arm will be stationary by your torso and should be parallel to the floor (aligned with your torso at all times). This will be your starting position.

As you breathe out, externally rotate your forearm so that the dumbbell is lifted up in a semicircle motion as you maintain the 90 degree angle bend between the upper arms and the forearm. You will continue this external rotation until the forearm is perpendicular to the floor and the torso pointing towards the ceiling. At this point you will hold the contraction for a second.
As you breathe in, slowly go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and then switch to the other arm.

name: Dumbbell One-Arm Shoulder Press
instructions: Pegang sebuah dumbbell, lalu duduklah di bangku military press atau bangku biasa yang memiliki sandaran punggung dengan posisi dumbbell tegak di atas paha, atau Anda juga bisa berdiri tegak.
Angkat dumbbell ke atas hingga setinggi bahu. Tangan yang lain dapat direntangkan ke samping, diletakkan di pinggang, atau memegang permukaan yang stabil.
Putar pergelangan tangan sehingga telapak tangan menghadap ke depan. Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.
Sambil mengembuskan napas, dorong dumbbell ke atas hingga lengan Anda lurus sepenuhnya.
Setelah berhenti sejenak selama satu detik, turunkan kembali dumbbell perlahan ke posisi awal sambil menarik napas.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang direkomendasikan, lalu ganti ke lengan satunya.
instructions_en: Grab a dumbbell and either sit on a military press bench or a utility bench that has a back support on it as you place the dumbbells upright on top of your thighs or stand up straight.
Clean the dumbbell up to bring it to shoulder height. The other hand can be kept fully extended to the side, by the waist or grabbing a fixed surface.
Rotate the wrist so that the palm of your hand is facing forward. This is your starting position.
As you exhale, push the dumbbell up until your arm is fully extended.
After a second pause, slowly come down back to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and then switch arms.

name: Dumbbell One-Arm Triceps Extension
instructions: Pegang sebuah dumbbell, lalu duduklah di bangku military press atau bangku biasa yang memiliki sandaran punggung dengan posisi dumbbell tegak di atas paha, atau Anda juga bisa berdiri tegak.

Angkat dumbbell ke atas hingga setinggi bahu, lalu luruskan lengan ke atas kepala sehingga seluruh lengan tegak lurus dengan lantai dan berada di samping kepala Anda. Dumbbell harus berada di atas kepala Anda. Tangan yang lain dapat direntangkan ke samping, diletakkan di pinggang, menopang lengan atas yang memegang dumbbell, atau memegang permukaan yang stabil.
Putar pergelangan tangan sehingga telapak tangan menghadap ke depan dan jari kelingking menghadap ke langit-langit. Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.
Turunkan dumbbell secara perlahan ke belakang kepala Anda dengan menjaga lengan atas tetap diam. Tarik napas saat melakukan gerakan ini dan berhenti sejenak saat otot trisep meregang sepenuhnya.

Kembali ke posisi awal dengan mengontraksikan otot trisep sambil mengembuskan napas. (Tips: Sangat penting bahwa hanya lengan bawah yang bergerak. Lengan atas harus selalu diam di samping kepala Anda).
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang direkomendasikan, lalu ganti ke lengan satunya.
instructions_en: Grab a dumbbell and either sit on a military press bench or a utility bench that has a back support on it as you place the dumbbells upright on top of your thighs or stand up straight.

Clean the dumbbell up to bring it to shoulder height and then extend the arm over your head so that the whole arm is perpendicular to the floor and next to your head. The dumbbell should be on top of you. The other hand can be kept fully extended to the side, by the waist, supporting the upper arm that has the dumbbell or grabbing a fixed surface.
Rotate the wrist so that the palm of your hand is facing forward and the pinkie is facing the ceiling. This will be your starting position.
Slowly lower the dumbbell behind your head as you hold the upper arm stationary. Inhale as you perform this movement and pause when your triceps are fully stretched.
Return to the starting position by flexing your triceps as you breathe out. Tip: It is imperative that only the forearm moves. The upper arm should remain at all times stationary next to your head.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and switch arms.

name: Dumbbell One-Arm Upright Row
instructions: Pegang dumbbell, berdiri tegak dengan lengan lurus di depan paha, siku sedikit ditekuk, dan punggung lurus sebagai posisi awal. Telapak tangan menghadap paha.
Tangan yang tidak aktif dapat diluruskan di samping, diletakkan di pinggang, atau memegang permukaan yang stabil.

Hembuskan napas, gunakan otot bahu samping untuk mengangkat dumbbell dekat dengan tubuh hingga sejajar dengan dagu. Dorong gerakan menggunakan siku (siku harus selalu lebih tinggi dari lengan bawah). Jaga tubuh tetap diam dan tahan sejenak di atas.
Tarik napas, turunkan dumbbell secara perlahan kembali ke posisi awal.
Ulangi sebanyak repetisi yang ditentukan, kemudian ganti sisi lengan.
instructions_en: Grab a dumbbell and stand up straight with your arm extended in front of you with a slight bend at the elbows and your back straight. This will be your starting position. Tip: The dumbbell should be resting on top of your thigh with the palm of your hands facing your thighs.
Keep the other hand can be kept fully extended to the side, by the waist or grabbing a fixed surface. This will be your starting position.

Use your side shoulders to lift the dumbbell as you exhale. The dumbbell should be close to the body as you move it up. Continue to lift it until the dumbbell is nearly in line with your chin. Tip: Your elbows should drive the motion. As you lift the dumbbell, your elbow should always be higher than your forearm. Also, keep your torso stationary and pause for a second at the top of the movement.
Lower the dumbbell back down slowly to the starting position. Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and switch arms.

name: Dumbbell Prone Incline Curl
instructions: Pegang sepasang dumbbell, berbaring tengkurap di atas bangku miring dengan bahu dekat bagian atas sandaran. Lutut dapat diletakkan di atas kursi atau kaki dibuka ke samping.
Biarkan lengan tergantung lurus ke bawah tegak lurus dengan lantai.
Jaga siku tetap di samping tubuh dan putar telapak tangan menghadap ke depan sebagai posisi awal.
Hembuskan napas, angkat dumbbell dengan mengontraksikan biseps hingga lengan tertekuk penuh. Pastikan hanya lengan bawah yang bergerak dan lengan atas tetap stabil.
Turunkan kembali dumbbell hingga lengan lurus sepenuhnya.
Ulangi sebanyak repetisi yang ditentukan.
instructions_en: Grab a dumbbell on each hand and lie face down on an incline bench with your shoulders near top of the incline. Your knees can rest on the seat or your legs can be straddled to the sides (my preferred way).
Let your arms extend and hang naturally in front of you so that they are perpendicular to the floor.
Now keep your elbows in by your side and face the palms forward. This will be your starting position.

Raise the dumbbells by contracting the biceps until your arms are fully flexed. Exhale as you perform this portion of the movement and ensure that only the forearms move. The upper arms should remain stationary at all times.
Lower the dumbbells until your arms are fully extended.
Repeat for the recommended amount of times.

name: Dumbbell Raise
instructions: Pegang sepasang dumbbell, berdiri tegak dengan lengan lurus di samping tubuh, siku sedikit ditekuk, dan punggung lurus sebagai posisi awal. Telapak tangan menghadap ke belakang.

Hembuskan napas, gunakan otot bahu samping untuk mengangkat dumbbell ke samping tubuh hingga hampir sejajar dengan dagu. Dorong gerakan menggunakan siku (siku harus selalu lebih tinggi dari lengan bawah). Jaga tubuh tetap diam dan tahan sejenak di atas.
Tarik napas, turunkan kembali dumbbell secara perlahan ke posisi awal.
Ulangi sebanyak repetisi yang ditentukan.
instructions_en: Grab a dumbbell in each arm and stand up straight with your arms extended by your sides with a slight bend at the elbows and your back straight. This will be your starting position. Tip: The dumbbell should be next to your thighs with the palm of your hands facing back.

Use your side shoulders to lift the dumbbells as you exhale. The dumbbells should be to the side of the body as you move them up. Continue to lift it until the dumbbells are nearly in line with your chin. Tip: Your elbows should drive the motion. As you lift the dumbbell, your elbow should always be higher than your forearm. Also, keep your torso stationary and pause for a second at the top of the movement.
Lower the dumbbells back down slowly to the starting position. Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement.

name: Dumbbell Rear Lunge
instructions: Berdiri tegak dengan memegang dumbbell di samping tubuh sebagai posisi awal.

Tarik napas, melangkah ke belakang dengan kaki kanan sekitar 60 cm, lalu turunkan tubuh sambil menjaga dada tetap tegak dan keseimbangan terjaga. Pastikan lutut depan tidak melewati ujung jari kaki dan tulang kering tetap tegak lurus dengan lantai.
Hembuskan napas, dorong tubuh kembali ke posisi awal (gunakan ujung kaki untuk fokus pada paha depan, atau tumit untuk fokus pada bokong).
Ulangi gerakan dengan sisi kaki yang berlawanan.
instructions_en: Stand with your torso upright holding two dumbbells in your hands by your sides. This will be your starting position.

Step backward with your right leg around two feet or so from the left foot and lower your upper body down, while keeping the torso upright and maintaining balance. Inhale as you go down. Tip: As in the other exercises, do not allow your knee to go forward beyond your toes as you come down, as this will put undue stress on the knee joint. Make sure that you keep your front shin perpendicular to the ground. Keep the torso upright during the lunge; flexible hip flexors are important. A long lunge emphasizes the Gluteus Maximus; a short lunge emphasizes Quadriceps.
Push up and go back to the starting position as you exhale. Tip: Use the ball of your feet to push in order to accentuate the quadriceps. To focus on the glutes, press with your heels.
Now repeat with the opposite leg.

name: Dumbbell Scaption
instructions: Pegang beban ringan di masing-masing tangan dengan posisi lengan di samping tubuh dan ibu jari menghadap ke atas.
Angkat kedua lengan lurus ke depan dengan sudut sekitar 30 derajat keluar dari garis tengah tubuh.
Lanjutkan hingga lengan sejajar dengan lantai, lalu kembali ke posisi awal secara perlahan.
instructions_en: This corrective exercise strengthens the muscles that stabilize your shoulder blade. Hold a light weight in each hand, hanging at your sides. Your thumbs should pointing up.
Begin the movement raising your arms out in front of you, about 30 degrees off center. Your arms should be fully extended as you perform the movement.
Continue until your arms are parallel to the ground, and then return to the starting position.

Lanjutkan hingga lengan sejajar dengan lantai, lalu kembali ke posisi awal secara perlahan.

name: Dumbbell Seated Box Jump
instructions: Siapkan kotak di samping bangku. Pegang dumbbell di depan dada dengan kedua tangan dan duduk di bangku menghadap kotak.
Tumpukan kaki dengan kuat, condongkan tubuh ke depan, lalu dorong pinggul dan lutut untuk melompat ke atas kotak.
Mendaratlah di atas kotak dengan kedua kaki, redam benturan dengan menekuk pinggul dan lutut.
Turun kembali ke posisi semula.
instructions_en: Position a box a couple feet to the side of a bench. Hold a dumbbell to your chest with both hands and seat yourself on the bench facing the box. This will be your starting position.
Plant your feet firmly on the ground as you lean forward, extending through the hips and knees to jump up and forward.
Land on the box with both feet, absorbing the impact by allowing the hips and knees to bend.
Step down and return to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Seated One-Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Letakkan balok di lantai sekitar 30 cm dari bangku datar.
Duduk di bangku, letakkan dumbbell di paha kiri, sekitar 8 cm di atas lutut.
Posisikan bagian depan telapak kaki kiri di atas balok.
Hembuskan napas, angkat tumit setinggi mungkin dengan mengontraksikan otot betis. Tahan selama satu detik.
Turunkan tumit secara perlahan hingga merasakan regangan maksimal.
Ulangi sesuai repetisi yang ditentukan, lalu ganti dengan kaki kanan.
instructions_en: Place a block on the floor about 12 inches from a flat bench.
Sit on a flat bench and place a dumbbell on your upper left thigh about 3 inches above your knee.
Now place the ball of your left foot on the block. This will be your starting position.
Raise your toes up as high as possible as you exhale and you contract your calf muscle. Hold the contraction for a second.
Slowly return to the starting position, stretching as far down as possible.
Repeat for your prescribed number of repetitions and then repeat with the right leg.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Duduk di bangku dengan sandaran punggung. Pegang dumbbell dan letakkan di atas paha.
Angkat dumbbell ke bahu satu per satu dengan bantuan dorongan paha.
Putar pergelangan tangan hingga telapak tangan menghadap ke depan.
Hembuskan napas, dorong dumbbell ke atas hingga hampir bersentuhan.
Tahan sejenak, lalu tarik napas sambil menurunkan dumbbell secara perlahan ke posisi awal.
Ulangi sesuai repetisi yang ditentukan.
instructions_en: While holding a dumbbell in each hand, sit on a military press bench or utility bench that has back support. Place the dumbbells upright on top of your thighs.
Now raise the dumbbells to shoulder height one at a time using your thighs to help propel them up into position.
Make sure to rotate your wrists so that the palms of your hands are facing forward. This is your starting position.
Now, exhale and push the dumbbells upward until they touch at the top.
Then, after a brief pause at the top contracted position, slowly lower the weights back down to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_id: Duduk di bangku dengan sandaran punggung. Pegang dumbbell dan letakkan di atas paha.
Angkat dumbbell ke bahu satu per satu dengan bantuan dorongan paha.
Putar pergelangan tangan hingga telapak tangan menghadap ke depan.
Hembuskan napas, dorong dumbbell ke atas hingga hampir bersentuhan.
Tahan sejenak, lalu tarik napas sambil menurunkan dumbbell secara perlahan ke posisi awal.
Ulangi sesuai repetisi yang ditentukan.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
instructions: Berdiri tegak dengan dumbbell di masing-masing tangan (telapak menghadap tubuh), lengan lurus di samping.
Hembuskan napas, angkat bahu setinggi mungkin. Tahan kontraksi selama satu detik. Pastikan lengan tetap lurus dan tidak menggunakan otot bisep.
Turunkan kembali dumbbell ke posisi semula.
Ulangi sesuai repetisi yang ditentukan.
instructions_en: Stand erect with a dumbbell on each hand (palms facing your torso), arms extended on the sides.

Lift the dumbbells by elevating the shoulders as high as possible while you exhale. Hold the contraction at the top for a second. Tip: The arms should remain extended at all times. Refrain from using the biceps to help lift the dumbbells. Only the shoulders should be moving up and down.
Lower the dumbbells back to the original position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Side Bend
instructions: Berdiri tegak dengan kaki selebar bahu. Pegang dumbbell di tangan kiri, tangan kanan diletakkan di pinggang.
Jaga punggung tetap lurus dan pandangan ke depan. Tarik napas, tekuk pinggang ke arah kanan sejauh mungkin. Tahan sejenak, lalu hembuskan napas dan kembali ke posisi tegak.
Ulangi gerakan ke arah sisi kiri, tahan sejenak, lalu kembali ke posisi awal.
Ulangi sesuai repetisi, lalu pindahkan beban ke tangan seberangnya.
instructions_en: Stand up straight while holding a dumbbell on the left hand (palms facing the torso) as you have the right hand holding your waist. Your feet should be placed at shoulder width. This will be your starting position.

While keeping your back straight and your head up, bend only at the waist to the right as far as possible. Breathe in as you bend to the side. Then hold for a second and come back up to the starting position as you exhale. Tip: Keep the rest of the body stationary.
Now repeat the movement but bending to the left instead. Hold for a second and come back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and then change hands.

name: Dumbbell Squat
instructions: Berdirilah tegak sambil memegang dumbbell di kedua tangan (telapak tangan menghadap ke samping paha).
Posisikan kaki selebar bahu dengan jari-jari kaki sedikit menghadap ke luar. Jaga kepala tetap tegak dan punggung lurus untuk menjaga keseimbangan. Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.

Turunkan tubuh secara perlahan dengan menekuk lutut sembari menjaga punggung tetap lurus dan kepala tegak. Lanjutkan hingga paha sejajar dengan lantai. Tips: Pastikan lutut tidak melewati ujung jari kaki untuk menghindari tekanan berlebih pada sendi lutut.
Dorong tubuh kembali ke posisi awal sambil mengembuskan napas, dengan memfokuskan dorongan pada tumit untuk meluruskan kaki kembali.
Ulangi gerakan ini sesuai jumlah repetisi yang direkomendasikan.
instructions_en: Stand up straight while holding a dumbbell on each hand (palms facing the side of your legs).

Position your legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Keep your head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a straight back. This will be your starting position. Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances discussed in the foot stances section.

Begin to slowly lower your torso by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up. Continue down until your thighs are parallel to the floor. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knees should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If your knees are past that imaginary line (if they are past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
Begin to raise your torso as you exhale by pushing the floor with the heel of your foot mainly as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Squat To A Bench
instructions: Berdirilah tegak dengan bangku datar di belakang Anda, sambil memegang dumbbell di kedua tangan (telapak tangan menghadap ke samping paha).
Posisikan kaki selebar bahu dengan jari-jari kaki sedikit menghadap ke luar. Jaga kepala tetap tegak dan punggung lurus untuk menjaga keseimbangan. Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.

Tarik napas dan turunkan tubuh secara perlahan dengan menekuk lutut hingga bokong menyentuh sedikit bangku di belakang Anda. Jaga punggung tetap lurus dan kepala tegak. Tips: Pastikan lutut tidak melewati ujung jari kaki untuk menghindari tekanan berlebih pada sendi lutut.
Dorong tubuh kembali ke posisi awal sambil mengembuskan napas, dengan memfokuskan dorongan pada tumit untuk meluruskan kaki kembali.
Ulangi gerakan ini sesuai jumlah repetisi yang direkomendasikan.
instructions_en: Stand up straight with a flat bench behind you while holding a dumbbell on each hand (palms facing the side of your legs).

Position your legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Keep your head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a straight back. This will be your starting position. Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances discussed in the foot stances section.

Begin to slowly lower your torso by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up. Continue down until you slightly touch the bench behind you. Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knees should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If your knees are past that imaginary line (if they are past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
Begin to raise the bar as you exhale by pushing the floor with the heel of your foot mainly as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Dorong tubuh kembali ke posisi awal sambil mengembuskan napas, dengan memfokuskan dorongan pada tumit untuk meluruskan kaki kembali.

name: Dumbbell Step Ups
instructions: Berdirilah tegak sambil memegang dumbbell di kedua tangan (telapak tangan menghadap ke samping paha).

Tempatkan kaki kanan di atas platform tinggi. Melangkah naik dengan meluruskan pinggul dan lutut kanan. Fokuskan dorongan terutama pada tumit untuk mengangkat seluruh tubuh, lalu naikkan kaki kiri ke atas platform. Hembuskan napas saat mendorong tubuh ke atas.
Turunkan kaki kiri terlebih dahulu dengan menekuk pinggul dan lutut kanan sambil menarik napas. Turunkan kaki kanan ke samping kaki kiri untuk kembali ke posisi berdiri awal.
Ulangi gerakan dengan kaki kanan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang direkomendasikan, lalu lakukan hal yang sama dengan kaki kiri.
instructions_en: Stand up straight while holding a dumbbell on each hand (palms facing the side of your legs).

Place the right foot on the elevated platform. Step on the platform by extending the hip and the knee of your right leg. Use the heel mainly to lift the rest of your body up and place the foot of the left leg on the platform as well. Breathe out as you execute the force required to come up.

Step down with the left leg by flexing the hip and knee of the right leg as you inhale. Return to the original standing position by placing the right foot of to next to the left foot on the initial position.
Repeat with the right leg for the recommended amount of repetitions and then perform with the left leg.

name: Dumbbell Tricep Extension -Pronated Grip
instructions: Berbaringlah di atas bangku datar sambil memegang dua dumbbell tepat di atas bahu. Luruskan lengan sepenuhnya hingga membentuk sudut 90 derajat dengan tubuh dan lantai.
Posisikan telapak tangan menghadap ke depan dan siku tetap rapat (tidak melebar). Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.
Tarik napas dan turunkan dumbbell secara perlahan hingga berada di dekat telinga. Pastikan lengan atas tetap diam dan siku tetap rapat.
Hembuskan napas dan gunakan kekuatan otot trisep untuk mendorong kembali beban ke posisi awal.
instructions_en: Lie down on a flat bench holding two dumbbells directly above your shoulders. Your arms should be fully extended and form a 90 degree angle from your torso and the floor.
The palms of your hands should be facing forward, and your elbows should be tucked in. This will be your starting position.
Now, inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells until they are near your ears. Be sure to keep your upper arms stationary and your elbows tucked in.
Then, exhale and use your triceps to return the weight to the starting position.

name: Dynamic Back Stretch
instructions: Berdirilah dengan kaki dibuka selebar bahu. Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.
Jaga lengan tetap lurus, ayunkan lurus ke depan dan ke atas sebanyak 5-10 kali. Tingkatkan rentang gerak pada setiap ayunan hingga lengan berada di atas kepala.
instructions_en: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. This will be your starting position.
Keeping your arms straight, swing them straight up in front of you 5-10 times, increasing the range of motion each time until your arms are above your head.
instructions_id: Berdirilah dengan kaki dibuka selebar bahu. Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.

name: Dynamic Chest Stretch
instructions: Berdiri dengan tangan disatukan dan lengan lurus ke depan sebagai posisi awal.

Jaga lengan tetap lurus, ayunkan lengan ke belakang sejauh mungkin secara cepat lalu kembalikan ke depan, seperti gerakan tepuk tangan yang dilebih-lebihkan. Ulangi 5-10 kali sambil tingkatkan kecepatan.
instructions_en: Stand with your hands together, arms extended directly in front of you. This will be your starting position.
Keeping your arms straight, quickly move your arms back as far as possible and back in again, similar to an exaggerated clapping motion. Repeat 5-10 times, increasing speed as you do so.
instructions_id: Berdiri dengan tangan disatukan dan lengan lurus ke depan sebagai posisi awal.

name: EZ-Bar Curl
instructions: Berdiri tegak sambil memegang EZ curl bar pada pegangan luar yang lebar. Telapak tangan menghadap ke depan dan sedikit miring ke dalam mengikuti bentuk bar. Jaga siku tetap dekat dengan tubuh sebagai posisi awal.
Jaga posisi lengan atas tetap, buang napas dan angkat beban ke depan sambil kontraksikan bisep. Fokuskan gerakan hanya pada lengan bawah.
Lanjutkan mengangkat beban hingga bisep berkontraksi penuh dan bar berada di tingkat bahu. Tahan posisi kontraksi di atas sejenak sambil meremas bisep.
Tarik napas lalu turunkan bar secara perlahan kembali ke posisi awal.
Ulangi sebanyak jumlah repetisi yang dianjurkan.
instructions_en: Stand up straight while holding an EZ curl bar at the wide outer handle. The palms of your hands should be facing forward and slightly tilted inward due to the shape of the bar. Keep your elbows close to your torso. This will be your starting position.
Now, while keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights forward while contracting the biceps. Focus on only moving your forearms.
Continue to raise the weight until your biceps are fully contracted and the bar is at shoulder level. Hold the top contracted position for a moment and squeeze the biceps.
Then inhale and slowly lower the bar back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: EZ-Bar Skullcrusher
instructions: Dengan genggaman rapat, angkat EZ bar dan pegang dengan siku mengarah ke dalam saat berbaring di bangku. Lengan harus tegak lurus dengan lantai sebagai posisi awal.
Jaga lengan atas tetap, turunkan bar dengan menekuk siku. Tarik napas saat melakukan gerakan ini. Berhenti sejenak saat bar berada tepat di atas dahi.
Angkat kembali bar ke posisi awal dengan meluruskan siku sambil membuang napas.
Ulangi.
instructions_en: Using a close grip, lift the EZ bar and hold it with your elbows in as you lie on the bench. Your arms should be perpendicular to the floor. This will be your starting position.
Keeping the upper arms stationary, lower the bar by allowing the elbows to flex. Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Pause once the bar is directly above the forehead.
Lift the bar back to the starting position by extending the elbow and exhaling.
Repeat.

name: Elbow Circles
instructions: Duduk atau berdiri dengan kaki dibuka selebar bahu.
Letakkan tangan di bahu dengan siku sejajar bahu dan mengarah ke luar.
Buat gerakan melingkar secara perlahan dengan siku. Buang napas saat memulai lingkaran dan tarik napas saat menyelesaikan lingkaran.
instructions_en: Sit or stand with your feet slightly apart.
Place your hands on your shoulders with your elbows at shoulder level and pointing out.
Slowly make a circle with your elbows. Breathe out as you start the circle and breathe in as you complete the circle.

name: Elbow to Knee
instructions: Berbaring di lantai, silangkan kaki kanan di atas lutut kiri yang menekuk. Letakkan tangan di belakang kepala dengan belikat menempel di lantai sebagai posisi awal.
Lakukan gerakan dengan melenturkan tulang belakang dan memutar torso untuk mendekatkan siku kiri ke lutut kanan.
Kembali ke posisi awal dan ulangi gerakan sebanyak repetisi yang diinginkan sebelum berganti sisi.
instructions_en: Lie on the floor, crossing your right leg across your bent left knee. Clasp your hands behind your head, beginning with your shoulder blades on the ground. This will be your starting position.
Perform the motion by flexing the spine and rotating your torso to bring the left elbow to the right knee.
Return to the starting position and repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.

name: Elbows Back
instructions: Berdiri tegak.
Letakkan kedua tangan di punggung bawah dengan jari menghadap ke bawah dan siku mengarah ke luar.
Tarik siku ke arah belakang secara perlahan hingga terasa seolah-olah keduanya akan bersentuhan.
instructions_en: Stand up straight.
Place both hands on your lower back, fingers pointing downward and elbows out.
Then gently pull your elbows back aiming to touch them together.

name: Elevated Back Lunge
instructions: Siapkan barbel pada rak setinggi bahu dengan beban yang sesuai. Letakkan platform pendek di belakang Anda.
Panggul barbel di punggung atas, jaga punggung tetap tegak dan kencang. Berdirilah di atas platform dengan kedua kaki. Ini adalah posisi awal.
Langkahkan satu kaki ke belakang. Turunkan tubuh dengan menekuk pinggul dan lutut hingga lutut menyentuh lantai.
Tahan sejenak, lalu dorong kembali ke posisi awal menggunakan kekuatan pinggul dan lutut sebelum berganti kaki.
instructions_en: Position a bar onto a rack at shoulder height loaded to an appropriate weight. Place a short, raised platform behind you.
Rack the bar onto your upper back, keeping your back arched and tight. Step onto your raised platform with both feet. This will be your starting position.
Begin by stepping backwards with one leg. Descend by flexing your hips and knees until your knee touches the floor.
Pause, and extend through the hips and knees to rise up, returning all the way to the starting position before alternating.

name: Elevated Cable Rows
instructions: Siapkan platform setinggi 10-15 cm.
Letakkan platform di atas kursi mesin kabel.
Duduk di mesin dan letakkan kaki pada tumpuan depan, jaga lutut tetap sedikit menekuk (tidak terkunci).
Condongkan tubuh dengan menjaga punggung tetap lurus, lalu pegang handle V-bar.

Dengan lengan terentang, tarik tubuh hingga batang tubuh membentuk sudut 90 derajat terhadap kaki. Punggung sedikit melengkung dan busungkan dada hingga otot lat terasa meregang. Ini adalah posisi awal.

Jaga batang tubuh tetap stabil, tarik handle ke arah perut dengan lengan tetap dekat dengan tubuh. Buang napas saat menarik. Remas otot punggung, tahan sejenak, lalu kembali ke posisi semula sambil menarik napas.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang disarankan.
instructions_en: Get a platform of some sort (it can be an aerobics or calf raise platform) that is around 4-6 inches in height.
Place it on the seat of the cable row machine.
Sit down on the machine and place your feet on the front platform or crossbar provided making sure that your knees are slightly bent and not locked.
Lean over as you keep the natural alignment of your back and grab the V-bar handles.

With your arms extended pull back until your torso is at a 90-degree angle from your legs. Your back should be slightly arched and your chest should be sticking out. You should be feeling a nice stretch on your lats as you hold the bar in front of you. This is the starting position of the exercise.

Keeping the torso stationary, pull the handles back towards your torso while keeping the arms close to it until you touch the abdominals. Breathe out as you perform that movement. At that point you should be squeezing your back muscles hard. Hold that contraction for a second and slowly go back to the original position while breathing in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Elliptical Trainer
instructions: Naiki mesin elliptical dan pilih opsi latihan pada menu. Anda dapat menggunakan mode manual atau program otomatis, serta memasukkan usia dan berat badan untuk estimasi kalori. Sesuaikan tingkat kemiringan (elevation) untuk mengatur intensitas.
Gunakan sensor pada handle untuk memantau detak jantung agar intensitas tetap terjaga.
instructions_en: To begin, step onto the elliptical and select the desired option from the menu. Most ellipticals have a manual setting, or you can select a program to run. Typically, you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned during exercise. Elevation can be adjusted to change the intensity of the workout.
The handles can be used to monitor your heart rate to help you stay at an appropriate intensity.

name: Exercise Ball Crunch
instructions: Berbaringlah di atas bola latihan dengan punggung bawah menempel pada permukaan bola. Tekuk lutut dengan telapak kaki menapak kokoh di lantai. Biarkan tubuh bagian atas menggantung di atas bola. Silangkan tangan di dada atau letakkan di samping tubuh untuk menghindari ketegangan leher.
Turunkan tubuh untuk meregangkan otot perut. Jaga posisi leher tetap netral.

Dengan pinggul tetap stabil, kontraksikan otot perut untuk mengangkat bahu dan dada ke atas hingga terasa kencang. Punggung bawah harus selalu menempel pada bola. Buang napas saat bergerak ke atas dan tahan sejenak.
Tarik napas saat kembali ke posisi awal.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang disarankan.
instructions_en: Lie on an exercise ball with your lower back curvature pressed against the spherical surface of the ball. Your feet should be bent at the knee and pressed firmly against the floor. The upper torso should be hanging off the top of the ball. The arms should either be kept alongside the body or crossed on top of your chest as these positions avoid neck strains (as opposed to the hands behind the back of the head position).
Lower your torso into a stretch position keeping the neck stationary at all times. This will be your starting position.

With the hips stationary, flex the waist by contracting the abdominals and curl the shoulders and trunk upward until you feel a nice contraction on your abdominals. The arms should simply slide up the side of your legs if you have them at the side or just stay on top of your chest if you have them crossed. The lower back should always stay in contact with the ball. Exhale as you perform this movement and hold the contraction for a second.
As you inhale, go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Exercise Ball Pull-In
instructions: Letakkan bola stabilitas (exercise ball) di dekat Anda, lalu berbaringlah tengkurap di lantai di depan bola dengan kedua telapak tangan diletakkan di lantai selebar bahu dalam posisi push-up.

Sekarang, posisikan tulang kering bagian bawah Anda di atas bola stabilitas. Tips: Pada titik ini, kaki Anda harus lurus sepenuhnya dengan tulang kering di atas bola, dan tubuh bagian atas berada dalam posisi push-up yang ditopang oleh kedua lengan yang lurus di depan Anda. Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.

Sembari menjaga punggung tetap lurus dan tubuh bagian atas tidak bergerak, tarik lutut ke arah dada saat mengembuskan napas, biarkan bola menggelinding ke depan di bawah pergelangan kaki Anda. Kencangkan otot perut dan tahan posisi tersebut selama satu detik.
Perlahan luruskan kembali kaki Anda, gelindingkan bola kembali ke posisi awal saat menarik napas.
Ulangi gerakan ini sesuai dengan jumlah repetisi yang direkomendasikan.
instructions_en: Place an exercise ball nearby and lay on the floor in front of it with your hands on the floor shoulder width apart in a push-up position.

Now place your lower shins on top of an exercise ball. Tip: At this point your legs should be fully extended with the shins on top of the ball and the upper body should be in a push-up type of position being supported by your two extended arms in front of you. This will be your starting position.

While keeping your back completely straight and the upper body stationary, pull your knees in towards your chest as you exhale, allowing the ball to roll forward under your ankles. Squeeze your abs and hold that position for a second.
Now slowly straighten your legs, rolling the ball back to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Extended Range One-Arm Kettlebell Floor Press
instructions: Berbaringlah telentang di lantai dan posisikan kettlebell di salah satu sisi tangan yang akan melakukan dorongan. Pegang kettlebell pada bagian gagangnya. Tekuk kaki pada sisi yang sama dengan lengan yang mendorong, lalu silangkan lutut tersebut melewati garis tengah tubuh.
Dorong kettlebell ke atas dengan meluruskan siku dan mengaduksi lengan (merapatkan lengan ke arah tengah dada), menekannya ke atas tubuh Anda. Kembali ke posisi awal.
instructions_en: Lie on the floor and position a kettlebell for one arm to press. The kettlebell should be held by the handle. The leg on the same side that you are pressing should be bent, with the knee crossing over the midline of the body.
Press the kettlebell by extending the elbow and adducting the arm, pressing it above your body. Return to the starting position.

name: External Rotation
instructions: Berbaringlah miring di atas bangku datar (flat bench). Pegang dumbbell dengan satu tangan, sementara tangan lainnya ditekuk di atas bangku sebagai bantalan untuk menyandarkan kepala.
Tekuk siku pada lengan yang memegang dumbbell hingga membentuk sudut 90 derajat antara lengan atas dan lengan bawah. Tips: Jaga agar lengan atas tetap sejajar dengan torso (batang tubuh) Anda.

Sekarang, tekuk siku dengan posisi lengan bawah sejajar dengan lantai dan tegak lurus dengan torso Anda (sehingga lengan bawah berada tepat di depan Anda). Lengan atas harus tetap menempel di samping torso dan sejajar dengan lantai. Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.

Saat mengembuskan napas, lakukan rotasi luar (external rotation) pada lengan bawah sehingga dumbbell terangkat dalam gerakan setengah lingkaran dengan tetap mempertahankan sudut 90 derajat antara lengan atas dan lengan bawah. Lanjutkan rotasi luar ini hingga lengan bawah tegak lurus dengan lantai dan mengarah ke langit-langit. Tahan kontraksi ini selama satu detik.
Saat menarik napas, perlahan kembali ke posisi awal.
Ulangi gerakan ini sesuai jumlah repetisi yang direkomendasikan, lalu ganti dengan lengan yang lain.
instructions_en: Lie sideways on a flat bench with one arm holding a dumbbell and the other hand on top of the bench folded so that you can rest your head on it.
Bend the elbows of the arm holding the dumbbell so that it creates a 90-degree angle between the upper arm and the forearm. Tip: Keep the arm parallel to your torso.

Now bend the elbow while keeping the upper arm stationary. In this manner, the forearm will be parallel to the floor and perpendicular to your torso (Tip: So the forearm will be directly in front of you). The upper arm will be stationary by your torso and should be parallel to the floor (aligned with your torso at all times). This will be your starting position.

As you breathe out, externally rotate your forearm so that the dumbbell is lifted up in a semicircle motion as you maintain the 90 degree angle bend between the upper arms and the forearm. You will continue this external rotation until the forearm is perpendicular to the floor and the torso pointing towards the ceiling. At this point you will hold the contraction for a second.
As you breathe in, slowly go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and then switch to the other arm.

name: External Rotation with Band
instructions: Kaitkan resistance band pada sebuah tiang. Pastikan posisi band sejajar dengan tinggi siku Anda. Berdirilah dengan sisi kiri tubuh menghadap ke arah tiang berjarak beberapa kaki.

Pegang ujung band dengan tangan kanan, dan jaga agar siku tetap menempel rapat di samping tubuh. Disarankan untuk menjepit bantalan atau foam roller di antara siku dan tubuh agar posisinya tetap stabil.
Dengan lengan atas pada posisinya, tekuk siku hingga membentuk sudut 90 derajat dengan tangan menyilang di depan torso Anda. Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.
Lakukan gerakan dengan memutar lengan ke arah luar (gerakan seperti backhand) dengan tetap menjaga posisi siku Anda.
Putar sejauh yang Anda bisa, jeda sejenak, lalu kembali ke posisi awal.
instructions_en: Choke the band around a post. The band should be at the same height as your elbow. Stand with your left side to the band a couple of feet away.
Grasp the end of the band with your right hand, and keep your elbow pressed firmly to your side. We recommend you hold a pad or foam roll in place with your elbow to keep it firmly in position.
With your upper arm in position, your elbow should be flexed to 90 degrees with your hand reaching across the front of your torso. This will be your starting position.
Execute the movement by rotating your arm in a backhand motion, keeping your elbow in place.
Continue as far as you are able, pause, and then return to the starting position.

Lakukan gerakan dengan memutar lengan ke arah luar (gerakan seperti backhand) dengan tetap menjaga posisi siku Anda.

Execute the movement by rotating your arm in a backhand motion, keeping your elbow in place.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Hadap pulley tinggi dengan tali atau pegangan ganda, lalu tarik beban langsung ke arah wajah sambil membuka kedua tangan.
Jaga posisi lengan atas tetap sejajar dengan lantai.
instructions_en: Facing a high pulley with a rope or dual handles attached, pull the weight directly towards your face, separating your hands as you do so. Keep your upper arms parallel to the ground.
instructions_id: Hadap pulley tinggi dengan tali atau pegangan ganda, lalu tarik beban langsung ke arah wajah sambil membuka kedua tangan.

name: Farmer's Walk
instructions: Gunakan alat khusus, atau dumbbell berat / barbell pendek jika tidak tersedia. Berdirilah di antara beban tersebut.
Pegang handle, angkat beban dengan mendorong melalui tumit, jaga punggung tetap lurus dan kepala menghadap ke depan.
Berjalanlah dengan langkah pendek dan cepat, serta tetap bernapas. Lakukan sejauh jarak tertentu, biasanya 15-30 meter, secepat mungkin.
instructions_en: There are various implements that can be used for the farmers walk. These can also be performed with heavy dumbbells or short bars if these implements aren't available. Begin by standing between the implements.
After gripping the handles, lift them up by driving through your heels, keeping your back straight and your head up.
Walk taking short, quick steps, and don't forget to breathe. Move for a given distance, typically 50-100 feet, as fast as possible.

name: Fast Skipping
instructions: Mulailah dengan posisi rileks dan satu kaki sedikit di depan sebagai posisi awal.
Lakukan skipping dengan pola langkah kanan-kanan ke kiri-kiri, secara bergantian.
Lakukan skipping cepat dengan menjaga kontak kaki tetap dekat dengan lantai, kurangi waktu di udara, dan bergerak secepat mungkin.
instructions_en: Start in a relaxed position with one leg slightly forward. This will be your starting position.
Skip by executing a step-hop pattern of right-right-step to left-left-step, and so on, alternating back and forth.
Perform fast skips by maintaining close contact with the ground and reduce air time, moving as quickly as possible.

name: Finger Curls
instructions: Pegang barbell dengan kedua tangan, telapak tangan menghadap ke atas, dengan jarak seluas bahu.
Posisikan kaki rata di lantai dengan jarak sedikit lebih lebar dari bahu sebagai posisi awal.
Turunkan bar sejauh mungkin dengan meluruskan jari-jari, biarkan bar menggelinding turun hingga ruas jari terakhir.
Tekuk jari untuk mengangkat bar setinggi mungkin sambil menghembuskan napas. Tahan kontraksi di atas.
instructions_en: Hold a barbell with both hands and your palms facing up; hands spaced about shoulder width.
Place your feet flat on the floor, at a distance that is slightly wider than shoulder width apart. This will be your starting position.
Lower the bar as far as possible by extending the fingers. Allowing the bar to roll down the hands, catch the bar with the final joint in the fingers.
Now curl bar up as high as possible by closing your hands while exhaling. Hold the contraction at the top.

name: Flat Bench Cable Flyes
instructions: Letakkan bench datar di antara dua pulley bawah sehingga dada sejajar dengan pulley saat berbaring.
Berbaringlah di bench dengan kaki tetap di lantai.
Minta bantuan untuk memberikan handle dengan genggaman telapak tangan menghadap ke atas.
Rentangkan lengan ke samping dengan sedikit menekuk siku (pertahankan tekukan ini sepanjang gerakan). Lengan harus sejajar lantai sebagai posisi awal.
Angkat lengan membentuk setengah lingkaran ke depan hingga kedua tangan bertemu di atas. Remas dada saat bergerak dan buang napas, lalu tahan kontraksi sejenak di atas.
Kembali secara perlahan ke posisi awal.
Ulangi untuk jumlah repetisi yang ditentukan.
instructions_en: Position a flat bench between two low pulleys so that when you are laying on it, your chest will be lined up with the cable pulleys.
Lay flat on the bench and keep your feet on the ground.
Have someone hand you the handles on each hand. You will grab each single handle attachment with a palms up grip.

Extend your arms by your side with a slight bend on your elbows. Tip: You will keep this bend constant through the whole movement. Your arms should be parallel to the floor. This is your starting position.

Now start lifting the arms in a semi-circle motion directly in front of you by pulling the cables together until both hands meet at the top of the movement. Squeeze your chest as you perform this motion and breathe out during this movement. Also, hold the contraction for a second at the top. Tip: When performed correctly, at the top position of this movement, your arms should be perpendicular to your torso and the floor touching above your chest.
Slowly come back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Flat Bench Leg Pull-In
instructions: Berbaringlah di atas matras atau bangku datar dengan posisi kaki menggantung di ujung bangku.
Letakkan tangan di bawah bokong dengan telapak menghadap ke bawah atau pegang sisi bangku untuk stabilitas. Luruskan kaki ke depan sebagai posisi awal.
Buang napas, tekuk lutut dan tarik paha ke arah perut hingga lutut mendekati dada. Tahan posisi kontraksi selama satu detik.
Tarik napas, lalu kembali ke posisi awal secara perlahan.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai repetisi yang disarankan.
instructions_en: Lie on an exercise mat or a flat bench with your legs off the end.

Place your hands either under your glutes with your palms down or by the sides holding on to the bench (or with palms down by the side on an exercise mat). Also extend your legs straight out. This will be your starting position.
Bend your knees and pull your upper thighs into your midsection as you breathe out. Continue this movement until your knees are near your chest. Hold the contracted position for a second.
As you breathe in, slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Flat Bench Lying Leg Raise
instructions: Berbaringlah telentang di atas bangku dengan posisi kaki menggantung di ujung bangku.
Letakkan tangan di bawah bokong dengan telapak menghadap ke bawah atau pegang sisi bangku sebagai posisi awal.
Jaga kaki tetap lurus dengan lutut sedikit terkunci, angkat kaki hingga membentuk sudut 90 derajat dengan lantai. Buang napas saat mengangkat dan tahan posisi kontraksi selama satu detik.
Tarik napas, lalu turunkan kaki kembali ke posisi awal secara perlahan.
instructions_en: Lie with your back flat on a bench and your legs extended in front of you off the end.
Place your hands either under your glutes with your palms down or by the sides holding on to the bench. This will be your starting position.

As you keep your legs extended, straight as possible with your knees slightly bent but locked raise your legs until they make a 90-degree angle with the floor. Exhale as you perform this portion of the movement and hold the contraction at the top for a second.
Now, as you inhale, slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
instructions_id: Berbaringlah telentang di atas bangku dengan posisi kaki menggantung di ujung bangku.

name: Flexor Incline Dumbbell Curls
instructions: Pegang dumbel pada sisi yang lebih jauh agar beban lebih berat di sisi dekat ibu jari. Pastikan pergelangan tangan tetap menekuk ke belakang untuk mengurangi tekanan.
Duduklah di bangku miring (incline) dengan sudut 45 derajat sambil memegang sepasang dumbel.
Biarkan lengan menggantung ke samping dengan siku tetap rapat, telapak tangan menghadap ke depan. Pertahankan posisi tangan ini selama gerakan.

Angkat kedua dumbel secara bersamaan hingga otot bisep berkontraksi penuh sambil membuang napas. Jangan mengayunkan lengan dan jaga gerakan tetap terkontrol. Tahan kontraksi selama satu detik di atas.
Tarik napas, lalu kembali ke posisi awal secara perlahan.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai repetisi yang disarankan.
instructions_en: Hold the dumbbell towards the side farther from you so that you have more weight on the side closest to you. (This can be done for a good effect on all bicep dumbbell exercises). Now do a normal incline dumbbell curl, but keep your wrists as far back as possible so as to neutralize any stress that is placed on them.
Sit on an incline bench that is angled at 45-degrees while holding a dumbbell on each hand.

Let your arms hang down on your sides, with the elbows in, and turn the palms of your hands forward with the thumbs pointing away from the body. Tip: You will keep this hand position throughout the movement as there should not be any twisting of the hands as they come up. This will be your starting position.

Curl up the two dumbbells at the same time until your biceps are fully contracted and exhale. Tip: Do not swing the arms or use momentum. Keep a controlled motion at all times. Hold the contracted position for a second at the top.
As you inhale, slowly go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_id: Pegang dumbel pada sisi yang lebih jauh agar beban lebih berat di sisi dekat ibu jari. Pastikan pergelangan tangan tetap menekuk ke belakang untuk mengurangi tekanan.

Tarik napas, lalu kembali ke posisi awal secara perlahan.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai repetisi yang disarankan.

name: Floor Glute-Ham Raise
instructions: Gunakan bantuan rekan atau kaitkan kaki pada penyangga yang stabil.
Berlututlah dengan posisi tubuh tegak. Jika menggunakan rekan, pastikan mereka menahan kaki Anda dengan kuat sebagai posisi awal.
Turunkan tubuh dengan melakukan ekstensi pada lutut. Pastikan panggul tidak menekuk saat bergerak maju.
Letakkan tangan di depan sebagai penyangga saat mencapai lantai. Gunakan dorongan tangan secara perlahan untuk membantu kembali ke posisi awal.
instructions_en: You can use a partner for this exercise or brace your feet under something stable.
Begin on your knees with your upper legs and torso upright. If using a partner, they will firmly hold your feet to keep you in position. This will be your starting position.
Lower yourself by extending at the knee, taking care to NOT flex the hips as you go forward.

Place your hands in front of you as you reach the floor. This movement is very difficult and you may be unable to do it unaided. Use your arms to lightly push off the floor to aid your return to the starting position.

name: Floor Press
instructions: Atur ketinggian rak barbel. Berbaringlah di lantai dengan kepala di dekat rak, satukan tulang belikat, lalu angkat barbel dari rak.
Turunkan barbel ke bagian bawah dada atau perut atas sambil menjaga siku tetap rapat dan berusaha merenggangkan barbel. Turunkan hingga lengan atas menyentuh lantai tanpa menghentakkan beban.
Dorong barbel kembali ke atas secepat mungkin, pastikan posisi barbel, pergelangan tangan, dan siku tetap sejajar.
instructions_en: Adjust the j-hooks so they are at the appropriate height to rack the bar. Begin lying on the floor with your head near the end of a power rack. Keeping your shoulder blades pulled together; pull the bar off of the hooks.

Lower the bar towards the bottom of your chest or upper stomach, squeezing the bar and attempting to pull it apart as you do so. Ensure that you tuck your elbows throughout the movement. Lower the bar until your upper arm contacts the ground and pause, preventing any slamming or bouncing of the weight.
Press the bar back up as fast as you can, keeping the bar, your wrists, and elbows in line as you do so.

name: Floor Press with Chains
instructions: Sesuaikan j-hook pada tinggi yang tepat untuk menyangga barbel. Untuk latihan ini, gantungkan rantai langsung di ujung barbel, usahakan agar ujungnya tidak menyentuh pelat beban.
Berbaringlah di lantai dengan kepala dekat ujung power rack. Tarik belikat Anda saling mendekat (retraksi), lalu angkat barbel dari penyangga (unrack).

Turunkan barbel ke arah dada bagian bawah atau perut bagian atas, sambil menggenggam erat barbel dan seolah mencoba meregangkannya ke samping. Pastikan siku tetap rapat (tuck) selama gerakan. Turunkan hingga lengan atas menyentuh lantai dan tahan sejenak, hindari membenturkan atau memantulkan beban.
Dorong barbel kembali ke atas secepat mungkin, jaga agar barbel, pergelangan tangan, dan siku tetap sejajar selama gerakan.
instructions_en: Adjust the j-hooks so they are at the appropriate height to rack the bar. For this exercise, drape the chains directly over the end of the bar, trying to keep the ends away from the plates.
Begin lying on the floor with your head near the end of a power rack. Keeping your shoulder blades pulled together, pull the bar off of the hooks.

Lower the bar towards the bottom of your chest or upper stomach, squeezing the bar and attempting to pull it apart as you do so. Ensure that you tuck your elbows throughout the movement. Lower the bar until your upper arm contacts the ground and pause, preventing any slamming or bouncing of the weight.
Press the bar back up as fast as you can, keeping the bar, your wrists, and elbows in line as you do so.

name: Flutter Kicks
instructions: Berbaringlah telungkup di atas bangku datar (flat bench) dengan pinggul berada di ujung bangku, kedua kaki lurus dengan jari kaki tidak menyentuh lantai, dan kedua tangan memegang ujung depan bangku.
Kencangkan otot bokong (glutes) dan paha belakang (hamstring), lalu luruskan kaki hingga sejajar dengan pinggul. Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.
Mulai gerakan dengan mengangkat kaki kaki kiri lebih tinggi dari kaki kanan.
Turunkan kaki kiri bersamaan dengan mengangkat kaki kanan.

Lanjutkan gerakan bergantian seperti ini (seperti melakukan gerakan kaki gaya bebas saat berenang) hingga Anda mencapai jumlah repetisi yang dianjurkan untuk setiap kaki. Pastikan gerakan tetap terkontrol setiap saat. Tip: Bernapaslah secara normal selama melakukan gerakan ini.
instructions_en: On a flat bench lie facedown with the hips on the edge of the bench, the legs straight with toes high off the floor and with the arms on top of the bench holding on to the front edge.
Squeeze your glutes and hamstrings and straighten the legs until they are level with the hips. This will be your starting position.
Start the movement by lifting the left leg higher than the right leg.
Then lower the left leg as you lift the right leg.

Continue alternating in this manner (as though you are doing a flutter kick in water) until you have done the recommended amount of repetitions for each leg. Make sure that you keep a controlled movement at all times. Tip: You will breathe normally as you perform this movement.

name: Foot-SMR
instructions: Latihan ini meregangkan fasia otot-otot kaki. Mulailah dengan posisi duduk tanpa alas kaki. Gunakan foot roller atau benda serupa, seperti potongan pipa PVC kecil, lalu letakkan telapak kaki Anda di atas roller tepat di bagian lengkungan kaki (arch). Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.
Tekan dengan kuat ke bawah sambil menggulirkan roller di sepanjang lengkungan kaki Anda. Tahan selama 10-30 detik, lalu ganti dengan kaki satunya.
instructions_en: This exercise stretches the fascia of the muscles in the feet. Start off seated with your shoes removed. Using a foot roller or a similar object, such as a small section of pvc pipe, place your foot against the roller across the arch of your foot. This will be your starting position.
Press down firmly, rolling across the arch of your foot. Hold for 10-30 seconds, and then switch feet.

name: Forward Drag with Press
instructions: Pasang rantai atau tali dengan pegangan ganda (dual handle) pada sled. Berdirilah membelakangi sled sambil memegang satu pegangan di setiap tangan.

Mulai gerakan dengan melangkah maju satu langkah. Condongkan tubuh ke depan, dorong menggunakan kekuatan kaki dan pinggul untuk bergerak, berhenti sejenak di setiap langkah untuk meluruskan siku sambil mendorong tangan ke depan. Melangkahlah ke depan hingga Anda kembali ke posisi awal untuk bersiap mendorong lagi.
instructions_en: Attach a dual handled chain or rope attachment to the sled. You should be facing away from the sled, holding a handle in each hand.

Begin the movement by moving forward for one step. Leaning forward, extend through the legs and hips to move, pausing with each step to extend through the elbows, pressing your hands forward. Step forward until you return to the start position prepared to press.

name: Frankenstein Squat
instructions: Latihan ini melatih posisi tubuh dan barbel yang benar saat melakukan gerakan clean dan front squat.

Letakkan barbell di bagian depan bahu, lepaskan genggaman tangan Anda, dan luruskan lengan ke depan. Dorong bahu ke depan untuk membuat tumpuan (shelf), dan pastikan barbel menempel dekat tenggorokan. Pastikan hanya belikat yang didorong ke depan; jangan membungkukkan tulang punggung atas (thoracic spine).

Lakukan squat dengan menekuk lutut dan pinggul, turunkan pinggul di antara kedua kaki. Jaga tubuh tetap tegak, lengan tetap lurus ke depan, bahu terdorong ke depan, dan barbel harus tetap diam di tempatnya. Turunlah hingga posisi squat terdalam (bottom-out) sampai paha belakang menyentuh betis.
Kembali ke posisi tegak dengan mendorong melalui bagian depan tumit serta meluruskan lutut dan pinggul.
instructions_en: This drill teaches you the proper positioning of both the bar and your body during the clean and front squat.

Place the barbell on the front of the shoulders, releasing your grip and extending your arms out in front of you. The shoulders should be pushed forward to create a shelf, and the bar should be in contact with the throat. Ensure that you only move your shoulder blades forward; don't round the thoracic spine.

Squat by flexing the knees and hips, sitting in between your legs. Keep the torso upright, the arms up, and the shoulders forward, and the bar should stay in place. Go to the bottom of the squat, until your hamstrings contact your calves.
Return to the upright position by driving through the front of the heel and extending the knees and hips.

name: Freehand Jump Squat
instructions: Silangkan tangan di depan dada.
Posisikan kaki selebar bahu, tatapan ke depan, dan punggung tetap lurus.
Jongkok sambil menarik napas, jaga punggung tetap lurus dan dada busung hingga paha sejajar atau lebih rendah dari lantai.
Gunakan dorongan dari ujung kaki dan otot paha bagaikan pegas untuk melompat lurus ke atas setinggi mungkin. Buang napas saat melompat.
Saat mendarat, segera turun kembali ke posisi jongkok dan ulangi lompatan.
Ulangi sesuai jumlah repetisi yang dianjurkan.
instructions_en: Cross your arms over your chest.
With your head up and your back straight, position your feet at shoulder width.
Keeping your back straight and chest up, squat down as you inhale until your upper thighs are parallel, or lower, to the floor.
Now pressing mainly with the ball of your feet, jump straight up in the air as high as possible, using the thighs like springs. Exhale during this portion of the movement.
When you touch the floor again, immediately squat down and jump again.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Frog Hops
instructions: Berdirilah dengan tangan di belakang kepala, lalu jongkok dengan dada tegak dan pandangan ke depan. Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.

Lompatlah ke depan sejauh beberapa kaki, hindari melompat terlalu tinggi yang tidak perlu. Saat kaki menyentuh tanah, redam benturan melalui kaki, lalu lompat kembali. Ulangi gerakan ini sebanyak 5-10 kali.
instructions_en: Stand with your hands behind your head, and squat down keeping your torso upright and your head up. This will be your starting position.
Jump forward several feet, avoiding jumping unnecessarily high. As your feet contact the ground, absorb the impact through your legs, and jump again. Repeat this action 5-10 times.

name: Frog Sit-Ups
instructions: Berbaringlah telentang di lantai (atau matras) dengan kedua kaki lurus di depan.
Tekuk lutut dan biarkan bagian luar paha menyentuh lantai (atau matras) sementara telapak kaki saling bersentuhan.
Tarik kedua telapak kaki mendekat ke arah tubuh semaksimal mungkin, sambil menjaga bagian luar paha tetap di lantai (atau hampir menyentuhnya). Tips: Posisikan kaki membentuk wajik.
Silangkan tangan di depan dada dengan menyentuh bahu yang berlawanan. Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.
Sambil membuang napas, ratakan punggung bawah ke lantai lalu angkat dada ke atas. Tips: Gerakan ini mirip dengan seperempat gerakan awal sit-up. Tahan di posisi atas selama sedetik.
Sambil menarik napas, turunkan kembali tubuh secara perlahan ke posisi awal.
Ulangi sesuai jumlah repetisi yang dianjurkan.
instructions_en: Lie with your back flat on the floor (or exercise mat) and your legs extended in front of you.
Now bend at the knees and place your outer thighs by the floor (or mat) as you make the soles of your feet touch each other.

Now try pushing both soles and bringing them up as near you as possible while you keep the outer thighs on the floor (or at least almost touching it). Tip: In this position your legs should create a diamond shape.
Now, cross your arms in front of you by touching the opposite shoulders. This will be your starting position.
As you exhale flatten your lower back to the floor while curling the torso upwards. Tip: This will be like performing the first 1/4 movement of a sit up. Hold at the top position for a second.
As you inhale, slowly lower back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Front Barbell Squat
instructions: Latihan ini sebaiknya dilakukan di dalam squat rack demi keamanan. Atur ketinggian barbel pada rak setinggi dada. Masukkan lengan di bawah barbel dengan siku tinggi dan lengan atas sedikit di atas sejajar lantai. Letakkan barbel di atas otot deltoid (bahu depan) dan silangkan tangan untuk memegang barbel demi kontrol penuh.
Angkat barbel dari rak dengan mendorong kaki sambil menegakkan torso.
Mundurlah dari rak dan buka kaki selebar bahu dengan ujung kaki sedikit menghadap keluar. Jaga pandangan tetap ke depan dan punggung lurus. Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.

Turunkan barbel secara perlahan dengan menekuk lutut sambil menjaga postur tetap tegak dan pandangan ke depan. Turun hingga sudut paha dan betis sedikit kurang dari 90 derajat (paha berada di bawah sejajar lantai). Tarik napas saat turun. Tips: Pastikan lutut segaris dengan ujung kaki dan tidak melewati ujung jari kaki.
Angkat kembali barbel sambil membuang napas dengan mendorong lantai menggunakan bagian tengah telapak kaki, luruskan kaki kembali ke posisi awal.
Ulangi sesuai jumlah repetisi yang dianjurkan.
instructions_en: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To begin, first set the bar on a rack that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, bring your arms up under the bar while keeping the elbows high and the upper arm slightly above parallel to the floor. Rest the bar on top of the deltoids and cross your arms while grasping the bar for total control.
Lift the bar off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.

Step away from the rack and position your legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Keep your head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a straight back. This will be your starting position. (Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances described in the foot positioning section).

Begin to slowly lower the bar by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up. Continue down until the angle between the upper leg and the calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below parallel to the floor). Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knees should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If your knees are past that imaginary line (if they are past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
Begin to raise the bar as you exhale by pushing the floor mainly with the middle of your foot as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Front Barbell Squat To A Bench
instructions: Latihan ini sebaiknya dilakukan di dalam squat rack demi keamanan. Letakkan bangku datar di belakang Anda dan atur barbel pada rak setinggi dada. Masukkan lengan di bawah barbel dengan siku tinggi dan lengan atas sedikit di atas sejajar lantai. Letakkan barbel di atas otot deltoid (bahu depan) dan silangkan tangan untuk memegang barbel demi kontrol penuh.
Angkat barbel dari rak dengan mendorong kaki sambil menegakkan torso.
Mundurlah dari rak dan buka kaki selebar bahu dengan ujung kaki sedikit menghadap keluar. Jaga pandangan tetap ke depan dan punggung lurus. Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.

Turunkan barbel secara perlahan dengan menekuk lutut sambil menjaga postur tetap tegak dan pandangan ke depan. Turun hingga bokong menyentuh bangku. Tarik napas saat turun. Tips: Pastikan lutut segaris dengan ujung kaki dan tidak melewati ujung jari kaki.
Angkat kembali barbel sambil membuang napas dengan mendorong lantai menggunakan tumit kaki, luruskan kaki kembali ke posisi awal.
Ulangi sesuai jumlah repetisi yang dianjurkan.
instructions_en: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To begin, first set a flat bench behind you and set the bar on a rack that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, bring your arms up under the bar while keeping the elbows high and the upper arm slightly above parallel to the floor. Rest the bar on top of the deltoids and cross your arms while grasping the bar for total control.
Lift the bar off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.

Step away from the rack and position your legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Keep your head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a straight back. This will be your starting position. (Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances described in the foot positioning section).

Begin to slowly lower the bar by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up. Continue down until you touch the bench with your glutes. Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knees should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If your knees are past that imaginary line (if they are past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
Begin to raise the bar as you exhale by pushing the floor mainly with the heel of your foot as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Masukkan lengan di bawah barbel dengan siku tinggi dan lengan atas sedikit di atas sejajar lantai. Letakkan barbel di atas otot deltoid (bahu depan) dan silangkan tangan untuk memegang barbel demi kontrol penuh.
Angkat barbel dari rak dengan mendorong kaki sambil menegakkan torso.

Angkat kembali barbel sambil membuang napas dengan mendorong lantai menggunakan tumit kaki, luruskan kaki kembali ke posisi awal.
Ulangi sesuai jumlah repetisi yang dianjurkan.

name: Front Box Jump
instructions: Posisikan kotak setinggi 30-60 cm di depan Anda. Berdiri dengan kaki selebar bahu.
Lakukan squat pendek sebagai persiapan melompat, sambil mengayunkan lengan ke belakang.
Lompat setinggi mungkin dengan melakukan ekstensi pada pinggul, lutut, dan pergelangan kaki. Ayunkan lengan ke depan dan ke atas.
Mendaratlah di atas kotak dengan lutut menekuk untuk meredam benturan. Turun dari kotak dengan melangkah satu kaki demi satu kaki.
instructions_en: Begin with a box of an appropriate height 1-2 feet in front of you. Stand with your feet should width apart. This will be your starting position.
Perform a short squat in preparation for jumping, swinging your arms behind you.
Rebound out of this position, extending through the hips, knees, and ankles to jump as high as possible. Swing your arms forward and up.
Land on the box with the knees bent, absorbing the impact through the legs. You can jump from the box back to the ground, or preferably step down one leg at a time.
