name: Smith Machine Hip Raise
instructions: Letakkan bangku di dalam rak dan pasang beban yang sesuai pada bar. Berbaringlah di bangku dengan telapak kaki menapak pada bar. Lepaskan kunci bar dan luruskan kaki Anda (bisa dibantu dengan tangan). Pegang sisi mesin Smith untuk kestabilan ekstra sebagai posisi awal.
Mulailah gerakan dengan memutar panggul dan melenturkan tulang belakang untuk mengangkat pinggul dari bangku. Jaga sedikit tekukan pada lutut selama gerakan berlangsung.
Setelah jeda singkat, turunkan kembali pinggul ke bangku.
Ulangi gerakan ini sesuai jumlah repetisi yang diinginkan.
instructions_en: Position a bench in the rack and load the bar to an appropriate weight. Lie down on the bench, placing the bottom of your feet against the bar. Unlock the bar and extend your legs. You may need to use your hands to assist you. For added stability grasp the sides of the Smith Machine. This will be your starting position.
Initiate the movement by rotating your pelvis, flexing your spine to raise your hips off of the bench. Maintain a slight bend in the knees throughout the motion.
After a brief pause, return the hips to the bench.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructions_id: Letakkan bangku di dalam rak dan pasang beban yang sesuai pada bar. Berbaringlah di bangku dengan telapak kaki menapak pada bar. Lepaskan kunci bar dan luruskan kaki Anda (bisa dibantu dengan tangan). Pegang sisi mesin Smith untuk kestabilan ekstra sebagai posisi awal.

name: Smith Machine Incline Bench Press
instructions: Atur bangku incline di bawah smith machine. Posisikan barbell pada ketinggian yang terjangkau saat berbaring dengan lengan hampir lurus. Setelah mengatur beban, berbaringlah dan pastikan dada bagian atas sejajar dengan barbell. Genggam bar dengan posisi telapak tangan menghadap ke depan (lebih lebar dari bahu), lepas kunci bar, lalu luruskan lengan ke atas sebagai posisi awal.
Tarik napas, lalu turunkan bar secara perlahan hingga hampir menyentuh dada bagian atas.

Tahan selama satu detik, lalu dorong kembali bar ke posisi awal menggunakan otot dada sambil mengembuskan napas. Kunci lengan di atas, tahan sesaat, lalu turunkan kembali secara perlahan. (Tip: Durasi menurunkan beban sebaiknya dua kali lebih lambat dibanding saat mendorong).
Ulangi gerakan ini sesuai dengan jumlah repetisi yang dianjurkan.
Setelah selesai, kunci kembali bar ke rak dengan aman.
instructions_en: Place an incline bench underneath the smith machine. Place the barbell at a height that you can reach when lying down and your arms are almost fully extended. Once the weight you need is selected, lie down on the incline bench and make sure your upper chest is aligned with the barbell. Using a pronated grip (palms facing forward) that is wider than shoulder width, unlock the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms locked. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on your upper chest.

After a second pause, bring the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out and push the bar using your chest muscles. Lock your arms in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, place the bar back in the rack.

Setelah mengatur beban, berbaringlah dan pastikan dada bagian atas sejajar dengan barbell. Genggam bar dengan posisi telapak tangan menghadap ke depan (lebih lebar dari bahu), lepas kunci bar, lalu luruskan lengan ke atas sebagai posisi awal.

Tahan selama satu detik, lalu dorong kembali bar ke posisi awal menggunakan otot dada sambil mengembuskan napas. Kunci lengan di atas, tahan sesaat, lalu turunkan kembali secara perlahan. (Tip: Durasi menurunkan beban sebaiknya dua kali lebih lambat dibanding saat mendorong).

name: Smith Machine Leg Press
instructions: Atur bar mesin Smith beberapa kaki dari lantai dan pastikan bertumpu pada pengaman (safeties). Pasang beban yang sesuai, lalu berbaringlah di bawah bar. Letakkan bagian tengah telapak kaki pada bar dengan lutut ditarik ke arah dada sebagai posisi awal.
Dorong bar ke atas dengan menjejakkan kaki, luruskan pinggul dan lutut secara bersamaan. Jangan mengunci lutut di bagian atas.
Pada titik tertinggi, tahan sejenak sebelum kembali secara perlahan ke posisi awal.
instructions_en: Position a Smith machine bar a couple feet off of the ground. Ensure that it is resting on the safeties. After loading the bar to an appropriate weight, lie underneath the bar. Place the middle of your feet on the bar, tucking your knees to your chest. This will be your starting position.
Begin the movement by driving through your feet to move the bar upward, extending the hips and knees. Do not lock out your knees.
At the top of the motion, pause briefly before returning to the starting position.

name: Smith Machine One-Arm Upright Row
instructions: Atur posisi bar setinggi paha dan pasang beban yang sesuai.

Genggam bar dengan bukaan tangan yang lebar, lepaskan pengunci, dan lepaskan satu tangan yang tidak digunakan dari bar. Berdirilah tegak dengan lengan memegang bar dalam posisi lurus, kepala dan dada tegak sebagai posisi awal.
Mulailah gerakan dengan menekuk siku dan mengangkat lengan atas ke samping hingga sejajar dengan lantai.
Setelah jeda singkat, turunkan kembali beban ke posisi awal secara terkontrol.
Ulangi untuk jumlah repetisi yang diinginkan sebelum mengunci kembali bar ke rak.
instructions_en: With the bar at thigh level, load an appropriate weight.

Take a wide grip on the bar and unhook the weight, removing your off hand from the bar. Your arm should be extended as you stand up straight with your head and chest up. This will be your starting position.
Begin the movement by flexing the elbow, raising the upper arm with the elbow pointed out. Continue until your upper arm is parallel to the floor.
After a brief pause, return the weight to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before engaging the hooks to rack the weight.

name: Smith Machine Overhead Shoulder Press
instructions: Letakkan bangku datar (sebaiknya dengan sandaran) di bawah Smith Machine. Atur tinggi barbel agar saat duduk, lengan Anda hampir lurus sepenuhnya untuk menggapainya.

Duduklah sedikit di belakang barbel agar posisi hidung Anda segaris lurus dengan barbel. Kaki diam. Genggam barbel dengan telapak menghadap depan, buka kunci, lalu angkat hingga lengan lurus sepenuhnya sebagai posisi awal.
Tarik napas sambil menurunkan barbel perlahan hingga setinggi dagu.
Buang napas sambil mendorong barbel kembali ke posisi awal menggunakan otot bahu.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai repetisi yang dianjurkan.
instructions_en: To begin, place a flat bench (or preferably one with back support) underneath a smith machine. Position the barbell at a height so that when seated on the flat bench, the arms must be almost fully extended to reach the barbell.

Once you have the correct height, sit slightly in behind the barbell so that there is an imaginary straight line from the tip of your nose to the barbell. Your feet should be stationary. Grab the barbell with the palms facing forward, unlock it and lift it up so that your arms are fully extended. This is the starting position.
Slowly begin to lower the barbell until it is level with your chin while inhaling.
Then lift the barbell back to the starting position using your shoulders while exhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Smith Machine Pistol Squat
instructions: Atur tinggi bar sesuai tinggi badan Anda. Posisikan bar di bahu bagian belakang.
Pegang bar dengan telapak menghadap depan, buka kunci, dan angkat dari rak dengan meluruskan kaki.
Majukan satu kaki sekitar 30 cm di depan bar. Luruskan kaki lainnya ke depan tanpa menyentuh lantai. Tetap menatap ke depan dengan tulang belakang netral atau sedikit melengkung sebagai posisi awal.
Jaga postur, turunkan tubuh dengan menekuk lutut dan pinggul sedalam kemampuan fleksibilitas Anda.
Tahan sejenak di bawah, lalu kembali ke posisi awal dengan mendorong melalui tumit, sambil meluruskan lutut dan pinggul.
instructions_en: To begin, first set the bar to a position that best matches your height. Step under it and position the bar across the back of your shoulders.
Take the bar with your hands facing forward, unlock it and lift it off the rack by extending your legs. 3

Move one foot forward about 12 inches in front of the bar. Extend the other leg out in front of you, holding it off the ground. Look forward at all times and maintain a neutral or slightly arched spine. This will be your starting position.
Maintaining good posture, lower yourself by flexing the knee and hip, going down as far as flexibility allows.
Pause briefly at the bottom and then return to the starting position by driving through the heel of your foot, extending the knee and hip.

name: Smith Machine Reverse Calf Raises
instructions: Atur tinggi bar Smith Machine dan letakkan platform pijakan di bawahnya.
Berdiri di atas platform dengan tumit menapak dan bagian depan telapak kaki menggantung. Buka kaki selebar bahu dan arahkan jari kaki ke depan.

Posisikan bahu di bawah bar, dorong ke atas dengan meluruskan pinggul dan lutut hingga tubuh tegak. Jaga lutut sedikit menekuk, jangan dikunci. Ini posisi awal Anda. Catatan: Bar hanya sebagai penyeimbang.
Buang napas, jinjit setinggi mungkin dengan mengontraksikan otot betis. Jaga lutut tetap diam dan lurus. Tahan sejenak saat kontraksi maksimal.
Tarik napas sambil menurunkan tumit kembali ke posisi awal secara perlahan.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai repetisi yang dianjurkan.
instructions_en: Adjust the barbell on the smith machine to fit your height and align a raised platform right under the bar.
Stand on the platform with the heels of your feet secured on top of it with the balls of your feet extending off it. Position your toes facing forward with a shoulder width stance.

Now, place your shoulders under the barbell while maintaining the foot positioning described and push the barbell up by extending your hips and knees until your torso is standing erect. The knees should be kept with a slight bend; never locked. This will be your starting position. Tip: The barbell on your back is only for balance purposes.

Raise the balls of your feet as you breathe out by extending your toes as high as possible and flexing your calf. Ensure that the knee is kept stationary at all times. There should be no bending at any time. Hold the contracted position for a second before you start to go back down.
Slowly go back down to the starting position as you breathe in by lowering the balls of your feet and toes.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Smith Machine Squat
instructions: Atur tinggi bar sesuai tubuh Anda. Setelah beban terpasang, posisikan bahu bagian belakang (sedikit di bawah leher) di bawah bar.
Genggam bar dengan kedua tangan (telapak menghadap depan), buka kunci, dan angkat dari rak dengan mendorong kaki sambil menegakkan tubuh.
Buka kaki selebar bahu dengan jari kaki sedikit mengarah keluar. Jaga kepala tetap tegak dan punggung lurus sebagai posisi awal.

Tarik napas perlahan sambil menurunkan bar dengan menekuk lutut. Turun hingga sudut paha dan betis kurang dari 90 derajat (paha di bawah paralel lantai). Pastikan lutut tidak melebihi ujung jari kaki untuk mencegah cedera.
Buang napas sambil mendorong lantai dengan tumit untuk kembali ke posisi berdiri tegak.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai repetisi yang dianjurkan.
instructions_en: To begin, first set the bar on the height that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, step under the bar and place the back of your shoulders (slightly below the neck) across it.
Hold on to the bar using both arms at each side (palms facing forward), unlock it and lift it off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.

Position your legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Keep your head up at all times and also maintain a straight back. This will be your starting position. (Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances discussed in the foot stances section).

Begin to slowly lower the bar by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up. Continue down until the angle between the upper leg and the calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below parallel to the floor). Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knees should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If your knees are past that imaginary line (if they are past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
Begin to raise the bar as you exhale by pushing the floor with the heel of your foot as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Smith Machine Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Atur tinggi bar Smith Machine setinggi pertengahan paha. Genggam bar dengan pegangan pronasi (telapak menghadap depan) selebar bahu.
Angkat bar dengan meluruskan lengan sepenuhnya, punggung tetap lurus. Berdiri tegak dengan kaki selebar bahu dan lutut sedikit ditekuk sebagai posisi awal.
Buang napas, turunkan bar ke arah punggung kaki dengan menekuk pinggang tanpa menggerakkan lutut. Jaga punggung tetap lurus hingga otot hamstring terasa teregang.
Tarik napas, segera kembali ke posisi tegak dengan mendorong pinggul dan pinggang ke depan.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai repetisi yang dianjurkan.
instructions_en: To begin, set the bar on the smith machine to a height that is around the middle of your thighs. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, grasp the bar using a pronated (palms forward) grip that is shoulder width apart. You may need some wrist wraps if using a significant amount of weight.

Lift the bar up by fully extending your arms while keeping your back straight. Stand with your torso straight and your legs spaced using a shoulder width or narrower stance. The knees should be slightly bent. This is your starting position.

Keeping the knees stationary, lower the barbell to over the top of your feet by bending at the waist while keeping your back straight. Keep moving forward as if you were going to pick something from the floor until you feel a stretch on the hamstrings. Exhale as you perform this movement

Start bringing your torso up straight again as soon as you feel the hamstrings stretch by extending your hips and waist until you are back at the starting position. Inhale as you perform this movement.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Smith Machine Upright Row
instructions: Atur posisi bar pada mesin Smith setinggi pertengahan paha. Pegang bar dengan genggaman pronasi (telapak tangan menghadap ke depan) selebar bahu.
Angkat bar dengan meluruskan lengan sepenuhnya dan jaga punggung tetap lurus, beri sedikit tekukan pada siku. Ini adalah posisi awal.

Gunakan otot bahu samping untuk mengangkat bar ke atas mendekati tubuh sambil menghembuskan napas hingga hampir menyentuh dagu. Pastikan siku memimpin gerakan dan selalu berada lebih tinggi dari lengan bawah, serta jaga torso tetap stabil. Tahan sejenak di atas.
Turunkan bar secara perlahan kembali ke posisi awal sambil menarik napas.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang dianjurkan.
instructions_en: To begin, set the bar on the smith machine to a height that is around the middle of your thighs. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, grasp the bar using a pronated (palms forward) grip that is shoulder width apart. You may need some wrist wraps if using a significant amount of weight.
Lift the barbell up and fully extend your arms with your back straight. There should be a slight bend at the elbows. This is the starting position.

Use your side shoulders to lift the bar as you exhale. The bar should be close to the body as you move it up. Continue to lift it until it nearly touches your chin. Tip: Your elbows should drive the motion. As you lift the bar, your elbows should always be higher than your forearms. Also, keep your torso stationary and pause for a second at the top of the movement.
Lower the bar back down slowly to the starting position. Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Smith Single-Leg Split Squat
instructions: Letakkan bangku datar 2-3 kaki di belakang mesin Smith. Atur ketinggian bar, lalu posisikan diri di bawah bar dengan meletakkan bagian belakang bahu (sedikit di bawah leher) di atas bar.
Pegang bar dengan kedua tangan (telapak tangan menghadap ke depan), lepaskan kuncian rak, dan angkat bar dengan mendorong kaki sambil menegakkan torso.
Letakkan satu kaki di depan di bawah bar dan kaki lainnya ke belakang dengan punggung kaki bertumpu pada bangku. Ini adalah posisi awal.

Turunkan bar secara perlahan dengan menekuk lutut kaki depan sambil menjaga postur tetap tegak dan kepala menghadap ke depan, hingga sudut paha dan betis sedikit di bawah 90 derajat. Tarik napas saat turun. Pastikan lutut depan segaris lurus vertikal dengan jari kaki.
Dorong lantai menggunakan tumit kaki depan untuk mengangkat bar kembali ke posisi awal sambil menghembuskan napas.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang dianjurkan.
Ganti posisi kaki dan ulangi gerakan yang sama.
instructions_en: To begin, place a flat bench 2-3 feet behind the smith machine. Then, set the bar on the height that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, step under the bar and place the back of your shoulders (slightly below the neck) across it.
Hold on to the bar using both arms at each side (palms facing forward), unlock it and lift it off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.
Position your legs by placing one foot slightly forward under the bar and extending your other leg back and place the top of your foot on the bench. This will be your starting position

Begin to slowly lower the bar by bending the knee as you maintain a straight posture with the head up. Continue down until the angle between the upper leg and the calf becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below parallel to the floor). Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knee should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If your knee is past that imaginary line (if it is past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
Begin to raise the bar as you exhale by pushing the floor with the heel of your foot mainly as you straighten your leg again and go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Switch legs and repeat the movement.

name: Snatch
instructions: Buka kaki selebar bahu dengan posisi barbel tepat di atas pangkal jari kaki.

Genggam bar dengan telapak tangan menghadap ke bawah, tekuk lutut, jaga punggung tetap datar, dan gunakan pegangan yang lebih lebar dari bahu. Turunkan pinggul seperti posisi duduk di kursi. Ini adalah posisi awal.
Dorong lantai dengan kaki secara eksplosif dan angkat barbel bersamaan dengan menjaga posisinya tetap dekat dengan kaki.
Saat bar mencapai pertengahan paha, dorong lantai dengan kaki dan ekstensikan tubuh sepenuhnya dalam gerakan eksplosif.
Tarik bahu ke belakang dalam gerakan shrug (mengangkat bahu) sambil mengangkat siku ke samping dan Jaga posisi siku tetap di atas bar selama mungkin.
Dengan cepat dan bertenaga, turunkan tubuh ke bawah barbel saat posisinya sudah cukup tinggi, kunci lengan di atas kepala, dan ambil posisi squat.
Selesaikan gerakan dengan bangkit berdiri dari posisi squat. Pada akhir gerakan, kedua kaki berada dalam satu garis dan lengan lurus sepenuhnya menahan barbel di atas kepala.
instructions_en: Place your feet at a shoulder width stance with the barbell resting right above the connection between the toes and the rest of the foot.

With a palms facing down grip, bend at the knees and keeping the back flat grab the bar using a wider than shoulder width grip. Bring the hips down and make sure that your body drops as if you were going to sit on a chair. This will be your starting position.
Start pushing the floor as if it were a moving platform with your feet and simultaneously start lifting the barbell keeping it close to your legs.
As the bar reaches the middle of your thighs, push the floor with your legs and lift your body to a complete extension in an explosive motion.
Lift your shoulders back in a shrugging movement as you bring the bar up while lifting your elbows out to the side and keeping them above the bar for as long as possible.

Now in a very quick but powerful motion, you have to get your body under the barbell when it has reached a high enough point where it can be controlled and drop while locking your arms and holding the barbell overhead as you assume a squat position.
Finalize the movement by rising up out of the squat position to finish the lift. At the end of the lift both feet should be on line and the arms fully extended holding the barbell overhead.
instructions_id: Buka kaki selebar bahu dengan posisi barbel tepat di atas pangkal jari kaki.

Genggam bar dengan telapak tangan menghadap ke bawah, tekuk lutut, jaga punggung tetap datar, dan gunakan pegangan yang lebih lebar dari bahu. Turunkan pinggul seperti posisi duduk di kursi. Ini adalah posisi awal.
Dorong lantai dengan kaki secara eksplosif dan angkat barbel bersamaan dengan menjaga posisinya tetap dekat dengan kaki.
Saat bar mencapai pertengahan paha, dorong lantai dengan kaki dan ekstensikan tubuh sepenuhnya dalam gerakan eksplosif.
Tarik bahu ke belakang dalam gerakan shrug (mengangkat bahu) sambil mengangkat siku ke samping dan Jaga posisi siku tetap di atas bar selama mungkin.
Dengan cepat dan bertenaga, turunkan tubuh ke bawah barbel saat posisinya sudah cukup tinggi, kunci lengan di atas kepala, dan ambil posisi squat.
Selesaikan gerakan dengan bangkit berdiri dari posisi squat. Pada akhir gerakan, kedua kaki berada dalam satu garis dan lengan lurus sepenuhnya menahan barbel di atas kepala.

name: Snatch Balance
instructions: Mulailah dengan posisi kaki seperti saat menarik beban, bar berada di bahu belakang, dan tangan memegang bar dengan pegangan snatch yang lebar.
Lakukan celupan singkat dan dorongan eksplosif dengan lutut, lalu secara agresif turun ke bawah bar sambil memindahkan kaki ke posisi penerimaan beban.
Terima bar dalam posisi lengan terkunci lurus di atas kepala pada bagian bawah squat. Jaga torso tetap vertikal dengan pinggul turun di antara kedua kaki.
Lanjutkan turun hingga kedalaman penuh, lalu kembali ke posisi berdiri. Turunkan beban dengan hati-hati.
instructions_en: Begin with the feet in the pulling position, the bar racked across the back of the shoulders, and the hands placed in a wide snatch grip.
Pop the bar with an abrupt dip and drive of the knees, and aggressively drive under the bar, transitioning the feet into the receiving position.
Receive the bar locked out overhead near the bottom of the squat. The torso should remain vertical, lowering the hips between the legs.
Continue to descend to full depth, and return to a standing position. Carefully lower the weight.

name: Snatch Deadlift
instructions: Snatch deadlift melatih tarikan awal pada gerakan snatch. Mulai dengan pegangan snatch yang lebar dan barbel di lantai. Posisi kaki tepat di bawah pinggul dengan ujung kaki sedikit menghadap ke luar. Squat ke arah bar, jaga punggung tetap ekstensi sempurna dan kepala menghadap ke depan.
Mulai gerakan dengan mendorong melalui tumit dan mengangkat pinggul. Sudut punggung harus tetap sama hingga bar melewati lutut.
Pada titik tersebut, dorong pinggul ke depan melewati bar sambil sedikit merebahkan tubuh ke belakang. Kembalikan bar ke lantai dengan membalikkan urutan gerakan.
instructions_en: The snatch deadlift strengthens the first pull of the snatch. Begin with a wide snatch grip with the barbell placed on the platform. The feet should be directly under the hips, with the feet turned out. Squat down to the bar, keeping the back in absolute extension with the head facing forward.
Initiate the movement by driving through the heels, raising the hips. The back angle should remain the same until the bar passes the knees.
At that point, drive your hips through the bar as you lay back. Return the bar to the platform by reversing the motion.

name: Snatch Pull
instructions: Posisikan barbell di lantai dekat tulang kering, ambil pegangan snatch yang lebar. Rendahkan pinggul, tumpukan beban pada tumit, jaga punggung tetap lurus, dada membusung, kepala menghadap depan, dan bahu sedikit di depan bar.
Lakukan tarikan pertama dengan mendorong melalui tumit dan meluruskan lutut. Jaga sudut punggung tetap konstan dan lengan tetap lurus. Gerakkan beban secara terkontrol hingga melewati lutut.

Masuk ke tarikan kedua sebagai akselerasi utama. Saat bar mencapai pertengahan paha, mulailah meluruskan pinggul. Lakukan gerakan melompat dengan mengekstensikan pinggul, lutut, dan pergelangan kaki secara cepat untuk melontarkan bar ke atas.

Jangan menarik bar menggunakan lengan secara aktif. Di akhir tarikan kedua, tubuh harus tereksensi penuh dan sedikit condong ke belakang. Lakukan ekstensi dengan eksplosif dan singkat, jangan menahannya terlalu lama.
instructions_en: With a barbell on the floor close to the shins, take a wide snatch grip. Lower your hips with the weight focused on the heels, back straight, head facing forward, chest up, with your shoulders just in front of the bar. This will be your starting position.

Begin the first pull by driving through the heels, extending your knees. Your back angle should stay the same, and your arms should remain straight. Move the weight with control as you continue to above the knees.

Next comes the second pull, the main source of acceleration for the pull. As the bar approaches the mid-thigh position, begin extending through the hips. In a jumping motion, accelerate by extending the hips, knees, and ankles, using speed to move the bar upward.

There should be no need to actively pull through the arms to accelerate the weight; at the end of the second pull, the body should be fully extended, leaning slightly back. Full extension should be violent and abrupt, and ensure that you do not prolong the extension for longer than necessary.

name: Snatch Shrug
instructions: Ambil pegangan lebar dengan bar menggantung di pertengahan paha. Gunakan hook grip atau overhand grip. Pastikan punggung lurus dan condong sedikit ke depan.
Angkat bahu (shrug) ke arah telinga. Meskipun bisa menggunakan beban lebih berat daripada snatch, hindari beban berlebih yang memperlambat eksekusi gerakan.
instructions_en: Begin with a wide grip, with the bar hanging at the mid thigh position. You can use a hook or overhand grip. Your back should be straight and inclined slightly forward.
Shrug your shoulders towards your ears. While this exercise can usually by loaded with heavier weight than a snatch, avoid overloading to the point that the execution slows down.

name: Snatch from Blocks
instructions: Letakkan barbell di atas blok dengan ketinggian yang diinginkan. Gunakan pegangan lebar. Posisikan kaki selebar pinggul. Rendahkan pinggul, jaga dada membusung dan kepala menghadap depan. Bahu sedikit di depan bar dengan siku menghadap ke samping.
Mulai tarikan pertama dengan mendorong melalui tumit untuk mengangkat bar dari blok.

Transisi ke tarikan kedua dengan meluruskan pinggul, lutut, dan pergelangan kaki secepat mungkin. Jaga bar tetap dekat dengan tubuh. Di puncak ekstensi, lakukan shrug dan biarkan siku menekuk ke samping.

Sambil melangkah ke posisi penerimaan, tarik tubuh Anda dengan kuat ke bawah bar dan kunci beban di atas kepala. Posisi kaki sedikit lebih lebar dari pinggul. Terima beban di posisi squat terendah dengan lengan terkunci sempurna.
Jaga posisi bar tetap sejajar di atas tumit, kepala dan dada tegak, lalu dorong melalui tumit untuk berdiri. Kembalikan beban ke atas blok dengan hati-hati.
instructions_en: Begin with a loaded barbell on boxes or stands of the desired height. A wide grip should be taken on the bar. The feet should be directly below the hips, with the feet turned out as needed. Lower the hips, with the chest up and the head looking forward. The shoulders should be just in front of the bar, with the elbows pointed out. This will be the starting position.
Begin the first pull by driving through the front of the heels, raising the bar from the boxes.

Transition into the second pull by extending through the hips knees and ankles, driving the bar up as quickly as possible. The bar should be close to the body. At peak extension, shrug the shoulders and allow the elbows to flex to the side.

As you move your feet into the receiving position, forcefully pull yourself below the bar as you elevate the bar overhead. The feet should move to just outside the hips, turned out as necessary. Receive the bar with your body as low as possible and the arms fully extended overhead.
Keeping the bar aligned over the front of the heels, your head and chest up, drive through heels of the feet to move to a standing position. Carefully return the weight to the boxes.

name: Speed Band Overhead Triceps
instructions: Jangkar resistance band ke lantai. Anda bisa berdiri di atas band atau mengaitkannya ke dasar bangku (incline bench).
Tarik band ke belakang kepala, pegang dengan pronated grip (telapak menghadap depan) dan posisi siku menghadap ke atas.
Luruskan lengan dengan melakukan ekstensi siku, pastikan posisi lengan atas tetap diam (tidak bergerak).
Berikan jeda sejenak, lalu kembali ke posisi awal secara terkontrol.
instructions_en: For this exercise anchor a band to the ground. We used an incline bench and anchored the band to the base, standing over the bench. Alternatively, this could be performed standing on the band.
To begin, pull the band behind your head, holding it with a pronated grip and your elbows up. This will be your starting position.
To perform the movement, extend through the elbow to to straighten your arms, ensuring that you keep your upper arm in place.
Pause, and then return to the starting position.

name: Speed Box Squat
instructions: Pasang resistance band pada barbell dan jangkar dengan kuat di lantai. Atur tegangan yang memadai.
Gunakan box dengan ketinggian yang sesuai. Gunakan beban 50-70% dari 1RM agar tetap eksplosif.
Posisikan bar di punggung atas, tarik tulang belikat, lengkungkan punggung, dan kencangkan seluruh tubuh dari kepala hingga kaki.
Lepas bar dari rak, posisikan diri di depan box. Dorong pinggul ke belakang hingga duduk di atas box secara terkontrol (jangan menjatuhkan diri).
Berikan jeda singkat, lalu dorong tubuh ke atas secara eksplosif dengan meluruskan pinggul dan lutut.
instructions_en: Attach bands to the bar that are securely anchored near the ground. You may need to choke the bands to get adequate tension.

Use a box of an appropriate height for this exercise. Load the bar to a weight that still requires effort, but isn't so heavy that speed is compromised. Typically, that will be between 50-70% of your one rep max.
Position the bar on your upper back, shoulder blades retracted, back arched and everything tight head to toe. This will be the starting position.
Unrack the bar and position yourself in front of the box. Sit back with your hips until you are seated on the box, ensuring that you descend under control and don't crash onto the surface.
Pause briefly, and explode off of the box, extending through the hips and knees.

name: Speed Squats
instructions: Gunakan squat rack untuk keamanan. Atur posisi barbel sesuai tinggi badan, posisikan bagian belakang bahu (sedikit di bawah leher) di bawah barbel.
Pegang barbel dengan kedua tangan, angkat dari rak dengan mendorong kaki sambil meluruskan badan.
Mundurlah dari rak, buka kaki selebar bahu dengan ujung kaki sedikit menghadap keluar. Jaga kepala tetap menghadap ke depan dan punggung tetap lurus. Ini adalah posisi awal.

Turunkan badan dengan menekuk lutut sambil menjaga punggung tetap lurus dan kepala menghadap ke depan. Turun hingga paha berada sedikit di bawah sejajar lantai (sudut kurang dari 90 derajat). Tarik napas saat turun. Pastikan lutut tidak melewati garis vertikal jari kaki.
Dorong badan ke atas secepat mungkin tanpa menggunakan momentum, utamakan dorongan dari tumit untuk kembali ke posisi awal. Hembuskan napas saat naik.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang ditentukan.
instructions_en: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To begin, first set the bar on a rack that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, step under the bar and place the back of your shoulders (slightly below the neck) across it.
Hold on to the bar using both arms at each side and lift it off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.

Step away from the rack and position your legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Keep your head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a straight back. This will be your starting position. (Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances discussed in the foot stances section).

Begin to lower the bar by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up. Continue down until the angle between the upper leg and the calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below parallel to the floor). Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knees should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If your knees are past that imaginary line (if they are past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.

Begin to raise the bar as fast as possible without involving momentum as you exhale by pushing the floor with the heel of your foot mainly as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position. Note: You should perform these exercises as fast as possible but without breaking perfect form and without involving momentum.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Spell Caster
instructions: Pegang satu dumbbell di masing-masing tangan dengan genggaman pronasi (telapak tangan menghadap ke bawah). Buka kaki lebar dengan pinggul dan lutut lurus. Ini adalah posisi awal.
Mulai gerakan dengan menarik kedua dumbbell ke salah satu sisi pinggang sambil memutar torso.
Jaga lengan tetap lurus dan dumbbell sejajar dengan tanah, lalu putar torso ke arah sebaliknya untuk mengayunkan beban.
Lakukan secara bergantian dari satu sisi ke sisi lain hingga set selesai.
instructions_en: Hold a dumbbell in each hand with a pronated grip. Your feet should be wide with your hips and knees extended. This will be your starting position.
Begin the movement by pulling both of the dumbbells to one side next to your hip, rotating your torso.
Keeping your arms straight and the dumbbells parallel to the ground, rotate your torso to swing the weights to your opposite side.
Continue alternating, rotating from one side to the other until the set is complete.

name: Spider Crawl
instructions: Ambil posisi tengkurap di lantai. Tumpu berat badan pada tangan dan jari kaki, kaki rapat, dan tubuh lurus. Lengan ditekuk 90 derajat. Ini adalah posisi awal.
Mulai gerakan dengan mengangkat satu kaki dari lantai. Rotasikan kaki ke luar dan tarik lutut mendekati siku sejauh mungkin ke depan.
Kembalikan kaki ke posisi awal dan ulangi untuk sisi sebaliknya.
instructions_en: Begin in a prone position on the floor. Support your weight on your hands and toes, with your feet together and your body straight. Your arms should be bent to 90 degrees. This will be your starting position.
Initiate the movement by raising one foot off of the ground. Externally rotate the leg and bring the knee toward your elbow, as far forward as possible.
Return this leg to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side.

name: Spider Curl
instructions: Letakkan barbel pada bagian sandaran lengan preacher bench secara seimbang agar tidak jatuh.
Posisikan diri di bagian depan preacher bench dengan kemiringan 45 derajat, dada dan perut menempel pada bantalan.
Posisikan kaki dengan kokoh di lantai, lalu letakkan lengan atas di atas bantalan preacher bench.
Pegang barbel dengan genggaman supinasi (telapak tangan menghadap ke atas) selebar bahu atau sedikit lebih rapat.
Angkat barbel secara perlahan sambil menghembuskan napas. Tahan posisi kontraksi sejenak sambil meremas otot biseps.
Turunkan kembali barbel secara perlahan ke posisi awal sambil menarik napas.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang ditentukan.
instructions_en: Start out by setting the bar on the part of the preacher bench that you would normally sit on. Make sure to align the barbell properly so that it is balanced and will not fall off.

Move to the front side of the preacher bench (the part where the arms usually lay) and position yourself to lay at a 45 degree slant with your torso and stomach pressed against the front side of the preacher bench.
Make sure that your feet (especially the toes) are well positioned on the floor and place your upper arms on top of the pad located on the inside part of the preacher bench.
Use your arms to grab the barbell with a supinated grip (palms facing up) at about shoulder width apart or slightly closer from each other.
Slowly begin to lift the barbell upwards and exhale. Hold the contracted position for a second as you squeeze the biceps.
Slowly begin to bring the barbell back to the starting position as your breathe in. .
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Spinal Stretch
instructions: Duduk di kursi dengan punggung tegak dan kedua kaki menapak rata di lantai.
Jalin jari-jari tangan di belakang kepala, siku mengarah ke samping, dan dagu sedikit menunduk.
Putar tubuh bagian atas ke salah satu sisi semaksimal mungkin sebanyak 3 kali. Kemudian condongkan badan ke depan dan putar torso hingga siku mendekati lantai di sisi dalam lutut.
Kembali ke posisi tegak, lalu ulangi gerakan untuk sisi sebaliknya.
instructions_en: Sit in a chair so your back is straight and your feet planted on the floor.
Interlace your fingers behind your head, elbows out and your chin down.
Twist your upper body to one side about 3 times as far as you can. Then lean forward and twist your torso to reach your elbow to the floor on the inside of your knee.
Return to upright position and then repeat for your other side.

name: Split Clean
instructions: Posisikan barbell di lantai dekat tulang kering, genggam dengan posisi telapak tangan menghadap ke bawah sedikit di luar lebar bahu. Rendahkan pinggul, tumpukan beban pada tumit, punggung tegak, dada membusung, dan bahu sedikit di depan barbell.
Awali tarikan pertama dengan mendorong lantai melalui tumit dan meluruskan lutut. Jaga sudut punggung tetap konstan dan lengan tetap lurus saat barbell melewati lutut.

Lakukan tarikan kedua untuk akselerasi. Saat barbell di pertengahan paha, dorong pinggul ke depan dengan cepat. Lakukan gerakan melompat dengan mengekstensikan pinggul, lutut, dan pergelangan kaki untuk melontarkan barbell ke atas.
Segera lakukan tarikan ketiga dengan menarik bahu ke atas (shrug) dan menekuk siku ke luar. Tarik tubuh Anda ke bawah barbell dengan cepat sambil memutar siku ke bawah posisi barbell.

Terima barbell dengan posisi kaki melangkah (split), satu kaki di depan dan satu di belakang. Barbell harus bertumpu pada bahu yang menonjol ke depan, sedikit menyentuh tenggorokan. Turunkan tubuh hingga posisi squat.
Bangkit segera dengan mendorong melalui tumit, jaga dada tegak dan siku tinggi, lalu rapatkan kaki hingga berdiri tegak.
instructions_en: With a barbell on the floor close to the shins, take an overhand grip just outside the legs. Lower your hips with the weight focused on the heels, back straight, head facing forward, chest up, with your shoulders just in front of the bar. This will be your starting position.

Begin the first pull by driving through the heels, extending your knees. Your back angle should stay the same, and your arms should remain straight. Move the weight with control as you continue to above the knees.

Next comes the second pull, the main source of acceleration for the clean. As the bar approaches the mid-thigh position, begin extending through the hips. In a jumping motion, accelerate by extending the hips, knees, and ankles, using speed to move the bar upward. There should be no need to actively pull through the arms to accelerate the weight; at the end of the second pull, the body should be fully extended, leaning slightly back, with the arms still extended.

As full extension is achieved, transition into the third pull by aggressively shrugging and flexing the arms with the elbows up and out. At peak extension, aggressively pull yourself down, rotating your elbows under the bar as you do so.

Receive the bar with the feet split, aggressively moving one foot forward and one foot back. The bar should be racked onto the protracted shoulders, lightly touching the throat with the hands relaxed. Continue to descend to the bottom position, which will help in the recovery.
Immediately recover by driving through the heels, keeping the torso upright and elbows up. Bring the feet together as you stand up.

name: Split Jerk
instructions: Posisikan barbell di depan bahu, kaki selebar pinggul. Lakukan sedikit tekukan pada lutut tanpa menggeser pinggul ke belakang.
Turun sedikit saja, lalu dorong ke atas sekuat tenaga melalui tumit. Saat barbell lepas dari bahu, pindahkan kepala dan posisikan kaki ke posisi split dengan cepat.

Saat kaki berada di udara, gunakan dorongan barbell ke atas untuk menekan tubuh Anda ke bawah. Mendaratlah dengan satu kaki di depan dan satu di belakang, lutut sedikit ditekuk, dan lengan terkunci lurus di atas kepala.
Kembali ke posisi berdiri dengan merapatkan kedua kaki.
instructions_en: Standing with the weight racked on the front of the shoulders, begin with the dip. With your feet directly under your hips, flex the knees without moving the hips backward.

Go down only slightly, and reverse direction as powerfully as possible. Drive through the heels create as much speed and force as possible, and be sure to move your head out of the way as the bar leaves the shoulders. At this moment as the feet leave the floor, the feet must be placed into the receiving position as quickly as possible.

In the brief moment the feet are not actively driving against the platform, the athlete's effort to push the bar up will drive them down. The feet should be moved to a split stance, one foot forward, one foot back, with the knees partially bent. Receive the bar with the arms locked out overhead.
Return to a standing position, bringing the feet together.

name: Split Jump
instructions: Ambil posisi lunge, satu kaki di depan dengan lutut ditekuk, lutut belakang hampir menyentuh lantai.
Pastikan lutut depan sejajar dengan bagian tengah kaki.
Lompat setinggi mungkin dengan meluruskan kedua kaki, ayunkan lengan untuk membantu daya angkat.
Saat melompat, rapatkan kaki dan kembalikan ke posisi awal saat mendarat.
Redam benturan dengan kembali ke posisi awal secara terkontrol.
instructions_en: Assume a lunge stance position with one foot forward with the knee bent, and the rear knee nearly touching the ground.
Ensure that the front knee is over the midline of the foot.
Extending through both legs, jump as high as possible, swinging your arms to gain lift.
As you jump, bring your feet together, and move them back to their initial positions as you land.
Absorb the impact by reverting back to the starting position.

name: Split Snatch
instructions: Posisikan barbell di lantai dekat tulang kering dengan genggaman lebar. Kaki selebar pinggul, pinggul rendah, dada tegak, dan bahu sedikit di depan barbell.
Awali tarikan pertama dengan mendorong melalui tumit hingga barbell melewati lutut. Jaga sudut punggung tetap konstan.

Lakukan tarikan kedua dengan mengekstensikan pinggul, lutut, dan pergelangan kaki secara eksplosif. Pastikan barbell tetap dekat dengan tubuh. Di puncak ekstensi, angkat bahu (shrug) dan tekuk siku ke samping.
Saat melompat ke posisi split (satu kaki di depan, satu di belakang), tarik tubuh Anda dengan kuat ke bawah barbell sambil mendorong barbell hingga terkunci lurus di atas kepala.
Jaga barbell tetap di atas tumit, dada tegak, lalu dorong melalui tumit untuk berdiri dan rapatkan kaki.
Kembalikan beban ke lantai dengan hati-hati.
instructions_en: Begin with a loaded barbell on the floor. The bar should be close to or touching the shins, and a wide grip should be taken on the bar. The feet should be directly below the hips, with the feet turned out as needed. Lower the hips, with the chest up and the head looking forward. The shoulders should be just in front of the bar. This will be the starting position.
Begin the first pull by driving through the front of the heels, raising the bar from the ground. The back angle should stay the same until the bar passes the knees.

Transition into the second pull by extending through the hips knees and ankles, driving the bar up as quickly as possible. The bar should be close to the body. At peak extension, shrug the shoulders and allow the elbows to flex to the side.

As you move your feet into the receiving position, forcefully pull yourself below the bar as you elevate the bar overhead. The feet should move forcefully to a split position, one foot forward one foot back. Receive the bar with your body as low as possible and the arms fully extended overhead.
Keeping the bar aligned over the front of the heels, your head and chest up, drive through heels of the feet to move to a standing position, bringing your feet together.
Carefully return the weight to floor.

name: Split Squat with Dumbbells
instructions: Ambil posisi melangkah dengan kaki belakang diletakkan di atas tumpuan dan kaki depan menapak di lantai.
Pegang dumbbell di masing-masing tangan dengan posisi lengan tergantung di samping tubuh.
Turunkan tubuh dengan menekuk lutut dan pinggul depan. Jaga postur tetap tegak dan pastikan lutut depan tetap sejajar dengan kaki.
Dorong melalui tumit kaki depan untuk meluruskan lutut dan pinggul hingga kembali ke posisi berdiri.
instructions_en: Position yourself into a staggered stance with the rear foot elevated and front foot forward.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, letting them hang at the sides. This will be your starting position.
Begin by descending, flexing your knee and hip to lower your body down. Maintain good posture througout the movement. Keep the front knee in line with the foot as you perform the exercise.
At the bottom of the movement, drive through the heel to extend the knee and hip to return to the starting position.

name: Split Squats
instructions: Berdiri tegak, lalu melompatlah ke posisi split dengan satu kaki di depan dan satu kaki di belakang. Tekuk lutut dan turunkan pinggul secara perlahan.
Saat turun, segera balikkan arah gerakan untuk berdiri kembali sambil melompat dan bertukar posisi kaki. Ulangi 5-10 kali pada setiap kaki.
instructions_en: Being in a standing position. Jump into a split leg position, with one leg forward and one leg back, flexing the knees and lowering your hips slightly as you do so.
As you descend, immediately reverse direction, standing back up and jumping, reversing the position of your legs. Repeat 5-10 times on each leg.

name: Squat Jerk
instructions: Berdirilah dengan beban di bagian depan bahu. Mulailah dengan posisi turun (dip); posisikan kaki sejajar pinggul, tekuk lutut tanpa menggeser pinggul ke belakang. Turun sedikit saja, lalu bangkit dengan sekuat tenaga menggunakan dorongan tumit untuk menciptakan kecepatan dan tenaga maksimum. Pastikan kepala Anda menghindari jalur barbel saat terangkat dari bahu.

Saat kaki terangkat dari lantai, segera posisikan kaki ke posisi penerimaan beban secepat mungkin. Dorongan ke atas pada barbel secara otomatis akan menekan tubuh Anda ke bawah. Buka kaki sedikit lebih lebar dari pinggul dengan ujung kaki sedikit menghadap keluar. Tangkap barbel dalam posisi squat penuh dengan lengan lurus sepenuhnya di atas kepala.
Jaga agar barbel tetap sejajar di atas bagian depan tumit, kepala dan dada tegap, lalu dorong tubuh ke atas melalui tumit untuk kembali berdiri. Kembalikan beban ke lantai secara hati-hati.
instructions_en: Standing with the weight racked on the front of the shoulders, begin with the dip. With your feet directly under your hips, flex the knees without moving the hips backward. Go down only slightly, and reverse direction as powerfully as possible. Drive through the heels create as much speed and force as possible, and be sure to move your head out of the way as the bar leaves the shoulders.

At this moment as the feet leave the floor, the feet must be placed into the receiving position as quickly as possible. In the brief moment the feet are not actively driving against the platform, the athlete's effort to push the bar up will drive them down. The feet should move forcefully to just outside the hips, turned out as necessary. Receive the bar with your body in a full squat and the arms fully extended overhead.
Keeping the bar aligned over the front of the heels, your head and chest up, drive throught heels of the feet to move to a standing position. Carefully return the weight to floor.

name: Squat with Bands
instructions: Pasang resistance band pada sleeve barbel dan amankan pada pasak band, rack, atau dumbbell hingga ketegangannya pas.

Masuk ke bawah barbel dan posisikan di atas bahu belakang. Rapatkan belikat dan putar siku ke depan seolah ingin membengkokkan barbel. Angkat barbel dari rack dengan melengkungkan punggung bawah secara kencang, lalu mundur ke posisi latihan. Buka kaki lebih lebar untuk lebih memfokuskan latihan pada punggung, glutes, aduktor, dan hamstring. Jaga pandangan tetap ke depan.

Dengan punggung, bahu, dan core yang kencang, dorong lutut dan bokong ke luar saat mulai turun. Dorong pinggul ke belakang sejauh mungkin. Idealnya, tulang kering harus tegak lurus dengan lantai. Posisi barbel yang lebih rendah menuntut condongnya torso yang lebih besar agar beban tetap di atas tumit. Turun sampai melewati posisi parallel (lipatan pinggul sejajar dengan atas lutut).

Pertahankan berat badan di tumit serta dorong kaki dan lutut ke luar, lalu dorong tubuh ke atas dengan kepala memimpin gerakan. Terus naik sambil menjaga kekencangan seluruh tubuh dari ujung kepala hingga ujung kaki hingga kembali ke posisi awal.
instructions_en: Set up the bands on the sleeves, secured to either band pegs, the rack, or dumbbells so that there is appropriate tension.

Begin by stepping under the bar and placing it across the back of the shoulders. Squeeze your shoulder blades together and rotate your elbows forward, attempting to bend the bar across your shoulders. Remove the bar from the rack, creating a tight arch in your lower back, and step back into position. Place your feet wide for more emphasis on the back, glutes, adductors, and hamstrings. Keep your head facing forward.

With your back, shoulders, and core tight, push your knees and butt out and you begin your descent. Sit back with your hips as much as possible. Ideally, your shins should be perpendicular to the ground. Lower bar position necessitates a greater torso lean to keep the bar over the heels. Continue until you break parallel, which is defined as the crease of the hip being in line with the top of the knee.

Keeping the weight on your heels and pushing your feet and knees out, drive upward as you lead the movement with your head. Continue upward, maintaining tightness head to toe, until you have returned to the starting position.

name: Squat with Plate Movers
instructions: Letakkan barbel pada rack sedikit di bawah tingkat bahu. Letakkan piringan beban di lantai sekitar dua kaki di belakang rack. Setelah barbel diberi beban, masuk ke bawahnya dan posisikan bahu belakang di bawah barbel.
Pegang barbel dengan kedua tangan dan angkat dari rack dengan mendorong kaki sambil meluruskan torso secara bersamaan.
Mundurlah dari rack, ambil posisi kaki lebar dengan ujung kaki sedikit menghadap keluar, dan letakkan satu kaki di atas piringan beban. Jaga kepala tetap terangkat. Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.
Turunkan barbel secara perlahan dengan menekuk lutut dan pinggul. Lanjutkan ke bawah hingga sudut antara paha atas dan betis sedikit kurang dari 90 derajat.
Angkat barbel sambil menghembuskan napas dengan mendorong lantai menggunakan tumit kaki, lalu luruskan pinggul dan lutut.
Pada puncak gerakan, langkahkan kaki ke samping untuk merapatkan kaki di sisi seberang piringan beban.
Gunakan kaki bagian dalam untuk mendorong piringan beban, geser melintasi lantai ke tempat Anda baru saja berdiri.
Letakkan kaki bagian dalam pada piringan beban, lalu ambil posisi kaki lebar untuk pengulangan berikutnya.
instructions_en: To begin, first set the bar on a rack to just below shoulder level. Position a weight plate on the ground a couple feet back from the rack. Once the bar is loaded, step under it and place the back of your shoulders across it.
Hold on to the bar with both hands and lift it off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straighten your torso.
Step away from the rack and adopt a wide stance with the toes slightly pointed out, with one foot on the weight plate. Keep your head up at all times. This will be your starting position.
Begin to slowly lower the bar by bending the knees and hips. Continue down until the angle between the upper leg and the calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees.
Raise the bar as you exhale by pushing the floor with the heels of your feet as you extend the hips and knees.
At the top of the movement, side step, bringing your feet together on the opposite side of the plate.
Using your inside foot, push the weight plate, sliding it across the floor to where you were just standing.
Place your inside foot on the weight plate, adopting a wide stance for the next repetition.
instructions_id: Letakkan barbel pada rack sedikit di bawah tingkat bahu. Letakkan piringan beban di lantai sekitar dua kaki di belakang rack. Setelah barbel diberi beban, masuk ke bawahnya dan posisikan bahu belakang di bawah barbel.
Pegang barbel dengan kedua tangan dan angkat dari rack dengan mendorong kaki sambil meluruskan torso secara bersamaan.
Mundurlah dari rack, ambil posisi kaki lebar dengan ujung kaki sedikit menghadap keluar, dan letakkan satu kaki di atas piringan beban. Jaga kepala tetap terangkat. Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.
Turunkan barbel secara perlahan dengan menekuk lutut dan pinggul. Lanjutkan ke bawah hingga sudut antara paha atas dan betis sedikit kurang dari 90 derajat.
Angkat barbel sambil menghembuskan napas dengan mendorong lantai menggunakan tumit kaki, lalu luruskan pinggul dan lutut.
Pada puncak gerakan, langkahkan kaki ke samping untuk merapatkan kaki di sisi seberang piringan beban.
Gunakan kaki bagian dalam untuk mendorong piringan beban, geser melintasi lantai ke tempat Anda baru saja berdiri.
Letakkan kaki bagian dalam pada piringan beban, lalu ambil posisi kaki lebar untuk pengulangan berikutnya.

name: Squats - With Bands
instructions: Posisikan resistance band tepat di tengah kedua kaki. Berdirilah dengan kaki terbuka selebar bahu.
Genggam kedua ujung band dengan telapak tangan menghadap ke depan (pronated grip). Posisikan handle di dekat wajah. Ini posisi awal Anda.
Sambil membuang napas, turunkan tubuh dengan menekuk lutut hingga paha sejajar dengan lantai.
Dorong tubuh kembali ke posisi awal menggunakan tumpuan tumit sambil menarik napas.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang dianjurkan.
instructions_en: To start out, make sure that the exercise band is at an even split between both the left and right side of the body. To do this, use your hands to grab both sides of the band and place both feet in the middle of the band. Your feet should be shoulder width apart from each other.

When holding the bands, they should be the same height on each side. You should be using a pronated grip (palms facing forward) and have the handles of the bands next to your face for this exercise. This is the starting position.
Slowly start to bend the knees and lower the legs so that your thighs are parallel to the floor while exhaling.
Use the heel of your feet to push your body up to the starting position as you exhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Stairmaster
instructions: Naik ke atas mesin Stairmaster dan pilih opsi latihan pada menu. Anda bisa mengatur secara manual atau memilih program yang tersedia, serta memasukkan usia dan berat badan untuk estimasi kalori.
Gerakkan kaki naik turun secara berirama, tekan pedal ke bawah tanpa menyentuh lantai. Pegang handle untuk menjaga keseimbangan dan memantau detak jantung guna memastikan intensitas yang tepat.
Stairmaster efektif untuk latihan kardiovaskular dengan dampak sendi yang lebih rendah daripada lari, namun memiliki tingkat kesulitan yang lebih tinggi dibanding peralatan kardio lainnya.
instructions_en: To begin, step onto the stairmaster and select the desired option from the menu. You can choose a manual setting, or you can select a program to run. Typically, you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned during exercise.

Pump your legs up and down in an established rhythm, driving the pedals down but not all the way to the floor. It is recommended that you maintain your grip on the handles so that you don't fall. The handles can be used to monitor your heart rate to help you stay at an appropriate intensity.

Stairmasters offer convenience, cardiovascular benefits, and usually have less impact than running outside. They are typically much harder than other cardio equipment. A 150 lb person will typically burn over 300 calories in 30 minutes, compared to about 175 calories walking.

name: Standing Alternating Dumbbell Press
instructions: Berdiri tegak dengan memegang dumbbell di setiap tangan. Angkat ke bahu dengan telapak tangan menghadap ke depan dan siku mengarah ke samping. Ini posisi awal Anda.
Dorong satu dumbbell lurus ke atas tanpa menggerakkan tangan lainnya. Hindari mengayunkan tubuh atau menyentakkan beban.
Tahan sejenak, lalu turunkan kembali ke posisi awal.
Ulangi gerakan pada sisi lainnya secara bergantian.
instructions_en: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand. Raise the dumbbells to your shoulders with your palms facing forward and your elbows pointed out. This will be your starting position.
Extend one arm to press the dumbbell straight up, keeping your off hand in place. Do not lean or jerk the weight during the movement.
After a brief pause, return the weight to the starting position.
Repeat for the opposite side, continuing to alternate between arms.

name: Standing Barbell Calf Raise
instructions: Gunakan squat rack demi keamanan. Atur ketinggian bar sesuai, letakkan bar di punggung atas (di bawah leher).
Genggam bar dengan kedua tangan, angkat bar dari rack dengan dorongan kaki dan posisi tubuh tegak.
Berdiri dengan kaki selebar bahu dan jari kaki sedikit terbuka. Jaga kepala tetap tegak, punggung lurus, dan lutut sedikit menekuk (jangan dikunci).
Buang napas, jinjit setinggi mungkin dengan memfokuskan kontraksi pada otot betis. Jaga lutut tetap diam dan tidak menekuk.
Tahan kontraksi selama satu detik, lalu tarik napas sambil menurunkan tumit perlahan hingga betis terasa meregang.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang dianjurkan.
instructions_en: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To begin, first set the bar on a rack that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, step under the bar and place the bar on the back of your shoulders (slightly below the neck).
Hold on to the bar using both arms at each side and lift it off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.

Step away from the rack and position your legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Keep your head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a straight back. The knees should be kept with a slight bend; never locked. This will be your starting position. Tip: For better range of motion you may also place the ball of your feet on a wooden block but be careful as this option requires more balance and a sturdy block.

Raise your heels as you breathe out by extending your ankles as high as possible and flexing your calf. Ensure that the knee is kept stationary at all times. There should be no bending at any time. Hold the contracted position by a second before you start to go back down.
Go back slowly to the starting position as you breathe in by lowering your heels as you bend the ankles until calves are stretched.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Standing Barbell Press Behind Neck
instructions: Gunakan squat rack untuk memudahkan pengambilan bar. Letakkan bar di punggung atas (di bawah leher).
Genggam bar dengan kedua tangan, angkat bar dari rack dengan dorongan kaki dan posisi tubuh tegak.
Berdiri dengan kaki selebar bahu, jari kaki sedikit terbuka, dan jaga punggung tetap lurus. Ini posisi awal Anda.
Buang napas, angkat barbell lurus ke atas hingga lengan terentang penuh.
Tahan selama satu detik, lalu tarik napas sambil menurunkan kembali barbell ke posisi awal.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang dianjurkan.
instructions_en: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for easier pick up of the bar. To begin, first set the bar on a rack that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, step under the bar and place the back of your shoulders (slightly below the neck) across it.
Hold on to the bar using both arms at each side and lift it off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.

Step away from the rack and position your legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Your back should be kept straight while performing this exercise. This will be your starting position.
Elevate the barbell overhead by fully extending your arms while breathing out.
Hold the contraction for a second and lower the barbell back down to the starting position by inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Standing Bent-Over One-Arm Dumbbell Triceps Extension
instructions: Pegang dumbbell dengan satu tangan dan telapak tangan menghadap ke arah tubuh, tekuk lutut sedikit dan condongkan tubuh ke depan dari pinggang dengan punggung tetap lurus hingga hampir sejajar dengan lantai. Jaga kepala tetap terangkat.

Posisikan lengan atas dekat dengan tubuh dan sejajar dengan lantai, sementara lengan bawah mengarah ke bawah. Tips: Bentuk sudut 90 derajat antara lengan bawah dan lengan atas. Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.
Jaga lengan atas tetap diam, gunakan otot trisep untuk mengangkat beban sambil mengembuskan napas hingga lengan bawah sejajar dengan lantai dan seluruh lengan lurus. Hanya lengan bawah yang bergerak.
Setelah menahan kontraksi di atas selama satu detik, perlahan turunkan kembali dumbbell ke posisi awal sambil menarik napas.
Ulangi gerakan ini sesuai jumlah repetisi yang ditentukan.
Ganti sisi lengan dan ulangi latihan.
instructions_en: With a dumbbell in one hand and the palm facing your torso, bend your knees slightly and bring your torso forward, by bending at the waist, while keeping the back straight until it is almost parallel to the floor. Make sure that you keep the head up.

The upper arm should be close to the torso and parallel to the floor while the forearm is pointing towards the floor as the hand holds the weight. Tip: There should be a 90-degree angle between the forearm and the upper arm. This is your starting position.

Keeping the upper arms stationary, use the triceps to lift the weights as you exhale until the forearms are parallel to the floor and the whole arm is extended. Like many other arm exercises, only the forearm moves.
After a second contraction at the top, slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
Switch arms and repeat the exercise.

name: Standing Biceps Cable Curl
instructions: Berdirilah tegak sambil memegang stbar cable curl yang terhubung ke katrol bawah. Ganti pegangan selebar bahu dan jaga siku tetap dekat dengan tubuh. Telapak tangan menghadap ke atas (supinasi). Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.

Jaga lengan atas tetap diam, angkat beban sambil mengontraksikan bisep dan embuskan napas. Hanya lengan bawah yang bergerak. Lanjutkan gerakan hingga bisep berkontraksi penuh dan bar berada di depan dada atau tingkat bahu. Tahan posisi kontraksi sejenak sambil meremas otot.
Perlahan kembalikan bar ke posisi awal sambil menarik napas.
Ulangi sesuai jumlah repetisi yang dianjurkan.
instructions_en: Stand up with your torso upright while holding a cable curl bar that is attached to a low pulley. Grab the cable bar at shoulder width and keep the elbows close to the torso. The palm of your hands should be facing up (supinated grip). This will be your starting position.

While holding the upper arms stationary, curl the weights while contracting the biceps as you breathe out. Only the forearms should move. Continue the movement until your biceps are fully contracted and the bar is at shoulder level. Hold the contracted position for a second as you squeeze the muscle.
Slowly begin to bring the curl bar back to starting position as your breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Standing Biceps Stretch
instructions: Jalin jari-jari tangan Anda di belakang punggung dengan telapak tangan saling merapat, luruskan lengan lalu putar hingga telapak tangan menghadap ke bawah.
Angkat lengan ke atas dan tahan hingga Anda merasakan peregangan pada otot bisep.
instructions_en: Clasp your hands behind your back with your palms together, straighten arms and then rotate them so your palms face downward.
Raise your arms up and hold until you feel a stretch in your biceps.

name: Standing Bradford Press
instructions: Letakkan barbel pada posisi rak setinggi bahu. Dengan genggaman overhand (pronasi) selebar bahu, mulailah dengan posisi bar berada di depan bahu Anda. Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.
Mulai angkatan dengan meluruskan siku untuk mendorong bar ke atas kepala. Hindari mengunci siku sepenuhnya saat Anda memindahkan beban ke belakang kepala.
Turunkan bar ke bagian belakang kepala hingga siku membentuk sudut siku-siku.
Angkat kembali bar melewati atas kepala dengan meluruskan siku.
Turunkan bar kembali ke posisi awal di depan.
Lakukan secara bergantian hingga Anda menyelesaikan jumlah repetisi yang dianjurkan.
instructions_en: Place a loaded bar at shoulder level in a rack. With a pronated grip at shoulder width, begin with the bar racked across the front of your shoulders. This is your starting position.
Initiate the lift by extending the elbows to press the bar overhead. Avoid locking out the elbow as you move the weight behind your head.
Lower the bar down to the back of the head until your elbow forms a right angle.
Lift the bar back over your head by extending the elbows
Lower the bar down to the starting position.
Alternate in this manner until you complete the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Standing Cable Chest Press
instructions: Atur kedua katrol setinggi dada dan pilih beban yang sesuai. Berdirilah satu atau dua langkah di depan kabel, pegang masing-masing handle di kedua tangan. Anda bisa menggunakan posisi kaki melangkah (staggered stance) untuk stabilitas lebih baik.
Posisikan lengan atas membentuk sudut 90 derajat dengan tulang belikat dirapatkan. Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.
Jaga tubuh tetap diam, dorong handle ke depan dengan meluruskan siku hingga kedua tangan bertemu di depan dada.
Tahan sejenak di puncak gerakan, lalu kembali ke posisi awal secara perlahan.
instructions_en: Position dual pulleys to chest height and select an appropriate weight. Stand a foot or two in front of the cables, holding one in each hand. You can stagger your stance for better stability.
Position the upper arm at a 90 degree angle with the shoulder blades together. This will be your starting position.
Keeping the rest of the body stationary, extend through the elbows to press the handles forward, drawing them together in front of you.
Pause at the top of the motion, and return to the starting position.

name: Standing Cable Lift
instructions: Pasang handle standar pada mesin kabel dan atur katrol ke posisi terendah.
Berdirilah menyamping ke arah mesin, pegang handle dengan satu tangan dan menjauhlah dari mesin hingga lengan lurus dan kabel dalam kondisi tegang.
Buka kaki selebar bahu, jongkok sedikit, lalu pegang handle dengan kedua tangan. Jaga lengan tetap lurus.
Dalam satu gerakan halus, tarik handle ke atas menyilang tubuh hingga lengan terentang penuh di atas kepala.
Jaga punggung tetap tegak dan lengan tetap dekat dengan tubuh. Putar kaki belakang dan luruskan kaki untuk mendapatkan rentang gerak penuh.
Kembali ke posisi awal secara terkontrol, mulai dengan menurunkan lengan lalu posisi tubuh.
Ulangi gerakan hingga mencapai kegagalan otot.
Ubah posisi dan ulangi rangkaian gerakan yang sama pada sisi sebaliknya.
instructions_en: Connect a standard handle on a tower, and move the cable to the lowest pulley position.

With your side to the cable, grab the handle with one hand and step away from the tower. You should be approximately arm's length away from the pulley, with the tension of the weight on the cable. Your outstretched arm should be aligned with the cable.
With your feet positioned shoulder width apart, squat down and grab the handle with both hands. Your arms should still be fully extended.
In one motion, pull the handle up and across your body until your arms are in a fully-extended position above your head.
Keep your back straight and your arms close to your body as you pivot your back foot and straighten your legs to get a full range of motion.
Retract your arms and then your body. Return to the neutral position in a slow and controlled manner.
Repeat to failure.
Then, reposition and repeat the same series of movements on the opposite side.

name: Standing Cable Wood Chop
instructions: Pasang handle standar pada mesin kabel dan atur katrol ke posisi tertinggi.
Berdirilah menyamping ke arah mesin, pegang handle dengan satu tangan dan menjauhlah hingga lengan lurus dan kabel tegang.
Buka kaki selebar bahu, raih handle dengan tangan lainnya sehingga kedua tangan menggenggam handle dengan posisi lengan lurus.
Tarik handle ke bawah menyilang tubuh ke arah lutut depan sambil memutar torso (batang tubuh).
Jaga punggung dan lengan tetap lurus serta otot inti kencang. Putar kaki belakang dan tekuk lutut untuk mendapatkan rentang gerak penuh.
Pertahankan posisi berdiri dan lengan tetap lurus. Kembali ke posisi awal secara perlahan dan terkontrol.
Ulangi gerakan hingga mencapai kegagalan otot.
Ubah posisi dan ulangi rangkaian gerakan yang sama pada sisi sebaliknya.
instructions_en: Connect a standard handle to a tower, and move the cable to the highest pulley position.

With your side to the cable, grab the handle with one hand and step away from the tower. You should be approximately arm's length away from the pulley, with the tension of the weight on the cable. Your outstretched arm should be aligned with the cable.
With your feet positioned shoulder width apart, reach upward with your other hand and grab the handle with both hands. Your arms should still be fully extended.
In one motion, pull the handle down and across your body to your front knee while rotating your torso.
Keep your back and arms straight and core tight while you pivot your back foot and bend your knees to get a full range of motion.
Maintain your stance and straight arms. Return to the neutral position in a slow and controlled manner.
Repeat to failure.
Then, reposition and repeat the same series of movements on the opposite side.

name: Standing Calf Raises
instructions: Sesuaikan bantalan tuas mesin calf raise dengan tinggi badan Anda.

Posisikan bahu di bawah bantalan. Letakkan bagian depan telapak kaki di atas balok, dengan tumit menggantung di luar. Dorong tuas ke atas hingga tubuh tegak. Jaga lutut tetap sedikit menekuk (jangan dikunci). Ini adalah posisi awal.

Buang napas, angkat tumit setinggi mungkin dengan melakukan dorongan pada pergelangan kaki hingga otot betis berkontraksi. Jaga lutut tetap diam dan tidak menekuk. Tahan posisi puncak selama satu detik.
Tarik napas, turunkan tumit perlahan hingga otot betis terasa meregang.
Ulangi untuk jumlah repetisi yang disarankan.
instructions_en: Adjust the padded lever of the calf raise machine to fit your height.

Place your shoulders under the pads provided and position your toes facing forward (or using any of the two other positions described at the beginning of the chapter). The balls of your feet should be secured on top of the calf block with the heels extending off it. Push the lever up by extending your hips and knees until your torso is standing erect. The knees should be kept with a slight bend; never locked. Toes should be facing forward, outwards or inwards as described at the beginning of the chapter. This will be your starting position.

Raise your heels as you breathe out by extending your ankles as high as possible and flexing your calf. Ensure that the knee is kept stationary at all times. There should be no bending at any time. Hold the contracted position by a second before you start to go back down.
Go back slowly to the starting position as you breathe in by lowering your heels as you bend the ankles until calves are stretched.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Standing Concentration Curl
instructions: Pegang dumbbell, condongkan tubuh ke depan. Biarkan lengan yang bekerja menggantung tegak lurus ke lantai dengan siku menghadap ke luar. Ini adalah posisi awal.
Tekuk siku untuk mengangkat beban, pastikan lengan atas tetap diam. Di puncak gerakan, kontraksikan otot bisep dan tahan sejenak.
Turunkan dumbbell kembali ke posisi awal.
Ulangi gerakan untuk jumlah repetisi yang ditentukan.
instructions_en: Taking a dumbbell in your working hand, lean forward. Allow your working arm to hang perpendicular to the ground with the elbow pointing out. This will be your starting position.
Flex the elbow to curl the weight, keeping the upper arm stationary. At the top of the repetition, flex the biceps and pause.
Lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.

name: Standing Dumbbell Calf Raise
instructions: Berdiri tegak dengan memegang dumbbell di kedua sisi tubuh. Letakkan bagian depan telapak kaki di atas balok kayu yang stabil (tinggi sekitar 5-7 cm) dengan tumit menggantung menyentuh lantai. Ini posisi awal Anda.

Arahkan jari kaki lurus, ke dalam (untuk fokus sisi luar betis), atau ke luar (untuk fokus sisi dalam). Hembuskan napas lalu angkat tumit setinggi mungkin dengan kontraksi otot betis. Tahan selama 1 detik di atas.
Tarik napas sambil turunkan kembali tumit secara perlahan ke posisi awal.
Ulangi sesuai jumlah repetisi yang ditentukan.
instructions_en: Stand with your torso upright holding two dumbbells in your hands by your sides. Place the ball of the foot on a sturdy and stable wooden board (that is around 2-3 inches tall) while your heels extend off and touch the floor. This will be your starting position.

With the toes pointing either straight (to hit all parts equally), inwards (for emphasis on the outer head) or outwards (for emphasis on the inner head), raise the heels off the floor as you exhale by contracting the calves. Hold the top contraction for a second.
As you inhale, go back to the starting position by slowly lowering the heels.
Repeat for the recommended amount of times.

name: Standing Dumbbell Press
instructions: Berdiri dengan kaki dibuka selebar bahu, pegang satu dumbbell di masing-masing tangan. Angkat dumbbell setinggi kepala dengan siku menekuk sekitar 90 derajat. Ini posisi awal Anda.
Jaga postur tetap baik tanpa bantuan dorongan kaki atau condong ke belakang, dorong beban ke atas kepala hingga lengan lurus.
Tahan sejenak, lalu turunkan kembali beban secara perlahan ke posisi awal.
instructions_en: Standing with your feet shoulder width apart, take a dumbbell in each hand. Raise the dumbbells to head height, the elbows out and about 90 degrees. This will be your starting position.
Maintaining strict technique with no leg drive or leaning back, extend through the elbow to raise the weights together directly above your head.
Pause, and slowly return the weight to the starting position.

name: Standing Dumbbell Reverse Curl
instructions: Berdiri tegak dengan kaki dibuka selebar bahu dan pegang dumbbell menggunakanoverhand grip (telapak tangan menghadap ke bawah). Lengan lurus di samping badan sebagai posisi awal.
Jaga lengan atas tetap diam, hembuskan napas lalu angkat beban dengan mengontraksikan otot bisep dan lengan bawah. Lanjutkan hingga dumbbell berada di depan bahu. Tahan dan remas otot selama 1 detik.
Tarik napas lalu turunkan kembali dumbbell secara perlahan ke posisi awal.
Ulangi sesuai jumlah repetisi yang ditentukan.
instructions_en: To begin, stand straight with a dumbbell in each hand using a pronated grip (palms facing down). Your arms should be fully extended while your feet are shoulder width apart from each other. This is the starting position.

While holding the upper arms stationary, curl the weights while contracting the biceps as you breathe out. Only the forearms should move. Continue the movement until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level. Hold the contracted position for a second as you squeeze the muscle.
Slowly begin to bring the dumbbells back to starting position as your breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
