name: Standing Dumbbell Straight-Arm Front Delt Raise Above Head
instructions: Pegang dumbbell di depan paha dengan telapak tangan menghadap ke arah paha.
Jaga lengan tetap lurus dengan sedikit tekukan konstan pada siku. Ini posisi awal Anda.
Hembuskan napas lalu angkat dumbbell membentuk gerakan setengah lingkaran ke atas kepala hingga lengan lurus.
Tarik napas lalu turunkan kembali secara perlahan melalui jalur yang sama ke posisi awal.
Ulangi sesuai jumlah repetisi yang ditentukan.
instructions_en: Hold the dumbbells in front of your thighs, palms facing your thighs.
Keep your arms straight with a slight bend at the elbows but keep them locked. This will be your starting position.
Raise the dumbbells in a semicircular motion to arm's length overhead as you exhale.
Slowly return to the starting position using the same path as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Standing Dumbbell Triceps Extension
instructions: Berdiri dengan kaki dibuka selebar bahu. Gunakan kedua tangan untuk mengangkat dan memegang satu dumbbell ke atas kepala hingga kedua lengan lurus.
Pegang dumbbell dengan telapak tangan menghadap ke langit-langit dan ibu jari melingkar pada pegangan. Ini posisi awal Anda.

Tarik napas lalu turunkan beban ke belakang kepala secara perlahan membentuk setengah lingkaran hingga lengan bawah menyentuh bisep. Jaga agar lengan atas tetap di dekat kepala, siku menghadap ke depan, dan tidak bergerak.
Hembuskan napas lalu dorong kembali dumbbell ke atas menggunakan otot trisep hingga posisi lengan lurus.
Ulangi sesuai jumlah repetisi yang ditentukan.
instructions_en: To begin, stand up with a dumbbell held by both hands. Your feet should be about shoulder width apart from each other. Slowly use both hands to grab the dumbbell and lift it over your head until both arms are fully extended.
The resistance should be resting in the palms of your hands with your thumbs around it. The palm of the hands should be facing up towards the ceiling. This will be your starting position.

Keeping your upper arms close to your head with elbows in and perpendicular to the floor, lower the resistance in a semicircular motion behind your head until your forearms touch your biceps. Tip: The upper arms should remain stationary and only the forearms should move. Breathe in as you perform this step.
Go back to the starting position by using the triceps to raise the dumbbell. Breathe out as you perform this step.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Standing Dumbbell Upright Row
instructions: Pegang dumbbell dengan posisi telapak tangan menghadap ke belakang (pronated) selebar bahu. Posisikan dumbbell di atas paha dengan lengan sedikit menekuk dan punggung tegak.

Hembuskan napas, angkat dumbbell dengan mengarahkan sikut ke atas hingga hampir menyentuh dagu. Jaga agar posisi sikut selalu lebih tinggi dari lengan bawah, tubuh tetap diam, dan tahan selama satu detik di puncak gerakan.
Tarik napas sambil menurunkan dumbbell kembali ke posisi awal secara perlahan.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang disarankan.
instructions_en: Grasp a dumbbell in each hand with a pronated (palms forward) grip that is slightly less than shoulder width. The dumbbells should be resting on top of your thighs. Your arms should be extended with a slight bend at the elbows and your back should be straight. This will be your starting position.

Use your side shoulders to lift the dumbbells as you exhale. The dumbbells should be close to the body as you move it up and the elbows should drive the motion. Continue to lift them until they nearly touch your chin. Tip: Your elbows should drive the motion. As you lift the dumbbells, your elbows should always be higher than your forearms. Also, keep your torso stationary and pause for a second at the top of the movement.
Lower the dumbbells back down slowly to the starting position. Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Standing Elevated Quad Stretch
instructions: Berdiri membelakangi bangku atau box dengan jarak sekitar 60-90 cm.
Angkat satu kaki ke belakang dan letakkan punggung kaki atau bagian depan telapak kaki di atas bangku, mana yang terasa paling nyaman.
Jaga lutut kaki tumpu sedikit menekuk dan jangan biarkan lutut melewati ujung jari kaki. Lakukan bergantian pada sisi lainnya.
instructions_en: Start by standing with your back about two to three feet away from a bench or step.
Lift one leg behind you and rest your foot on the step,either on your instep or the ball of your foot, whichever you find most comfortable.
Keep your supporting knee slightly bent and avoid letting that knee extend out beyond your toes. Switch sides.

name: Standing Front Barbell Raise Over Head
instructions: Berdiri tegak dengan kaki selebar bahu, pegang barbell dengan telapak tangan menghadap bawah (pronated) dengan genggaman lebih sempit dari lebar bahu.
Posisikan sikut sedikit menekuk sebagai posisi awal.
Hembuskan napas, angkat barbell lurus hingga tepat di atas kepala, tetap jaga sikut sedikit menekuk.
Tarik napas, turunkan barbell kembali ke posisi awal setelah merasakan kontraksi otot.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang disarankan.
instructions_en: To begin, stand straight with a barbell in your hands. You should grip the bar with palms facing down and a closer than shoulder width grip apart from each other.
Your feet should be shoulder width apart from each other. Your elbows should be slightly bent. This is the starting position.
Lift the barbell up until it is directly over your head while exhaling. Make sure to keep your elbows slightly bent when performing each repetition.
Once you feel the contraction, begin to lower the barbell back down to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Posisikan sikut sedikit menekuk sebagai posisi awal.
Hembuskan napas, angkat barbell lurus hingga tepat di atas kepala, tetap jaga sikut sedikit menekuk.

name: Standing Gastrocnemius Calf Stretch
instructions: Letakkan tumit kanan di atas pijakan dengan lutut lurus, condongkan tubuh ke depan, dan raih jari kaki kanan dengan tangan kanan. Jaga lutut kiri sedikit menekuk dan punggung tetap lurus.
Tumpukan berat badan pada kaki kiri dan letakkan tangan kiri di atas paha kiri.
Tarik jari kaki kanan ke arah lutut hingga terasa regangan pada betis.
instructions_en: Place your right heel on a step with your knee extended and lean forward to grab your right toe with your right hand. Your left knee should be slightly bent and your back should be straight.
Support your weight on your left leg and place your left hand on your left thigh.
Pull your right toes toward your knee until you feel a stretch in your calf.
instructions_id: Letakkan tumit kanan di atas pijakan dengan lutut lurus, condongkan tubuh ke depan, dan raih jari kaki kanan dengan tangan kanan. Jaga lutut kiri sedikit menekuk dan punggung tetap lurus.
Tumpukan berat badan pada kaki kiri dan letakkan tangan kiri di atas paha kiri.
Tarik jari kaki kanan ke arah lutut hingga terasa regangan pada betis.

name: Standing Hamstring and Calf Stretch
instructions: Lingkarkan tali atau band pada salah satu kaki, lalu posisikan kaki tersebut di depan.
Tekuk kaki belakang sementara kaki depan tetap lurus. Angkat jari-jari kaki depan dari lantai dan condongkan tubuh ke depan.
Gunakan tali untuk menarik bagian atas kaki guna memperdalam regangan betis. Tahan selama 10-20 detik, lalu ulangi pada kaki lainnya.
instructions_en: Being by looping a belt, band, or rope around one foot. While standing, place that foot forward.
Bend your back leg, while keeping the front one straight. Now raise the toes of your front foot off of the ground and lean forward.
Using the belt, pull on the top of the foot to increase the stretch in the calf. Hold for 10-20 seconds and repeat with the other foot.
instructions_id: Lingkarkan tali atau band pada salah satu kaki, lalu posisikan kaki tersebut di depan.
Tekuk kaki belakang sementara kaki depan tetap lurus. Angkat jari-jari kaki depan dari lantai dan condongkan tubuh ke depan.
Gunakan tali untuk menarik bagian atas kaki guna memperdalam regangan betis. Tahan selama 10-20 detik, lalu ulangi pada kaki lainnya.

name: Standing Hip Circles
instructions: Berdiri dengan satu kaki sambil memegang penyangga vertikal.
Angkat lutut kaki lainnya hingga membentuk sudut 90 derajat sebagai posisi awal.
Buka pinggul seluas mungkin sambil membuat lingkaran besar dengan lutut.
Lakukan gerakan ini secara perlahan untuk beberapa repetisi, lalu ulangi pada sisi sebaliknya.
instructions_en: Begin standing on one leg, holding to a vertical support.
Raise the unsupported knee to 90 degrees. This will be your starting position.
Open the hip as far as possible, attempting to make a big circle with your knee.
Perform this movement slowly for a number of repetitions, and repeat on the other side.
instructions_id: Berdiri dengan satu kaki sambil memegang penyangga vertikal.
Angkat lutut kaki lainnya hingga membentuk sudut 90 derajat sebagai posisi awal.
Buka pinggul seluas mungkin sambil membuat lingkaran besar dengan lutut.
Lakukan gerakan ini secara perlahan untuk beberapa repetisi, lalu ulangi pada sisi sebaliknya.

name: Standing Hip Flexors
instructions: Berdiri tegak dengan tulang belakang lurus, posisi kaki kiri sedikit di depan kaki kanan.

Tekuk kedua lutut dan angkat tumit belakang dari lantai sambil mendorong pinggul kanan ke depan. Posisi ini tidak memberikan peregangan yang sangat mendalam karena sulit melemaskan fleksor pinggul sekaligus menahan berat badan. Ganti sisi.
instructions_en: Stand up straight with the spine vertical, the left foot slightly in front of the right.

Bend both knees and lift the back heel off the floor as you press the right hip forward. You can't get a thorough, deep stretch in this position, however, because it's hard to relax the hip flexor and stand on it at the same time. Switch sides.
instructions_id: Berdiri tegak dengan tulang belakang lurus, posisi kaki kiri sedikit di depan kaki kanan.

name: Standing Inner-Biceps Curl
instructions: Berdiri dengan memegang dumbbell di masing-masing tangan. Posisi lengan lurus di samping tubuh dengan siku mendekati torso, dan kaki dibuka selebar bahu.
Putar telapak tangan menghadap ke dalam (netral) sebagai posisi awal.

Tahan posisi lengan atas, lalu angkat beban ke arah luar sambil mengontraksikan biseps dan buang napas. Putar pergelangan tangan saat beban terangkat penuh hingga telapak tangan menghadap ke atas (supinasi).
Hanya lengan bawah yang bergerak. Lanjutkan gerakan hingga biseps berkontraksi penuh dan dumbbell sejajar dengan bahu. Tips: Jaga lengan bawah tetap sejajar dengan deltoid luar.
Tahan posisi kontraksi selama sedetik sambil meremas biseps.
Turunkan kembali dumbbell secara perlahan ke posisi awal sambil menarik napas. Putar pergelangan tangan saat menurunkan beban untuk kembali ke grip netral.
Ulangi untuk jumlah repetisi yang dianjurkan.
instructions_en: Stand up with a dumbbell in each hand being held at arms length. The elbows should be close to the torso. Your legs should be at about shoulder's width apart from each other.
Rotate the palms of the hands so that they are facing inward in a neutral position. This will be your starting position.

While holding the upper arms stationary, curl the weights out while contracting the biceps as you breathe out. Your wrist should turn so that when the weights are fully elevated you have supinated grip (palms facing up).
Only the forearms should move. Continue the movement until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level. Tip: Keep the forearms aligned with your outer deltoids.
Hold the contracted position for a second as you squeeze the biceps.
Slowly begin to bring the dumbbells back to the starting position as your breathe in. Remember to rotate the wrists as you lower the weight in order to switch back to a neutral grip.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_id: Berdiri dengan memegang dumbbell di masing-masing tangan. Posisi lengan lurus di samping tubuh dengan siku mendekati torso, dan kaki dibuka selebar bahu.
Putar telapak tangan menghadap ke dalam (netral) sebagai posisi awal.

Tahan posisi lengan atas, lalu angkat beban ke arah luar sambil mengontraksikan biseps dan buang napas. Putar pergelangan tangan saat beban terangkat penuh hingga telapak tangan menghadap ke atas (supinasi).
Hanya lengan bawah yang bergerak. Lanjutkan gerakan hingga biseps berkontraksi penuh dan dumbbell sejajar dengan bahu. Tips: Jaga lengan bawah tetap sejajar dengan deltoid luar.
Tahan posisi kontraksi selama sedetik sambil meremas biseps.
Turunkan kembali dumbbell secara perlahan ke posisi awal sambil menarik napas. Putar pergelangan tangan saat menurunkan beban untuk kembali ke grip netral.
Ulangi untuk jumlah repetisi yang dianjurkan.

name: Standing Lateral Stretch
instructions: Ambil posisi berdiri dengan kaki sedikit lebih lebar dari pinggul dan lutut sedikit ditekuk.
Letakkan tangan kanan di pinggul kanan untuk menopang tulang belakang.
Angkat lengan kiri ke atas secara vertikal dan letakkan tangan kiri di belakang kepala. Tahan posisi ini saat Anda miringkan torso ke arah kanan.
Jaga distribusi berat badan merata di kedua kaki (jangan bertumpu pada pinggul kiri). Ganti sisi.
instructions_en: Take a slightly wider than hip distance stance with your knees slightly bent.
Place your right hand on your right hip to support the spine.
Raise your left arm in a vertical line and place your left hand behind your head. Keep it there as you incline your torso to the right.
Keep your weight evenly distributed between both legs (don't lean into your left hip). Switch sides.

name: Standing Leg Curl
instructions: Sesuaikan tuas mesin dengan tinggi badan Anda, posisikan tubuh bagian atas condong ke depan sekitar 30-45 derajat di pinggang (karena posisi bersudut lebih baik untuk rekrutmen hamstring), dengan bantalan tuas di bagian belakang kaki kanan (beberapa inci di bawah betis) dan bagian depan kaki kanan di atas bantalan mesin.
Dengan torso tetap condong ke depan, pastikan kaki lurus sempurna dan pegang handle samping mesin. Arahkan jari kaki lurus ke depan sebagai posisi awal.
Sambil membuang napas, tekuk kaki kanan ke atas semaksimal mungkin tanpa mengangkat paha atas dari bantalan. Tahan selama sedetik saat mencapai kontraksi penuh.
Sambil menarik napas, kembalikan kaki ke posisi awal. Ulangi untuk jumlah repetisi yang dianjurkan.
Lakukan latihan yang sama untuk kaki kiri.
instructions_en: Adjust the machine lever to fit your height and lie with your torso bent at the waist facing forward around 30-45 degrees (since an angled position is more favorable for hamstrings recruitment) with the pad of the lever on the back of your right leg (just a few inches under the calves) and the front of the right leg on top of the machine pad.
Keeping the torso bent forward, ensure your leg is fully stretched and grab the side handles of the machine. Position your toes straight. This will be your starting position.
As you exhale, curl your right leg up as far as possible without lifting the upper leg from the pad. Once you hit the fully contracted position, hold it for a second.
As you inhale, bring the legs back to the initial position. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Perform the same exercise now for the left leg.

name: Standing Long Jump
instructions: Lakukan latihan ini di atas pasir atau permukaan empuk. Pastikan Anda memiliki alat pengukur jarak. Berdirilah dengan posisi setengah jongkok dan kaki selebar bahu.
Ayunkan lengan dengan kuat dan gunakan momentum kaki untuk melompat ke depan sejauh mungkin.
Mendaratlah dengan kaki di depan untuk memaksimalkan jarak jangkauan.
Ukur jarak dari titik pendaratan ke titik awal dan catat hasilnya.
instructions_en: This drill is best done in sand or other soft landing surface. Ensure that you are able to measure distance. Stand in a partial squat stance with feet shoulder width apart.
Utilizing a big arm swing and a countermovement of the legs, jump forward as far as you can.
Attempt to land with your feet out in front you, reaching as far as possible with your legs.
Measure the distance from your landing point to the starting point and track results.

name: Standing Low-Pulley Deltoid Raise
instructions: Berdirilah di sisi kanan mesin kabel rendah. Pegang handle dengan tangan kiri secara menyilang di depan tubuh menggunakan genggaman pronasi (telapak menghadap ke bawah). Tangan kanan memegang tiang mesin untuk keseimbangan.
Pastikan punggung tegak dan kaki dibuka selebar bahu. Ini adalah posisi awal.
Angkat lengan kiri ke samping hingga mencapai ketinggian bahu sambil mengembuskan napas.
Tahan sejenak di puncak gerakan untuk merasakan kontraksi, lalu turunkan beban secara perlahan ke posisi awal sambil menarik napas.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai repetisi yang dianjurkan.
Ganti ke tangan kanan dan ulangi latihan.
instructions_en: Start by standing to the right side of a low pulley row. Use your left hand to come across the body and grab a single handle attached to the low pulley with a pronated grip (palms facing down). Rest your arm in front of you. Your right hand should grab the machine for better support and balance.
Make sure that your back is erect and your feet are shoulder width apart from each other. This is the starting position.
Begin to use the left hand and come across your body out until it is elevated to shoulder height while exhaling.
Feel the contraction at the top for a second and begin to slowly lower the handle back down to the original starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Switch arms and repeat the exercise.

name: Standing Low-Pulley One-Arm Triceps Extension
instructions: Pegang handle dengan tangan kiri di samping mesin. Membelakangi mesin, angkat handle ke atas kepala dengan kedua tangan (telapak menghadap depan). Jaga lengan atas tetap vertikal, gunakan tangan kanan untuk menopang siku kiri agar stabil. Ini adalah posisi awal.
Jaga lengan atas tetap diam di dekat kepala, turunkan beban di belakang kepala dengan gerakan melingkar hingga lengan bawah menyentuh bisep. Tarik napas saat menurunkan beban.
Kembali ke posisi awal dengan mendorong handle ke atas menggunakan otot triceps. Hembuskan napas saat mendorong beban.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai repetisi yang dianjurkan.
Ganti ke tangan kanan dan ulangi latihan.
instructions_en: Grab a single handle with your left arm next to the low pulley machine. Turn away from the machine keeping the handle to the side of your body with your arm fully extended. Now use both hands to elevate the single handle directly above the head with the palm facing forward. Keep your upper arm completely vertical (perpendicular to the floor) and put your right hand on your left elbow to help keep it steady. This is the starting position.

Keeping your upper arms close to your head (elbows in) and perpendicular to the floor, lower the resistance in a semicircular motion behind your head until your forearms touch your biceps. Tip: The upper arms should remain stationary and only the forearms should move. Breathe in as you perform this step.
Go back to the starting position by using the triceps to raise the single handle. Breathe out as you perform this step.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Switch arms and repeat the exercise.

name: Standing Military Press
instructions: Atur barbell setinggi dada pada rak. Pegang barbell dengan genggaman pronasi (telapak menghadap depan) lebih lebar dari bahu.
Tekuk sedikit lutut, angkat barbell ke tulang selangka/dada atas. Mundur selangkah dan buka kaki selebar bahu.
Angkat barbell ke atas kepala hingga lengan terkunci. Posisikan barbell di depan kepala sejajar dengan bahu. Ini adalah posisi awal.
Turunkan barbell perlahan ke tulang selangka sambil menarik napas.
Dorong kembali barbell ke posisi awal sambil mengembuskan napas.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai repetisi yang dianjurkan.
instructions_en: Start by placing a barbell that is about chest high on a squat rack. Once you have selected the weights, grab the barbell using a pronated (palms facing forward) grip. Make sure to grip the bar wider than shoulder width apart from each other.
Slightly bend the knees and place the barbell on your collar bone. Lift the barbell up keeping it lying on your chest. Take a step back and position your feet shoulder width apart from each other.

Once you pick up the barbell with the correct grip length, lift the bar up over your head by locking your arms. Hold at about shoulder level and slightly in front of your head. This is your starting position.
Lower the bar down to the collarbone slowly as you inhale.
Lift the bar back up to the starting position as you exhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Standing Olympic Plate Hand Squeeze
instructions: Berdirilah tegak dengan kaki selebar bahu. Pegang piringan beban di kedua tangan dengan posisi netral (telapak menghadap dalam) di samping tubuh. Ini adalah posisi awal.
Turunkan piringan beban hingga jari hampir terbuka sepenuhnya namun tetap menggenggam beban sambil menarik napas.
Angkat kembali piringan ke posisi awal dengan meremas jari-jari tangan sambil mengembuskan napas.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai repetisi yang dianjurkan dalam program Anda.
instructions_en: To begin, stand straight while holding a weight plate by the ridge at arm's length in each hand using a neutral grip (palms facing in). You feet should be shoulder width apart from each other. This will be your starting position.
Lower the plates until the fingers are nearly extended but can still hold weights. Inhale as you lower the plates.
Now raise the plates back to the starting position as you exhale by closing your hands.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions prescribed in your program.

name: Standing One-Arm Cable Curl
instructions: Pegang handle tunggal di dekat mesin katrol bawah. Jaga jarak dari mesin agar lengan Anda menahan beban sepenuhnya.
Pastikan lengan atas tetap diam dan tegak lurus dengan lantai, siku di dalam, dan telapak tangan menghadap ke depan. Letakkan tangan yang tidak bekerja pada pinggang untuk menjaga keseimbangan.
Hembuskan napas perlahan sambil menekuk handle ke atas. Pastikan hanya lengan bawah yang bergerak hingga menyentuh otot biseps.
Tahan kontraksi sesaat sambil meremas biseps, lalu tarik napas sambil menurunkan handle kembali ke posisi awal.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang ditentukan.
Berganti sisi lengan untuk melakukan latihan ini.
instructions_en: Start out by grabbing single handle next to the low pulley machine. Make sure you are far enough from the machine so that your arm is supporting the weight.

Make sure that your upper arm is stationary, perpendicular to the floor with elbows in and palms facing forward. Your non lifting arm should be grabbing your waist. This will allow you to keep your balance.
Slowly begin to curl the single handle upwards while keeping the upper arm stationary until your forearm touches your bicep while exhaling. Tip: Only the forearm should move.
Hold the contraction position as you squeeze the bicep and then lower the single handle back down to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Switch arms while performing this exercise.

name: Standing One-Arm Dumbbell Curl Over Incline Bench
instructions: Berdirilah di sisi belakang bangku miring seolah menjadi pengawas (spotter). Pegang dumbbell dengan satu tangan dan letakkan di atas bangku miring dengan telapak tangan menghadap ke atas.
Letakkan tangan yang tidak bekerja di sudut atau sisi bangku miring. Tekan dada ke bagian atas bangku dan buka kaki sedikit lebar di lantai. Ini adalah posisi awal.

Jaga lengan atas tetap diam, lalu hembuskan napas sambil mengangkat dumbbell ke atas dan kontraksikan biseps. Hanya lengan bawah yang bergerak hingga biseps berkontraksi penuh dan dumbbell sejajar dengan bahu. Tahan posisi ini selama satu detik.
Tarik napas perlahan saat menurunkan dumbbell kembali ke posisi awal.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang ditentukan.
Berganti sisi lengan untuk melakukan latihan ini.
instructions_en: Stand on the back side of an incline bench as if you were going to be a spotter for someone. Have a dumbbell in one hand and rest it across the incline bench with a supinated (palms up) grip.

Position your non lifting hand at the corner or side of the incline bench. The chest should be pressed against the top part of the incline and your feet should be pressed against the floor at a wide stance. This is the starting position.

While holding the upper arm stationary, curl the dumbbell upward while contracting the biceps as you breathe out. Only the forearms should move. Continue the movement until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbell is at shoulder level. Hold the contracted position for a second.
Slowly begin to bring the dumbbells back to starting position as your breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Switch arms while performing this exercise.

name: Standing One-Arm Dumbbell Triceps Extension
instructions: Berdirilah dengan kaki dibuka selebar bahu sambil memegang dumbbell dengan satu tangan. Angkat dan luruskan lengan ke atas kepala. Kelingking menghadap ke langit-langit dan telapak tangan menghadap ke depan.
Posisi ini adalah posisi awal Anda.

Jaga lengan atas tetap dekat dengan kepala (siku di dalam) dan tegak lurus dengan lantai. Tarik napas sambil menurunkan beban secara melingkar di belakang kepala hingga lengan bawah menyentuh biseps. Pastikan lengan atas tidak bergerak dan hanya lengan bawah yang bergerak.
Hembuskan napas sambil mendorong dumbbell kembali ke posisi awal menggunakan triseps.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang ditentukan.

instructions_en: To begin, stand up with a dumbbell held in one hand. Your feet should be about shoulder width apart from each other. Now fully extend the arm with the dumbbell over your head. Tip: The small finger of your hand should be facing the ceiling and the palm of your hand should be facing forward. The dumbbell should be above your head.
This will be your starting position.

Keeping your upper arm close to your head (elbows in) and perpendicular to the floor, lower the resistance in a semicircular motion behind your head until your forearm touch your bicep. Tip: The upper arm should remain stationary and only the forearm should move. Breathe in as you perform this step.
Go back to the starting position by using the triceps to raise the dumbbell. Breathe out as you perform this step.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Switch arms and repeat the exercise.

name: Standing Overhead Barbell Triceps Extension
instructions: Berdirilah sambil memegang barbell atau E-Z bar dengan genggaman menghadap ke depan (pronasi). Posisi tangan lebih sempit dari lebar bahu dan kaki dibuka selebar bahu.

Hembuskan napas saat mendorong barbell kembali ke posisi awal menggunakan triseps.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang ditentukan.

Now elevate the barbell above your head until your arms are fully extended. Keep your elbows in. This will be your starting position.

Keeping your upper arms close to your head and elbows in, perpendicular to the floor, lower the resistance in a semicircular motion behind your head until your forearms touch your biceps. Tip: The upper arms should remain stationary and only the forearms should move. Breathe in as you perform this step.
Go back to the starting position by using the triceps to raise the barbell. Breathe out as you perform this step.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Standing Palm-In One-Arm Dumbbell Press
instructions: Pegang dumbbell dengan satu tangan di sisi tubuh dan lengan lurus menggunakan genggaman netral. Pegang bangku miring dengan tangan lainnya untuk menjaga keseimbangan.
Buka kaki selebar bahu. Perlahan angkat dumbbell hingga lengan membentuk sudut 90 derajat (lengan bawah tegak lurus lantai). Pertahankan genggaman netral selama latihan.
Angkat dumbbell ke atas hingga lengan lurus sepenuhnya. Ini adalah posisi awal.
Tarik napas saat menurunkan beban hingga lengan kembali membentuk sudut 90 derajat.
Rasakan kontraksi sesaat, lalu hembuskan napas sambil mendorong beban kembali ke posisi awal. Jaga pegangan pada bangku dan posisi kaki untuk keseimbangan.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang ditentukan.
Berganti sisi lengan dan ulangi latihan.
instructions_en: Start by having a dumbbell in one hand with your arm fully extended to the side using a neutral grip. Use your other arm to hold on to an incline bench to keep your balance.

Your feet should be shoulder width apart from each other. Now slowly lift the dumbbell up until you create a 90 degree angle with your arm. Note: Your forearm should be perpendicular to the floor. Continue to maintain a neutral grip throughout the entire exercise.
Slowly lift the dumbbell up until your arm is fully extended. This the starting position.
While inhaling lower the weight down until your arm is at a 90 degree angle again.

Feel the contraction for a second and then lift the weight back up towards the starting position while exhaling. Remember to hold on to the incline bench and keep your feet positioned to keep balance during the exercise.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Switch arms and repeat the exercise.

Berganti sisi lengan dan ulangi latihan.

name: Standing Palms-In Dumbbell Press
instructions: Berdiri dengan kaki selebar bahu. Pegang dumbbell di masing-masing tangan dengan lengan lurus ke samping (posisi netral).
Angkat dumbbell perlahan hingga membentuk sudut 90 derajat pada siku (lengan bawah tegak lurus dengan lantai). Ini posisi awal Anda.
Pertahankan genggaman netral, dorong dumbbell ke atas hingga lengan lurus sepenuhnya.
Sambil menarik napas, turunkan kembali beban hingga lengan membentuk sudut 90 derajat.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai repetisi yang disarankan.
instructions_en: Start by having a dumbbell in each hand with your arm fully extended to the side using a neutral grip. Your feet should be shoulder width apart from each other. Now slowly lift the dumbbells up until you create a 90 degree angle with your arms. Note: Your forearms should be perpendicular to the floor. This the starting position.
Continue to maintain a neutral grip throughout the entire exercise. Slowly lift the dumbbells up until your arms are fully extended.
While inhaling lower the weights down until your arm is at a 90 degree angle again.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Standing Palms-Up Barbell Behind The Back Wrist Curl
instructions: Berdiri tegak, pegang barbell di belakang bokong dengan lengan lurus. Gunakan genggaman pronasi (telapak tangan menghadap ke belakang) selebar bahu.
Pandangan lurus ke depan, kaki dibuka selebar bahu. Ini posisi awal Anda.
Sambil membuang napas, angkat barbell dengan menekuk pergelangan tangan ke arah atas. Fokus hanya pada pergelangan tangan, tubuh tetap diam.
Tahan kontraksi sejenak, lalu turunkan kembali barbell ke posisi awal sambil menarik napas.
Ulangi sesuai repetisi yang disarankan.
Setelah selesai, turunkan barbell ke rak atau lantai dengan menekuk lutut. Disarankan mengambil beban dari rak atau dibantu rekan.
instructions_en: Start by standing straight and holding a barbell behind your glutes at arm's length while using a pronated grip (palms will be facing back away from the glutes) and having your hands shoulder width apart from each other.
You should be looking straight forward while your feet are shoulder width apart from each other. This is the starting position.
While exhaling, slowly elevate the barbell up by curling your wrist in a semi-circular motion towards the ceiling. Note: Your wrist should be the only body part moving for this exercise.
Hold the contraction for a second and lower the barbell back down to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
When finished, lower the barbell down to the squat rack or the floor by bending the knees. Tip: It is easiest to either pick it up from a squat rack or have a partner hand it to you.

name: Standing Pelvic Tilt
instructions: Berdiri dengan kaki selebar pinggul.
Tekuk lutut sedikit agar posisi kaki rileks dan fleksibel.
Gerakkan panggul ke depan dan belakang beberapa kali sebelum menahan tulang ekor tetap menghadap ke depan.
instructions_en: Start off with your feet hip-distance apart.
Bend your knees slightly to keep them soft and springy.
You may want to move your pelvis forward and backward and back few times before holding the tailbone forward in this stretch.
instructions_id: Berdiri dengan kaki selebar pinggul.

name: Standing Rope Crunch
instructions: Pasang tali (rope) pada katrol tinggi dan pilih beban yang sesuai.
Berdiri membelakangi mesin kabel. Pegang tali dengan kedua tangan di atas bahu, tahan di dada bagian atas. Ini posisi awal Anda.
Lakukan gerakan dengan menekuk tulang belakang (crunch), tarik beban ke bawah sejauh mungkin.
Tahan kontraksi puncak sejenak sebelum kembali ke posisi awal.
instructions_en: Attach a rope to a high pulley and select an appropriate weight.
Stand with your back to the cable tower. Take the rope with both hands over your shoulders, holding it to your upper chest. This will be your starting position.
Perform the movement by flexing the spine, crunching the weight down as far as you can.
Hold the peak contraction for a moment before returning to the starting position.

name: Standing Soleus And Achilles Stretch
instructions: Berdiri dengan kaki selebar pinggul, satu kaki sedikit di depan kaki lainnya.
Tekuk kedua lutut, pastikan tumit kaki belakang tetap menempel di lantai. Lakukan bergantian pada sisi lainnya.
instructions_en: Stand with your feet hip-distance apart, one foot slightly in front of the other.
Bend both knees, keeping your back heel on the floor. Switch sides.

name: Standing Toe Touches
instructions: Berdiri dengan ruang yang cukup di depan dan belakang Anda.
Tekuk pinggang dengan kaki tetap lurus, hingga tubuh bagian atas rileks dan tergantung ke bawah di depan. Biarkan lengan dan tangan menggantung secara alami. Tahan selama 10 hingga 20 detik.
instructions_en: Stand with some space in front and behind you.
Bend at the waist, keeping your legs straight, until you can relax and let your upper body hang down in front of you. Let your arms and hands hang down naturally. Hold for 10 to 20 seconds.

name: Standing Towel Triceps Extension
instructions: Mulailah dengan berdiri, kedua lengan lurus penuh di atas kepala sambil memegang satu ujung handuk dengan kedua tangan. Siku menghadap ke dalam, lengan tegak lurus dengan lantai, telapak tangan saling berhadapan, dan kaki dibuka selebar bahu. Ini adalah posisi awal.

Minta partner Anda memegang ujung handuk yang lain untuk memberikan tahanan. Jaga lengan atas tetap dekat dengan kepala (siku di dalam) dan tegak lurus dengan lantai, lalu turunkan handuk dengan gerakan melingkar di belakang kepala hingga lengan bawah menyentuh biseps. Tips: Lengan atas harus tetap diam dan hanya lengan bawah yang bergerak. Tarik napas saat melakukan gerakan ini.
Kembali ke posisi awal dengan menggunakan otot triseps untuk mengangkat handuk. Hembuskan napas saat melakukan gerakan ini.
Ulangi sebanyak repetisi yang disarankan.
instructions_en: To begin, stand up with both arms fully extended above the head holding one end of a towel with both hands. Your elbows should be in and the arms perpendicular to the floor with the palms facing each other while your feet should be shoulder width apart from each other. This is the starting position.

Now communicate with your partner so that he/she can grip the other side of the towel to apply resistance. Keeping your upper arms close to your head (elbows in) and perpendicular to the floor, lower the resistance in a semicircular motion behind your head until your forearms touch your biceps. Tip: The upper arms should remain stationary and only the forearms should move. Breathe in as you perform this step.
Go back to the starting position by using the triceps to raise the towel. Breathe out as you perform this step.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Standing Two-Arm Overhead Throw
instructions: Berdiri dengan kaki dibuka selebar bahu sambil memegang bola medicine dengan kedua tangan. Awali dengan membawa bola jauh ke belakang kepala, tekuk sedikit lutut, dan condongkan badan ke belakang.
Lemparkan bola ke depan dengan kuat, tekuk bagian pinggul, dan gunakan seluruh tubuh untuk menyelesaikan gerakan.
Bola medicine dapat dilempar ke arah partner atau tembok, lalu tangkap kembali saat memantul.
instructions_en: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding a medicine ball in both hands. To begin, reach the medicine ball deep behind your head as you bend the knees slightly and lean back.
Violently throw the ball forward, flexing at the hip and using your whole body to complete the movement.
The medicine ball can be thrown to a partner or to a wall, receiving it as it bounces back.

name: Star Jump
instructions: Ambil posisi rileks dengan kaki dibuka selebar bahu dan lengan didekatkan ke sisi tubuh.
Awali gerakan dengan melakukan setengah jongkok, lalu melompatlah ke atas setinggi mungkin dengan eksplosif. Luruskan seluruh tubuh sepenuhnya, lebarkan kaki dan tangan menjauhi tubuh.
Saat mendarat, satukan kembali anggota tubuh dan redam benturan melalui kaki.
instructions_en: Begin in a relaxed stance with your feet shoulder width apart and hold your arms close to the body.
To initiate the move, squat down halfway and explode back up as high as possible. Fully extend your entire body, spreading your legs and arms away from the body.
As you land, bring your limbs back in and absorb your impact through the legs.

name: Step-up with Knee Raise
instructions: Berdiri menghadap box atau bangku dengan ketinggian yang sesuai dan kaki rapat. Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.

Mulailah gerakan dengan melangkah naik, letakkan kaki kiri di atas bangku. Luruskan pinggul dan lutut kaki depan untuk berdiri di atas box. Saat berdiri dengan kaki kiri, tekuk lutut dan pinggul kanan, angkat lutut setinggi mungkin.
Balikkan gerakan ini untuk turun dari box, lalu ulangi urutan gerakan untuk sisi kaki sebaliknya.
instructions_en: Stand facing a box or bench of an appropriate height with your feet together. This will be your starting position.

Begin the movement by stepping up, putting your left foot on the top of the bench. Extend through the hip and knee of your front leg to stand up on the box. As you stand on the box with your left leg, flex your right knee and hip, bringing your knee as high as you can.
Reverse this motion to step down off the box, and then repeat the sequence on the opposite leg.

name: Step Mill
instructions: Naik ke mesin stepmill dan pilih menu latihan yang diinginkan.
Anda dapat memilih pengaturan manual atau program yang tersedia.
Masukkan usia dan berat badan untuk estimasi kalori yang terbakar.
Berhati-hatilah saat menaiki tangga agar tidak tersandung.
Disarankan untuk selalu memegang handle agar menjaga keseimbangan dan mencegah terjatuh.
instructions_en: To begin, step onto the stepmill and select the desired option from the menu. You can choose a manual setting, or you can select a program to run. Typically, you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned during exercise. Use caution so that you don't trip as you climb the stairs. It is recommended that you maintain your grip on the handles so that you don't fall.

Stepmills offer convenience, cardiovascular benefits, and usually have less impact than running outside while offering a similar rate of calories burned. They are typically much harder than other cardio equipment. A 150 lb person will typically burn over 300 calories in 30 minutes, compared to about 175 calories walking.

Anda dapat memilih pengaturan manual atau program yang tersedia.

name: Stiff-Legged Barbell Deadlift
instructions: Pegang barbell dengan overhand grip (telapak tangan menghadap ke bawah). Gunakan wrist wrap jika menggunakan beban berat.
Berdiri tegak dengan kaki selebar bahu atau lebih sempit, lutut sedikit ditekuk. Ini adalah posisi awal.
Jaga lutut tetap diam, turunkan barbell ke arah punggung kaki dengan menekuk pinggul, pastikan punggung tetap lurus. Tarik napas saat melakukan gerakan ini hingga terasa regangan pada otot hamstring.
Kembali ke posisi tegak dengan meluruskan pinggul. Buang napas saat melakukan gerakan ini.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang dianjurkan.
instructions_en: Grasp a bar using an overhand grip (palms facing down). You may need some wrist wraps if using a significant amount of weight.
Stand with your torso straight and your legs spaced using a shoulder width or narrower stance. The knees should be slightly bent. This is your starting position.

Keeping the knees stationary, lower the barbell to over the top of your feet by bending at the hips while keeping your back straight. Keep moving forward as if you were going to pick something from the floor until you feel a stretch on the hamstrings. Inhale as you perform this movement.
Start bringing your torso up straight again by extending your hips until you are back at the starting position. Exhale as you perform this movement.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Stiff-Legged Dumbbell Deadlift
instructions: Pegang sepasang dumbbell dengan lengan lurus di samping tubuh.

Jaga lutut tetap diam, turunkan dumbbell ke arah punggung kaki dengan menekuk pinggang, pastikan punggung tetap lurus. Buang napas saat melakukan gerakan ini hingga terasa regangan pada otot hamstring.
Kembali ke posisi tegak dengan meluruskan pinggul dan pinggang. Tarik napas saat melakukan gerakan ini.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang dianjurkan.

Keeping the knees stationary, lower the dumbbells to over the top of your feet by bending at the waist while keeping your back straight. Keep moving forward as if you were going to pick something from the floor until you feel a stretch on the hamstrings. Exhale as you perform this movement
Start bringing your torso up straight again by extending your hips and waist until you are back at the starting position. Inhale as you perform this movement.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Stiff Leg Barbell Good Morning
instructions: Gunakan squat rack untuk keamanan. Atur barbel setinggi bahu, posisikan beban di pundak belakang (sedikit di bawah leher).
Pegang barbel dengan kedua tangan, angkat dari rak dengan mendorong menggunakan kaki dan tegakkan tubuh.
Maju menjauhi rak, posisikan kaki selebar bahu. Jaga pandangan ke depan dan punggung tetap lurus. Ini adalah posisi awal.
Jaga kaki tetap diam, condongkan tubuh ke depan dengan menekuk pinggul sambil menarik napas hingga tubuh sejajar dengan lantai.
Buang napas saat menegakkan kembali tubuh ke posisi awal.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang dianjurkan.
instructions_en: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To begin, first set the bar on a rack that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, step under the bar and place the back of your shoulders (slightly below the neck) across it.
Hold on to the bar using both arms at each side and lift it off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.

Step away from the rack and position your legs using a shoulder width medium stance. Keep your head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a straight back. This will be your starting position.
Keeping your legs stationary, move your torso forward by bending at the hips while inhaling. Lower your torso until it is parallel with the floor.
Begin to raise the bar as you exhale by elevating your torso back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Stomach Vacuum
instructions: Berdiri tegak dengan kaki selebar bahu dan tangan di pinggang. Ini adalah posisi awal.
Tarik napas dalam, lalu buang napas perlahan sambil menarik perut sedalam mungkin ke arah tulang belakang.
Tahan kontraksi isometrik selama sekitar 20 detik sambil tetap bernapas normal, lalu lepaskan.
Tingkatkan durasi tahanan secara bertahap hingga 40-60 detik seiring dengan kemajuan latihan.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah set yang dianjurkan.
instructions_en: To begin, stand straight with your feet shoulder width apart from each other. Place your hands on your hips. This is the starting position.

Now slowly inhale as much air as possible and then start to exhale as much as possible while bringing your stomach in as much as possible and hold this position. Try to visualize your navel touching your backbone.
One isometric contraction is around 20 seconds. During the 20 second hold, try to breathe normally. Then inhale and bring your stomach back to the starting position.
Once you have practiced this exercise, try to perform this exercise for longer than 20 seconds. Tip: You can work your way up to 40-60 seconds.
Repeat for the recommended amount of sets.

name: Straight-Arm Dumbbell Pullover
instructions: Letakkan satu dumbbell secara vertikal di atas bangku datar.

Posisikan tubuh tegak lurus dengan bangku (tubuh melintang seperti membentuk tanda silang) dengan hanya bagian bahu yang berada di atas permukaan bangku. Panggul berada di bawah bangku, lutut ditekuk dengan kaki menapak kuat di lantai, dan kepala berada di luar bangku.
Pegang dumbbell dengan kedua tangan dan posisikan lurus di atas dada dengan tangan lurus. Telapak tangan menopang bagian bawah sisi dumbbell. Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.
Jaga agar lengan tetap lurus, turunkan beban secara perlahan dalam jalur melengkung ke belakang kepala sambil menarik napas hingga Anda merasakan regangan pada dada.
Kembalikan dumbbell ke posisi awal melalui jalur melengkung yang sama sambil mengembuskan napas.
Tahan beban di posisi awal selama satu detik, lalu ulangi gerakan untuk jumlah repetisi yang ditentukan.
instructions_en: Place a dumbbell standing up on a flat bench.

Ensuring that the dumbbell stays securely placed at the top of the bench, lie perpendicular to the bench (torso across it as in forming a cross) with only your shoulders lying on the surface. Hips should be below the bench and legs bent with feet firmly on the floor. The head will be off the bench as well.

Grasp the dumbbell with both hands and hold it straight over your chest at arms length. Both palms should be pressing against the underside one of the sides of the dumbbell. This will be your starting position.
Caution: Always ensure that the dumbbell used for this exercise is secure. Using a dumbbell with loose plates can result in the dumbbell falling apart and falling on your face.
While keeping your arms straight, lower the weight slowly in an arc behind your head while breathing in until you feel a stretch on the chest.
At that point, bring the dumbbell back to the starting position using the arc through which the weight was lowered and exhale as you perform this movement.
Hold the weight on the initial position for a second and repeat the motion for the prescribed number of repetitions.

Pegang dumbbell dengan kedua tangan dan posisikan lurus di atas dada dengan tangan lurus. Telapak tangan menopang bagian bawah sisi dumbbell. Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.
Jaga agar lengan tetap lurus, turunkan beban secara perlahan dalam jalur melengkung ke belakang kepala sambil menarik napas hingga Anda merasakan regangan pada dada.
Kembalikan dumbbell ke posisi awal melalui jalur melengkung yang sama sambil mengembuskan napas.
Tahan beban di posisi awal selama satu detik, lalu ulangi gerakan untuk jumlah repetisi yang ditentukan.

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
instructions: Goh pegangan bar lebar dari katrol atas mesin pulldown dengan genggaman pronasi (telapak tangan menghadap ke bawah) yang lebih lebar dari bahu. Mundur sekitar dua kaki.
Condongkan tubuh ke depan dari pinggang sekitar 30 derajat dengan lengan lurus di depan Anda dan sedikit tekukan pada siku. Kencangkan otot latissimus dorsi Anda untuk bersiap.
Jaga lengan tetap lurus, tarik bar ke bawah dengan mengkontraksikan otot lat hingga tangan berada di samping paha. Buang napas saat melakukan gerakan ini.
Kembali ke posisi awal secara terkontrol sambil menarik napas.
Ulangi untuk jumlah repetisi yang disarankan.
instructions_en: You will start by grabbing the wide bar from the top pulley of a pulldown machine and using a wider than shoulder-width pronated (palms down) grip. Step backwards two feet or so.

Bend your torso forward at the waist by around 30-degrees with your arms fully extended in front of you and a slight bend at the elbows. If your arms are not fully extended then you need to step a bit more backwards until they are. Once your arms are fully extended and your torso is slightly bent at the waist, tighten the lats and then you are ready to begin.
While keeping the arms straight, pull the bar down by contracting the lats until your hands are next to the side of the thighs. Breathe out as you perform this step.
While keeping the arms straight, go back to the starting position while breathing in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Straight Bar Bench Mid Rows
instructions: Letakkan barbell yang sudah diberi beban di ujung bangku. Berdirilah di atas bangku di belakang bar dengan genggaman pronasi sedang. Dorong panggul ke belakang, busungkan dada, dan jaga tulang belakang tetap netral sebagai posisi awal.
Tarik bar ke arah tubuh dengan merapatkan tulang belikat dan menekuk siku. Lakukan gerakan secara terkontrol tanpa menyentak.
Setelah jeda singkat, kembalikan bar secara perlahan ke posisi awal hingga rentangan tangan penuh.
instructions_en: Place a loaded barbell on the end of a bench. Standing on the bench behind the bar, take a medium, pronated grip. Stand with your hips back and chest up, maintaining a neutral spine. This will be your starting position.
Row the bar to your torso by retracting the shoulder blades and flexing the elbows. Use a controlled movement with no jerking.
After a brief pause, slowly return the bar to the starting position, ensuring to go all the way down.

name: Straight Raises on Incline Bench
instructions: Letakkan bar di lantai di belakang bagian atas bangku miring (incline bench).
Berbaring tengkurap di atas bangku. Ambil barbell dari lantai dengan genggaman pronasi, jaga lengan tetap lurus sehingga bar menggantung ke bawah sebagai posisi awal.
Angkat barbell ke depan kepala dengan menjaga lengan tetap lurus dan terulur.
Kembali ke posisi awal.
instructions_en: Place a bar on the ground behind the head of an incline bench.
Lay on the bench face down. With a pronated grip, pick the barbell up from the floor, keeping your arms straight. Allow the bar to hang straight down. This will be your starting position.
To begin, raise the barbell out in front of your head while keeping your arms extended.
Return to the starting position.

name: Stride Jump Crossover
instructions: Berdirilah di samping box dengan satu kaki berada di atas box, dekat dengan bagian tepi.
Ayunkan tangan ke atas sambil mendorong tubuh menggunakan kaki yang berada di atas box untuk melompat setinggi mungkin, lalu angkat lutut kaki lainnya ke atas.
Mendaratlah di sisi sebaliknya dari box. Kaki yang awalnya di atas box kini berada di lantai, dan sebaliknya.
Ulangi gerakan dengan melompat kembali ke sisi semula.
instructions_en: Stand to the side of a box with your inside foot on top of it, close to the edge.
Begin by swinging the arms upward as you push through the top leg, jumping upward as high as possible. Attempt to drive the opposite knee upward.
Land in the opposite position that you started, on the opposite side of the box. The foot that was initially on the box will now be on the ground, with the opposite foot now on the box.
Repeat the movement, crossing back over to the other side.

name: Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Posisikan barbel di lantai, sejajarkan dengan bagian tengah kaki. Buka kaki selebar mungkin, dekat dengan collar barbel.

Tekuk pinggul untuk memegang barbel. Pastikan lengan tegak lurus di bawah bahu dan berada di antara kedua kaki. Gunakan pronated grip, mixed grip, atau hook grip. Rilekskan bahu agar posisi lengan lebih panjang.
Tarik napas, turunkan pinggul, busungkan dada, dan arahkan pandangan ke depan.
Dorong lantai dengan kaki yang melebar, tumpukan berat badan pada bagian belakang telapak kaki, lalu luruskan pinggul dan lutut.
Saat barbel melewati lutut, dorong pinggul ke depan ke arah barbel dan tarik tulang belikat ke belakang.
Turunkan kembali beban ke lantai dengan menekuk pinggul dan kontrol gerakan saat beban turun.
instructions_en: Begin with a bar loaded on the ground. Approach the bar so that the bar intersects the middle of the feet. The feet should be set very wide, near the collars. Bend at the hips to grip the bar. The arms should be directly below the shoulders, inside the legs, and you can use a pronated grip, a mixed grip, or hook grip. Relax the shoulders, which in effect lengthens your arms.

Take a breath, and then lower your hips, looking forward with your head with your chest up. Drive through the floor, spreading your feet apart, with your weight on the back half of your feet. Extend through the hips and knees.
As the bar passes through the knees, lean back and drive the hips into the bar, pulling your shoulder blades together.
Return the weight to the ground by bending at the hips and controlling the weight on the way down.

instructions: Pasang resistensi band pada barbel, lalu injak bagian tengah band dengan bagian belakang telapak kaki Anda.
Posisikan kaki sangat lebar, dengan barbel sejajar di tengah kaki. Tekuk pinggul untuk memegang barbel, lengan tegak lurus di bawah bahu di antara kedua kaki.
Tarik napas, turunkan pinggul, dada membusung, dan pandangan ke depan.
Dorong lantai, tumpukan berat di bagian belakang telapak kaki, lalu luruskan pinggul dan lutut.
Saat barbel melewati lutut, dorong pinggul ke arah barbel dan rapatkan tulang belikat.
Turunkan beban dengan terkontrol melalui gerakan menekuk pinggul.

instructions: Pasang rantai pada sleeves barbel atau gantungkan di tengah agar beban bertambah seiring angkatan. Pastikan ujung rantai tidak mengganggu piringan beban saat turun.
Posisikan kaki sangat lebar, barbel di tengah kaki. Tekuk pinggul untuk memegang barbel, lengan di antara kaki dengan posisi bahu rileks.
Tarik napas, turunkan pinggul, dada membusung, pandangan ke depan.
Dorong lantai, fokuskan berat pada bagian belakang kaki, lalu luruskan pinggul dan lutut.
Saat barbel melewati lutut, dorong pinggul ke depan dan rapatkan tulang belikat.
Turunkan beban ke lantai secara terkontrol dengan menekuk pinggul.
instructions_en: You can attach the chains to the sleeves of the bar, or just drape the middle over the bar so there is a greater weight increase as you lift. Attempt to keep the ends of the chains away from the plates so you don't hit them when you lower the weight.

name: Superman
instructions: Berbaringlah tengkurap di lantai dengan lengan terentang lurus ke depan.
Angkat lengan, kaki, dan dada secara bersamaan dari lantai. Tahan kontraksi selama 2 detik sambil mengembuskan napas. Kencangkan otot punggung bawah untuk hasil maksimal.
Turunkan kembali lengan, kaki, dan dada ke posisi awal secara perlahan sambil menarik napas.
Ulangi sesuai jumlah repetisi yang ditentukan.
instructions_en: To begin, lie straight and face down on the floor or exercise mat. Your arms should be fully extended in front of you. This is the starting position.

Simultaneously raise your arms, legs, and chest off of the floor and hold this contraction for 2 seconds. Tip: Squeeze your lower back to get the best results from this exercise. Remember to exhale during this movement. Note: When holding the contracted position, you should look like superman when he is flying.
Slowly begin to lower your arms, legs and chest back down to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions prescribed in your program.

name: Supine Chest Throw
instructions: Berbaring telentang dengan lutut ditekuk.
Pegang bola di dada dengan kedua tangan di bagian bawah bola.
Dorong bola ke atas dengan meluruskan siku sekuat mungkin untuk melempar bola setinggi mungkin.
Tangkap bola dengan kedua tangan saat jatuh kembali.
instructions_en: This drill is great for chest passes when you lack a partner or a wall of sufficient strength. Lay on the ground on your back with your knees bent.
Begin with the ball on your chest, held with both hands on the bottom.
Explode up, extending through the elbow to throw the ball directly above you as high as possible.
Catch the ball with both hands as it comes down.

name: Supine One-Arm Overhead Throw
instructions: Berbaring telentang di lantai dengan lutut ditekuk. Pegang bola dengan satu tangan dan luruskan lengan sepenuhnya ke belakang kepala sebagai posisi awal.
Mulai gerakan dari bahu, lempar bola ke depan sambil bangkit menjadi posisi duduk untuk mencapai jarak maksimal.
Bola dapat dilempar ke arah partner atau dipantulkan ke dinding.
instructions_en: Lay on the ground on your back with your knees bent. Hold the ball with one hand, extending the arm fully behind your head. This will be your starting position.
Initiate the movement at the shoulder, throwing the ball directly forward of you as you sit up, attempting to go for maximum distance.
The ball can be thrown to a partner or bounced off of a wall.

name: Suspended Fallout
instructions: Atur tali suspensi sehingga pegangannya berada pada ketinggian yang tepat di bawah pinggang.
Berdiri sambil memegang handle. Condongkan tubuh ke depan ke dalam tali hingga membentuk posisi incline push-up sebagai posisi awal.
Jaga lengan tetap lurus, condongkan tubuh lebih jauh ke depan mendekati lantai, biarkan bahu melakukan ekstensi dan angkat lengan lurus ke atas melewati kepala.
Pertahankan posisi tulang belakang tetap netral dan tubuh tetap lurus, dengan sendi bahu sebagai satu-satunya bagian yang bergerak.
Berhenti sejenak di puncak kontraksi, lalu kembali ke posisi awal.
instructions_en: Adjust the straps so the handles are at an appropriate height, below waist level.
Begin standing and grasping the handles. Lean into the straps, moving to an incline push-up position. This will be your starting position.
Keeping your arms straight, lean further into the suspension straps, bringing your body closer to the ground, allowing your shoulders to extend, raising your arms up and over your head.
Maintain a neutral spine and keep the rest of your body straight, your shoulders being the only joints allowed to move.
Pause during the peak contraction, and then return to the starting position.

name: Suspended Push-Up
instructions: Kaitkan tali suspensi dengan aman di bagian atas rak atau objek lainnya.
Condongkan tubuh ke depan, pegang handle di masing-masing tangan, dan ambil posisi plank push-up. Posisikan tubuh sejajar mungkin dengan lantai dengan lengan lurus dan postur tubuh yang baik.
Jaga torso tetap lurus dan kaku, lalu turunkan badan secara perlahan dengan menekuk siku.
Lanjutkan hingga siku membentuk sudut kurang dari 90 derajat, tahan sebentar, lalu dorong kembali ke posisi awal.
instructions_en: Anchor your suspension straps securely to the top of a rack or other object.

Leaning into the straps, take a handle in each hand and move into a push-up plank position. You should be as close to parallel to the ground as you can manage with your arms fully extended, maintaining good posture.
Maintaining a straight, rigid torso, descend slowly by allowing the elbows to flex.
Continue until your elbows break 90 degrees, pausing before you extend to return to the starting position.

name: Suspended Reverse Crunch
instructions: Pasang tali suspensi dengan handle menggantung sekitar satu kaki dari lantai. Ambil posisi plank push-up dengan membelakangi anchor point.
Masukkan kaki ke dalam handle. Jaga postur tubuh tetap lurus dan pastikan pinggul tidak turun sebagai posisi awal.
Mulai gerakan dengan menekuk lutut dan pinggul, tarik lutut ke arah dada. Saat melakukannya, miringkan panggul ke depan dan tekuk tulang belakang.
Pada titik tertinggi dengan gerakan terkontrol, kembali ke posisi awal.
instructions_en: Secure a set of suspension straps with the handles hanging about a foot off of the ground. Move yourself into a pushup plank position facing away from the rack.
Place your feet into the handles. You should maintain a straight posture, not allowing the hips to sag. This will be your starting position.
Begin the movement by flexing the knees and hips, drawing the knees to your torso. As you do so, anteriorly tilt your pelvis, allowing your spine to flex.
At the top of the controlled motion, return to the starting position.

name: Suspended Row
instructions: Atur strap setinggi dada. Pegang handle dengan kedua tangan, lalu condongkan tubuh ke belakang. Pastikan tubuh tegak, kepala dan dada membusung, serta lengan terentang lurus sebagai posisi awal.
Tekuk siku untuk memulai gerakan. Tarik tulang belikat (protraksi) saat Anda menarik tubuh ke atas.
Tahan sejenak di puncak gerakan, lalu kembali ke posisi awal secara terkontrol.
instructions_en: Suspend your straps at around chest height. Take a handle in each hand and lean back. Keep your body erect and your head and chest up. Your arms should be fully extended. This will be your starting position.
Begin by flexing the elbow to initiate the movement. Protract your shoulder blades as you do so.
At the completion of the motion pause, and then return to the starting position.

name: Suspended Split Squat
instructions: Atur strap sehingga handle berada 45-75 cm dari lantai.
Membelakangi alat, masukkan satu kaki ke dalam handle. Jaga kepala menghadap ke depan, dada membusung, dan lutut kaki tumpu sedikit menekuk sebagai posisi awal.
Turunkan tubuh dengan menekuk lutut dan pinggul. Tumpukan beban pada tumit dan jaga postur tubuh tetap tegak.
Dorong tubuh kembali ke posisi awal dengan meluruskan pinggul dan lutut.
instructions_en: Suspend your straps so the handles are 18-30 inches from the floor.
Facing away from the setup, place your rear foot into the handle behind you. Keep your head looking forward and your chest up, with your knee slightly bent. This will be your starting position.
Descend by flexing the knee and hips, lowering yourself to the ground. Keep your weight on the heel of your foot and maintain your posture throughout the exercise.
At the bottom of the movement, reverse the motion, extending through the hip and knee to return to the starting position.
instructions_id: Atur strap sehingga handle berada 45-75 cm dari lantai.
Membelakangi alat, masukkan satu kaki ke dalam handle. Jaga kepala menghadap ke depan, dada membusung, dan lutut kaki tumpu sedikit menekuk sebagai posisi awal.
Turunkan tubuh dengan menekuk lutut dan pinggul. Tumpukan beban pada tumit dan jaga postur tubuh tetap tegak.
Dorong tubuh kembali ke posisi awal dengan meluruskan pinggul dan lutut.

name: Svend Press
instructions: Berdiri tegak.
Tekan dua piringan beban ringan bersama-sama di depan dada. Jaga jari-jari menghadap ke depan untuk mengaktifkan kontraksi otot dada sebagai posisi awal.
Tetap tekan kedua piringan dengan telapak tangan, lalu dorong lengan lurus ke depan secara terkontrol.
Tahan sejenak di posisi terjauh, lalu kembali perlahan ke posisi awal.
instructions_en: Begin in a standing position.

Press two lightweight plates together with your hands. Hold the plates together close to your chest to create an isometric contraction in your chest muscles. Your fingers should be pointed forward. This is your starting position.
Squeeze the plates between your palms and extend your arms directly out in front of you in a controlled motion.
Pause at the top of the motion, and then slowly return to the starting position.

name: T-Bar Row with Handle
instructions: Pasang barbel pada landmine atau sudut dinding agar tidak bergeser, lalu pasang beban yang sesuai.
Berdirilah di atas barbel, pasang handle Double D pada ujung barbel. Gunakan kekuatan kaki dan pinggul untuk mengangkat beban hingga posisi berdiri.
Buka kaki selebar bahu, dorong pinggul ke belakang, dan busungkan dada. Pastikan lengan terentang lurus sebagai posisi awal.
Tarik beban ke arah perut atas dengan menarik tulang belikat dan menekuk siku. Hindari mengayunkan tubuh.
Tahan sejenak di puncak gerakan, lalu kembali ke posisi awal.
instructions_en: Position a bar into a landmine or in a corner to keep it from moving. Load an appropriate weight onto your end.
Stand over the bar, and position a Double D row handle around the bar next to the collar. Using your hips and legs, rise to a standing position.
Assume a wide stance with your hips back and your chest up. Your arms should be extended. This will be your starting position.
Pull the weight to your upper abdomen by retracting the shoulder blades and flexing the elbows. Do not jerk the weight or cheat during the movement.
After a brief pause, return to the starting position.

name: Tate Press
instructions: Berbaring di bangku datar dengan memegang dumbbell di atas paha.
Angkat dumbbell ke atas bahu. Posisikan lengan lebih lebar dari bahu dengan telapak tangan menghadap ke depan dan siku mengarah ke luar sebagai posisi awal.
Jaga lengan atas tetap diam, turunkan dumbbell perlahan dalam gerakan melengkung hingga menyentuh dada bagian atas sambil menarik napas.
Hembuskan napas, dorong dumbbell ke atas menggunakan otot trisep dengan gerakan melengkung yang sama hingga lengan lurus. Tahan sejenak di puncak gerakan.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang ditentukan.
instructions_en: Lie down on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand on top of your thighs. The palms of your hand will be facing each other.

By using your thighs to help you get the dumbbells up, clean the dumbbells one arm at a time so that you can hold them in front of you at shoulder width. Note: when holding the dumbbells in front of you, make sure your arms are wider than shoulder width apart from each other using a pronated (palms forward) grip. Allow your elbows to point out. This is your starting position.

Keeping the upper arms stationary, slowly move the dumbbells in and down in a semi circular motion until they touch the upper chest while inhaling. Keep full control of the dumbbells at all times and do not move the upper arms nor rest the dumbbells on the chest.

As you breathe out, move the dumbbells up using your triceps and the same semi-circular motion but in reverse. Attempt to keep the dumbbells together as they move up. Lock your arms in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down again slowly again. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions of your training program.

name: The Straddle
instructions: Mulai dengan posisi duduk tegak, lalu rentangkan kedua kaki ke depan membentuk huruf V.
Letakkan tangan di lantai, condongkan badan ke depan sejauh mungkin. Tahan selama 10 hingga 20 detik.
instructions_en: Begin in a seated, upright position. Start by extending your legs in front of you in a V.
With your hands on the floor, lean forward as far as possible. Hold for 10 to 20 seconds.
instructions_id: Mulai dengan posisi duduk tegak, lalu rentangkan kedua kaki ke depan membentuk huruf V.

name: Thigh Abductor
instructions: Duduklah pada mesin abduktor dan pilih beban yang nyaman. Letakkan kaki dengan benar pada posisinya, lalu pegang handle di kedua sisi. Jaga seluruh tubuh bagian atas (dari pinggang ke atas) tetap stabil. Ini adalah posisi awal.
Dorong mesin perlahan menggunakan kedua kaki untuk menjauhkan satu sama lain sambil menghembuskan napas.
Rasakan kontraksi otot selama sedetik, lalu kembali ke posisi awal sambil menarik napas. Catatan: Jaga tubuh bagian atas tetap stabil untuk mencegah cedera.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang dianjurkan.
instructions_en: To begin, sit down on the abductor machine and select a weight you are comfortable with. When your legs are positioned properly, grip the handles on each side. Your entire upper body (from the waist up) should be stationary. This is the starting position.
Slowly press against the machine with your legs to move them away from each other while exhaling.

Feel the contraction for a second and begin to move your legs back to the starting position while breathing in. Note: Remember to keep your upper body stationary to prevent any injuries from occurring.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Thigh Adductor
instructions: Duduklah pada mesin adduktor dan pilih beban yang nyaman. Posisikan kaki dengan benar pada bantalan mesin, lalu pegang handle di kedua sisi. Jaga seluruh tubuh bagian atas (dari pinggang ke atas) tetap stabil. Ini adalah posisi awal.
Dorong mesin perlahan menggunakan kedua kaki untuk mendekatkan satu sama lain sambil menghembuskan napas.
Rasakan kontraksi otot selama sedetik, lalu kembalikan kaki ke posisi awal sambil menarik napas. Catatan: Jaga tubuh tetap stabil dan hindari gerakan menyentak yang cepat untuk mencegah cedera.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang dianjurkan.

When your legs are positioned properly on the leg pads of the machine, grip the handles on each side. Your entire upper body (from the waist up) should be stationary. This is the starting position.
Slowly press against the machine with your legs to move them towards each other while exhaling.

Feel the contraction for a second and begin to move your legs back to the starting position while breathing in. Note: Remember to keep your upper body stationary and avoid fast jerking motions in order to prevent any injuries from occurring.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Tire Flip
instructions: Pegang bagian bawah ban pada permukaannya, posisikan kaki sedikit mundur. Tekan dada ke arah ban.
Untuk mengangkat ban, dorong pinggul, lutut, dan pergelangan kaki secara bersamaan ke arah atas dan depan.

Saat ban mencapai sudut 45 derajat, melangkahlah ke depan dan dorong lutut ke arah ban. Ubah genggaman ke bagian atas ban, lalu dorong ke depan sekuat tenaga untuk menyelesaikanbalikkan ban. Ulangi sesuai kebutuhan.
instructions_en: Begin by gripping the bottom of the tire on the tread, and position your feet back a bit. Your chest should be driving into the tire.
To lift the tire, extend through the hips, knees, and ankles, driving into the tire and up.

As the tire reaches a 45 degree angle, step forward and drive a knee into the tire. As you do so adjust your grip to the upper portion of the tire and push it forward as hard as possible to complete the turn. Repeat as necessary.

name: Toe Touchers
instructions: Berbaringlah di lantai atau matras dengan punggung rata menempel di lantai. Letakkan tangan di samping badan dengan telapak tangan menghadap ke bawah.
Rapatkan kedua kaki, lalu angkat perlahan ke udara hingga hampir tegak lurus dengan lantai dengan sedikit tekukan pada lutut. Posisi telapak kaki sejajar dengan lantai.
Rentangkan kedua lengan hingga membentuk sudut 45 derajat dari lantai. Ini adalah posisi awal.
Dengan menjaga punggung bawah tetap menempel di lantai, angkat tubuh bagian atas secara perlahan dan raih ujung jari kaki dengan tangan. Hmbuskan napas saat melakukan gerakan ini.
Turunkan kembali tubuh dan lengan secara perlahan ke posisi awal sambil menarik napas. Pastikan lengan tetap lurus mengarah ke ujung kaki.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang dianjurkan.
instructions_en: To begin, lie down on the floor or an exercise mat with your back pressed against the floor. Your arms should be lying across your sides with the palms facing down.

Your legs should be touching each other. Slowly elevate your legs up in the air until they are almost perpendicular to the floor with a slight bend at the knees. Your feet should be parallel to the floor.
Move your arms so that they are fully extended at a 45 degree angle from the floor. This is the starting position.
While keeping your lower back pressed against the floor, slowly lift your torso and use your hands to try and touch your toes. Remember to exhale while perform this part of the exercise.
Slowly begin to lower your torso and arms back down to the starting position while inhaling. Remember to keep your arms straight out pointing towards your toes.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Torso Rotation
instructions: Berdiri tegak sambil memegang bola latihan dengan kedua tangan. Luruskan lengan ke depan dada sebagai posisi awal.
Putar batang tubuh ke satu sisi dengan pandangan tetap mengikuti arah bola. Putar kembali ke sisi berlawanan. Ulangi 10-20 repetisi.
instructions_en: Stand upright holding an exercise ball with both hands. Extend your arms so the ball is straight out in front of you. This will be your starting position.
Rotate your torso to one side, keeping your eyes on the ball as you move. Now, rotate back to the opposite direction. Repeat for 10-20 repetitions.
instructions_id: Berdiri tegak sambil memegang bola latihan dengan kedua tangan. Luruskan lengan ke depan dada sebagai posisi awal.

name: Trail Running/Walking
instructions: Berlari atau mendaki di jalur setapak akan memacu detak jantung dengan cepat. Pastikan menggunakan alas kaki yang sesuai.
Saat mendaki, otot betis dan bokong bekerja menarik tubuh ke atas. Saat turun, lutut, sendi, dan pergelangan kaki meredam beban terbesar.
Gunakan langkah pendek saat berjalan menurun, jaga lutut tetap sedikit menekuk untuk meredam impak, dan kurangi kecepatan guna menghindari risiko jatuh.
instructions_en: Running or hiking on trails will get the blood pumping and heart beating almost immediately. Make sure you have good shoes. While you use the muscles in your calves and buttocks to pull yourself up a hill, the knees, joints and ankles absorb the bulk of the pounding coming back down. Take smaller steps as you walk downhill, keep your knees bent to reduce the impact and slow down to avoid falling.
A 150 lb person can burn over 200 calories for 30 minutes walking uphill, compared to 175 on a flat surface. If running the trail, a 150 lb person can burn well over 500 calories in 30 minutes.

name: Trap Bar Deadlift
instructions: Posisikan beban yang sesuai pada trap bar di lantai. Berdirilah di tengah alat dan genggam kedua pegangan.
Turunkan pinggul, arahkan pandangan ke depan, dan busungkan dada.
Awali gerakan dengan menekan tumit ke lantai sambil meluruskan pinggul dan lutut. Pastikan punggung tetap tegak dan tidak melengkung.
Setelah mencapai posisi berdiri tegak, turunkan kembali beban ke lantai secara terkontrol.
instructions_en: For this exercise load a trap bar, also known as a hex bar, to an appropriate weight resting on the ground. Stand in the center of the apparatus and grasp both handles.
Lower your hips, look forward with your head and keep your chest up.
Begin the movement by driving through the heels and extend your hips and knees. Avoid rounding your back at all times.
At the completion of the movement, lower the weight back to the ground under control.

name: Tricep Dumbbell Kickback
instructions: Pegang dumbbell dengan telapak tangan menghadap ke dalam. Tekuk lutut sedikit, condongkan tubuh ke depan hingga punggung sejajar lantai, dan jaga pandangan tetap ke depan.
Tempelkan lengan atas di samping tubuh hingga membentuk sudut 90 derajat dengan lengan bawah.
Keluarkan napas, fokuskan gerakan pada lengan bawah untuk meluruskan lengan ke belakang dengan mengunci posisi lengan atas.
Tahan sejenak saat otot tricep berkontraksi, lalu tarik napas dan turunkan dumbbell perlahan ke posisi awal. Ulangi sesuai repetisi.
instructions_en: Start with a dumbbell in each hand and your palms facing your torso. Keep your back straight with a slight bend in the knees and bend forward at the waist. Your torso should be almost parallel to the floor. Make sure to keep your head up. Your upper arms should be close to your torso and parallel to the floor. Your forearms should be pointed towards the floor as you hold the weights. There should be a 90-degree angle formed between your forearm and upper arm. This is your starting position.
Now, while keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and use your triceps to lift the weights until the arm is fully extended. Focus on moving the forearm.
After a brief pause at the top contraction, inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.

name: Tricep Side Stretch
instructions: Bawa lengan kanan menyilang di depan dada ke arah bahu kiri, tarik siku dengan tangan kiri hingga terasa tarikan pada otot tricep. Ulangi untuk sisi sebaliknya.
instructions_en: Bring right arm across your body and over your left shoulder, holding your elbow with your left hand, until you feel a stretch in your tricep. Then repeat for your other arm.

name: Triceps Overhead Extension with Rope
instructions: Pasang tali pada katrol bawah. Pilih beban yang sesuai, pegang tali dengan kedua tangan, dan posisikan tubuh membelakangi mesin kabel.

Letakkan tangan di belakang kepala dengan siku mengarah lurus ke atas dan sedikit menekuk. Ambil posisi kuda-kuda (kaki selangkah di depan) dan condongkan tubuh sedikit menjauh dari mesin untuk stabilitas. Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.
Lakukan gerakan dengan meluruskan siku sambil menjaga posisi lengan atas tetap, lalu angkat tangan ke atas kepala.
Kontraksikan otot trika (triceps) di puncak gerakan, lalu turunkan beban secara perlahan kembali ke posisi awal.
instructions_en: Attach a rope to a low pulley. After selecting an appropriate weight, grasp the rope with both hands and face away from the cable.

Position your hands behind your head with your elbows point straight up. Your elbows should start out flexed, and you can stagger your stance and lean gently away from the machine to create greater stability. This will be your starting position.
To perform the movement, extend through the elbow while keeping the upper arm in position, raising your hands above your head.
Squeeze your triceps at the top of the movement, and slowly lower the weight back to the start position.
