name: Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Pasang stbar lurus atau bengkok pada katrol atas, lalu pegang dengan genggaman menghadap ke bawah (overhand) selebar bahu.

Berdirilah tegak dengan torso lurus dan condongkan tubuh sedikit ke depan. Rapatkan lengan atas ke sisi tubuh dan posisikan tegak lurus dengan lantai. Lengan bawah mengarah ke atas menuju katrol. Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.

Gunakan otot tricep untuk mendorong bar ke bawah hingga menyentuh bagian depan paha dan lengan lurus sempurna tegak lurus dengan lantai. Lengan atas harus tetap diam di samping torso dan hanya lengan bawah yang bergerak. Hembuskan napas saat melakukan gerakan ini.
Tahan selama satu detik di posisi kontraksi, lalu kembalikan bar secara perlahan ke posisi awal sambil menarik napas.
Ulangi gerakan ini sesuai jumlah repetisi yang dianjurkan.
instructions_en: Attach a straight or angled bar to a high pulley and grab with an overhand grip (palms facing down) at shoulder width.

Standing upright with the torso straight and a very small inclination forward, bring the upper arms close to your body and perpendicular to the floor. The forearms should be pointing up towards the pulley as they hold the bar. This is your starting position.

Using the triceps, bring the bar down until it touches the front of your thighs and the arms are fully extended perpendicular to the floor. The upper arms should always remain stationary next to your torso and only the forearms should move. Exhale as you perform this movement.
After a second hold at the contracted position, bring the bar slowly up to the starting point. Breathe in as you perform this step.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Triceps Pushdown - Rope Attachment
instructions: Pasang lampiran tali (rope) pada katrol atas dan pegang dengan genggaman netral (telapak tangan saling berhadapan).

Berdirilah tegak dengan torso lurus dan condongkan tubuh sedikit ke depan. Rapatkan lengan atas ke sisi tubuh dan tegak lurus dengan lantai. Lengan bawah mengarah ke atas menuju katrol sambil memegang tali. Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.

Gunakan otot tricep untuk menarik tali ke bawah hingga masing-masing sisi tali berada di samping paha. Di akhir gerakan, lengan lurus sempurna dan tegak lurus dengan lantai. Lengan atas tetap diam di samping torso dan hanya lengan bawah yang bergerak. Hembuskan napas saat mendorong.
Tahan selama satu detik pada posisi kontraksi, lalu bawa tali kembali ke posisi awal secara perlahan sambil menarik napas.
Ulangi gerakan ini sesuai jumlah repetisi yang dianjurkan.
instructions_en: Attach a rope attachment to a high pulley and grab with a neutral grip (palms facing each other).

Standing upright with the torso straight and a very small inclination forward, bring the upper arms close to your body and perpendicular to the floor. The forearms should be pointing up towards the pulley as they hold the rope with the palms facing each other. This is your starting position.

Using the triceps, bring the rope down as you bring each side of the rope to the side of your thighs. At the end of the movement the arms are fully extended and perpendicular to the floor. The upper arms should always remain stationary next to your torso and only the forearms should move. Exhale as you perform this movement.
After holding for a second, at the contracted position, bring the rope slowly up to the starting point. Breathe in as you perform this step.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

instructions: Pasang V-Bar pada katrol atas dan pegang dengan genggaman overhand (telapak tangan menghadap ke bawah) selebar bahu.

Berdirilah tegak dengan torso lurus dan condongkan tubuh sedikit ke depan. Rapatkan lengan atas ke sisi tubuh dan tegak lurus dengan lantai. Lengan bawah mengarah ke atas menuju katrol. Ibu jari berada lebih tinggi dari kelingking. Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.

Gunakan otot tricep untuk menurunkan bar hingga menyentuh bagian depan paha dan lengan lurus sempurna tegak lurus dengan lantai. Lengan atas tetap diam di samping torso dan hanya lengan bawah yang bergerak. Hembuskan napas saat mendorong ke bawah.
Tahan selama satu detik pada posisi kontraksi, lalu bawa V-Bar kembali ke posisi awal secara perlahan sambil menarik napas.
Ulangi gerakan ini sesuai jumlah repetisi yang dianjurkan.
instructions_en: Attach a V-Bar to a high pulley and grab with an overhand grip (palms facing down) at shoulder width.

Standing upright with the torso straight and a very small inclination forward, bring the upper arms close to your body and perpendicular to the floor. The forearms should be pointing up towards the pulley as they hold the bar. The thumbs should be higher than the small finger. This is your starting position.

Using the triceps, bring the bar down until it touches the front of your thighs and the arms are fully extended perpendicular to the floor. The upper arms should always remain stationary next to your torso and only the forearms should move. Exhale as you perform this movement.
After a second hold at the contracted position, bring the V-Bar slowly up to the starting point. Breathe in as you perform this step.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Triceps Stretch
instructions: Julurkan tangan ke belakang kepala, pegang siku, dan tarik secara perlahan. Tahan selama 10 hingga 20 detik, lalu ganti sisi.
instructions_en: Reach your hand behind your head, grasp your elbow and gently pull. Hold for 10 to 20 seconds, then switch sides.
instructions_id: Julurkan tangan ke belakang kepala, pegang siku, dan tarik secara perlahan. Tahan selama 10 hingga 20 detik, lalu ganti sisi.

name: Tuck Crunch
instructions: Berbaring telentang di lantai atau matras dengan punggung bawah menempel rata di lantai. Letakkan tangan di samping tubuh dengan telapak tangan menghadap ke bawah.
Silangkan pergelangan kaki satu sama lain. Angkat kaki perlahan hingga paha tegak lurus dengan lantai, dengan lutut sedikit ditekuk.
Pindahkan tangan dari lantai dan silangkan di depan dada. Ini adalah posisi awal.
Sambil menjaga punggung bawah tetap menempel di lantai, angkat tubuh bagian atas (torso) secara perlahan. Buang napas saat melakukan gerakan ini.
Kembalikan tubuh ke posisi awal secara perlahan sambil menarik napas.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang disarankan.
instructions_en: To begin, lie down on the floor or an exercise mat with your back pressed against the floor. Your arms should be lying across your sides with the palms facing down.

Your legs should be crossed by wrapping one ankle around the other. Slowly elevate your legs up in the air until your thighs are perpendicular to the floor with a slight bend at the knees. Note: Your knees and toes should be parallel to the floor as opposed to the thighs.
Move your arms from the floor and cross them so they are resting on your chest. This is the starting position.
While keeping your lower back pressed against the floor, slowly lift your torso. Remember to exhale while perform this part of the exercise.
Slowly begin to lower your torso back down to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang disarankan.

name: Two-Arm Dumbbell Preacher Curl
instructions: Pegang dumbbell dengan kedua tangan dan posisikan lengan atas di atas bangku preacher atau incline bench. Posisikan dumbbell sejajar bahu sebagai posisi awal.
Tarik napas dan turunkan dumbbell perlahan hingga lengan atas teregang sepenuhnya.
Buang napas dan gunakan otot bisep untuk mengangkat beban hingga berkontraksi penuh dan dumbbell berada setinggi bahu.
Remas otot bisep sejenak pada posisi kontraksi maksimal, lalu ulangi sesuai jumlah repetisi.
instructions_en: Grab a dumbbell with each arm and place the upper arms on top of the preacher bench or the incline bench. The dumbbell should be held at shoulder length. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe in, slowly lower the dumbbells until your upper arm is extended and the biceps is fully stretched.
As you exhale, use the biceps to curl the weights up until your biceps is fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder height.
Squeeze the biceps hard for a second at the contracted position and repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_id: Pegang dumbbell dengan kedua tangan dan posisikan lengan atas di atas bangku preacher atau incline bench. Posisikan dumbbell sejajar bahu sebagai posisi awal.

name: Two-Arm Kettlebell Clean
instructions: Letakkan dua kettlebell di antara kedua kaki. Posisikan tubuh dengan mendorong pinggul ke belakang dan pandangan lurus ke depan.
Angkat kettlebell ke bahu dengan menggerakkan kaki dan pinggul secara eksplosif. Putar pergelangan tangan saat beban naik menuju bahu.
Turunkan kembali kettlebell ke posisi awal dan ulangi gerakan.
instructions_en: Place two kettlebells between your feet. To get in the starting position, push your butt back and look straight ahead.
Clean the kettlebells to your shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you raise the kettlebells towards your shoulders. Rotate your wrists as you do so.
Lower the kettlebells back to the starting position and repeat.
instructions_id: Letakkan dua kettlebell di antara kedua kaki. Posisikan tubuh dengan mendorong pinggul ke belakang dan pandangan lurus ke depan.
Angkat kettlebell ke bahu dengan menggerakkan kaki dan pinggul secara eksplosif. Putar pergelangan tangan saat beban naik menuju bahu.
Turunkan kembali kettlebell ke posisi awal dan ulangi gerakan.

name: Two-Arm Kettlebell Jerk
instructions: Lakukan gerakan clean untuk membawa dua kettlebell ke posisi bahu dengan memanfaatkan dorongan kaki dan pinggul. Putar pergelangan tangan hingga telapak tangan menghadap ke depan.
Tekuk lutut sedikit, lalu dorong kettlebell ke atas kepala secara cepat. Segera jongkok kembali untuk menerima beban di bawah, kunci posisi lengan, lalu berdiri tegak untuk menyelesaikan repetisi.
instructions_en: Clean two kettlebells to your shoulders. Clean the kettlebells to your shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you swing the kettlebells towards your shoulders. Rotate your wrists as you do so, so that the palms face forward. Squat down a few inches and reverse the motion rapidly driving both kettlebells overhead. Immediately after the initial push, squat down again and get under the kettlebells. Once the kettlebells are locked out, stand upright to complete the exercise.
instructions_id: Lakukan gerakan clean untuk membawa dua kettlebell ke posisi bahu dengan memanfaatkan dorongan kaki dan pinggul. Putar pergelangan tangan hingga telapak tangan menghadap ke depan.

name: Two-Arm Kettlebell Military Press
instructions: Lakukan gerakan clean untuk membawa dua kettlebell ke posisi bahu dengan memanfaatkan dorongan kaki dan pinggul. Putar pergelangan tangan hingga telapak tangan menghadap ke depan.

Dorong kettlebell ke atas dan ke luar. Saat beban melewati kepala, condongkan tubuh sedikit ke depan agar beban berada di belakang garis kepala. Pastikan otot lat, bokong, dan perut tetap kencang untuk stabilitas.
instructions_en: Clean two kettlebells to your shoulders. Clean the kettlebells to your shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you swing the kettlebells towards your shoulders. Rotate your wrists as you do so, so that the palms face forward.

Press the kettlebells up and out. As the kettlebells pass your head, lean into the weights so that the kettlebells are racked behind your head. Make sure to contract your lats, butt, and stomach for added stability.
instructions_id: Lakukan gerakan clean untuk membawa dua kettlebell ke posisi bahu dengan memanfaatkan dorongan kaki dan pinggul. Putar pergelangan tangan hingga telapak tangan menghadap ke depan.

name: Two-Arm Kettlebell Row
instructions: Letakkan dua kettlebell di depan kaki. Tekuk lutut sedikit, dorong bokong ke belakang sejauh mungkin saat membungkuk untuk mengambil posisi awal.
Pegang kedua kettlebell, tarik ke arah perut dengan merapatkan belikat dan menekuk siku. Jaga punggung tetap lurus. Turunkan dan ulangi.
instructions_en: Place two kettlebells in front of your feet. Bend your knees slightly and then push your butt out as much as possible as you bend over to get in the starting position.
Grab both kettlebells and pull them to your stomach, retracting your shoulder blades and flexing the elbows. Keep your back straight. Lower and repeat.
instructions_id: Letakkan dua kettlebell di depan kaki. Tekuk lutut sedikit, dorong bokong ke belakang sejauh mungkin saat membungkuk untuk mengambil posisi awal.

name: Underhand Cable Pulldowns
instructions: Duduk pada mesin lat pulldown dengan bar panjang pada katrol atas. Atur bantalan lutut agar pas untuk mencegah tubuh terangkat oleh beban.
Genggam bar dengan telapak tangan menghadap ke arah tubuh (supinasi) dengan posisi tangan lebih sempit dari lebar bahu.
Dengan lengan lurus memegang bar, condongkan tubuh ke belakang sekitar 30 derajat, lengkungkan sedikit punggung bawah, dan busungkan dada. Ini posisi awal Anda.

Buang napas, tarik bar hingga menyentuh dada atas dengan mengarahkan bahu dan lengan atas ke bawah dan ke belakang. Tips: Fokus meremas otot punggung di posisi kontraksi penuh dan jaga siku tetap dekat dengan tubuh. Torso tidak bergerak dan hanya lengan yang bergerak.
Tahan sedetik di posisi kontraksi, tarik napas, lalu kembalikan bar secara perlahan ke posisi awal saat lengan lurus penuh.
Ulangi gerakan ini sesuai jumlah repetisi yang ditentukan.
instructions_en: Sit down on a pull-down machine with a wide bar attached to the top pulley. Adjust the knee pad of the machine to fit your height. These pads will prevent your body from being raised by the resistance attached to the bar.
Grab the pull-down bar with the palms facing your torso (a supinated grip). Make sure that the hands are placed closer than the shoulder width.

As you have both arms extended in front of you holding the bar at the chosen grip width, bring your torso back around 30 degrees or so while creating a curvature on your lower back and sticking your chest out. This is your starting position.

As you breathe out, pull the bar down until it touches your upper chest by drawing the shoulders and the upper arms down and back. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing the back muscles once you reach the fully contracted position and keep the elbows close to your body. The upper torso should remain stationary as your bring the bar to you and only the arms should move. The forearms should do no other work other than hold the bar.
After a second on the contracted position, while breathing in, slowly bring the bar back to the starting position when your arms are fully extended and the lats are fully stretched.
Repeat this motion for the prescribed amount of repetitions.

name: Upper Back-Leg Grab
instructions: Dalam posisi duduk, bungkukkan badan ke depan dan rangkul paha dari bawah dengan kedua lengan.
Rapatkan lutut dan luruskan kaki saat merapatkan dada ke lutut. Anda juga bisa meregangkan punggung tengah dengan menarik punggung menjauh dari lutut sambil merangkulnya.
instructions_en: While seated, bend forward to hug your thighs from underneath with both arms.
Keep your knees together and your legs extended out as you bring your chest down to your knees. You can also stretch your middle back by pulling your back away from your knees as your hugging them.
instructions_id: Dalam posisi duduk, bungkukkan badan ke depan dan rangkul paha dari bawah dengan kedua lengan.

name: Upper Back Stretch
instructions: Jalin jari-jari tangan dengan ibu jari mengarah ke bawah, bulatkan bahu sambil mendorong tangan ke depan.
instructions_en: Clasp fingers together with your thumbs pointing down, round your shoulders as you reach your hands forward.

name: Upright Barbell Row
instructions: Genggam barbell dengan overhand grip sedikit lebih sempit dari lebar bahu. Posisi bar di atas paha dengan lengan lurus dan siku sedikit ditekuk. Punggung tegak lurus. Ini posisi awal Anda.

Hembuskan napas, gunakan sisi bahu untuk mengangkat bar dengan menarik siku ke atas dan ke samping. Jaga bar tetap dekat dengan tubuh. Angkat hingga hampir menyentuh dagu. Tips: Siku harus memimpin gerakan dan selalu berada lebih tinggi dari lengan bawah. Jaga torso tetap stabil dan tahan sedetik di atas.
Turunkan bar secara perlahan ke posisi awal sambil menarik napas.
Ulangi sesuai jumlah repetisi yang dianjurkan.
instructions_en: Grasp a barbell with an overhand grip that is slightly less than shoulder width. The bar should be resting on the top of your thighs with your arms extended and a slight bend in your elbows. Your back should also be straight. This will be your starting position.

Now exhale and use the sides of your shoulders to lift the bar, raising your elbows up and to the side. Keep the bar close to your body as you raise it. Continue to lift the bar until it nearly touches your chin. Tip: Your elbows should drive the motion, and should always be higher than your forearms. Remember to keep your torso stationary and pause for a second at the top of the movement.
Lower the bar back down slowly to the starting position. Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Upright Cable Row
instructions: Pegang batang lurus pada katrol bawah dengan genggaman pronasi (telapak tangan menghadap paha) selebar bahu. Posisikan batang di atas paha dengan lengan lurus namun sedikit menekuk di siku, dan jaga punggung tetap tegak.

Gunakan otot bahu samping untuk menarik batang ke atas sambil mengembuskan napas. Jaga batang tetap dekat dengan tubuh hingga hampir menyentuh dagu. Pastikan siku tetap memimpin gerakan dan selalu berada lebih tinggi dari lengan bawah. Jaga torso tetap diam dan tahan selama satu detik di titik puncak.
Turunkan kembali batang secara perlahan ke posisi awal sambil menarik napas.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang disarankan.
instructions_en: Grasp a straight bar cable attachment that is attached to a low pulley with a pronated (palms facing your thighs) grip that is slightly less than shoulder width. The bar should be resting on top of your thighs. Your arms should be extended with a slight bend at the elbows and your back should be straight. This will be your starting position.

Use your side shoulders to lift the cable bar as you exhale. The bar should be close to the body as you move it up. Continue to lift it until it nearly touches your chin. Tip: Your elbows should drive the motion. As you lift the bar, your elbows should always be higher than your forearms. Also, keep your torso stationary and pause for a second at the top of the movement.
Lower the bar back down slowly to the starting position. Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Upright Row - With Bands
instructions: Berdiri di atas resistance band dengan posisi tangan lurus. Pegang handle dengan genggaman pronasi (telapak tangan menghadap paha) selebar bahu dan letakkan di atas paha. Pastikan lengan lurus dengan siku sedikit menekuk serta punggung tegak.

Gunakan otot bahu samping untuk menarik handle ke atas sambil mengembuskan napas. Jaga handle tetap dekat dengan tubuh hingga hampir menyentuh dagu. Pastikan siku tetap memimpin gerakan dan selalu lebih tinggi dari lengan bawah. Jaga torso tetap diam dan tahan selama satu detik di titik puncak.
Turunkan kembali handle secara perlahan ke posisi awal sambil menarik napas.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang disarankan.
instructions_en: To begin, stand on an exercise band so that tension begins at arm's length. Grasp the handles using a pronated (palms facing your thighs) grip that is slightly less than shoulder width. The handles should be resting on top of your thighs. Your arms should be extended with a slight bend at the elbows and your back should be straight. This will be your starting position.

Use your side shoulders to lift the handles as you exhale. The handles should be close to the body as you move them up. Continue to lift the handles until they nearly touches your chin. Tip: Your elbows should drive the motion. As you lift the handles, your elbows should always be higher than your forearms. Also, keep your torso stationary and pause for a second at the top of the movement.
Lower the handles back down slowly to the starting position. Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Turunkan kembali handle secara perlahan ke posisi awal sambil menarik napas.

name: Upward Stretch
instructions: Angkat kedua tangan lurus ke atas kepala dengan telapak tangan saling bersentuhan.
Dorong tangan ke atas dan sedikit ke belakang secara perlahan dengan menjaga punggung tetap tegak.
instructions_en: Extend both hands straight above your head, palms touching.
Slowly push your hands up and back, keeping your back straight.
instructions_id: Angkat kedua tangan lurus ke atas kepala dengan telapak tangan saling bersentuhan.
Dorong tangan ke atas dan sedikit ke belakang secara perlahan dengan menjaga punggung tetap tegak.

name: V-Bar Pulldown
instructions: Duduk pada mesin lat pulldown yang dilengkapi V-bar pada katrol atas.
Sesuaikan bantalan lutut agar pas dengan tinggi badan guna menahan posisi tubuh tetap stabil.
Pegang V-bar dengan posisi telapak tangan saling berhadapan (genggaman netral). Busungkan dada dan condongkan tubuh sedikit ke belakang (sekitar 30 derajat) untuk memaksimalkan kontraksi otot lat.
Tarik V-bar ke bawah dengan mengaktifkan otot lat dan remas otot belikat sambil mengembuskan napas. Terus tarik hingga dada hampir menyentuh V-bar. Jaga torso tetap diam selama gerakan.
Tahan selama satu detik di posisi kontraksi, lalu kembalikan batang ke posisi awal secara perlahan sambil menarik napas.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang ditentukan.
instructions_en: Sit down on a pull-down machine with a V-Bar attached to the top pulley.
Adjust the knee pad of the machine to fit your height. These pads will prevent your body from being raised by the resistance attached to the bar.

Grab the V-bar with the palms facing each other (a neutral grip). Stick your chest out and lean yourself back slightly (around 30-degrees) in order to better engage the lats. This will be your starting position.

Using your lats, pull the bar down as you squeeze your shoulder blades. Continue until your chest nearly touches the V-bar. Exhale as you execute this motion. Tip: Keep the torso stationary throughout the movement.
After a second hold on the contracted position, slowly bring the bar back to the starting position as you breathe in.
Repeat for the prescribed number of repetitions.

name: V-Bar Pullup
instructions: Pasang V-bar pada pull-up bar. Pastikan pegangan V-bar menghadap ke bawah agar Anda dapat bergantung padanya.
Pegang V-bar dengan kedua tangan lalu bergantunglah. Busungkan dada dan condongkan tubuh sedikit ke belakang untuk memaksimalkan kontraksi otot lat.
Tarik tubuh ke atas dengan mengaktifkan otot lat, arahkan kepala sedikit ke belakang agar tidak membentur bar sambil mengembuskan napas. Tarik hingga dada hampir menyentuh V-bar.
Tahan selama satu detik di posisi kontraksi, lalu turunkan tubuh ke posisi awal secara perlahan sambil menarik napas.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang ditentukan.
instructions_en: Start by placing the middle of the V-bar in the middle of the pull-up bar (assuming that the pull-up station you are using does not have neutral grip handles). The V-Bar handles will be facing down so that you can hang from the pull-up bar through the use of the handles.

Once you securely place the V-bar, take a hold of the bar from each side and hang from it. Stick your chest out and lean yourself back slightly in order to better engage the lats. This will be your starting position.

Using your lats, pull your torso up while leaning your head back slightly so that you do not hit yourself with the chin-up bar. Continue until your chest nearly touches the V-bar. Exhale as you execute this motion.
After a second hold on the contracted position, slowly lower your body back to the starting position as you breathe in.
Repeat for the prescribed number of repetitions.

name: Vertical Swing
instructions: Biarkan dumbel menggantung lurus di antara kaki dengan kedua tangan memegangnya. Jaga punggung tetap lurus dan kepala menghadap ke depan.
Ayunkan dumbel ke belakang di antara kedua kaki, gerakkan pinggul dan tekuk lutut sedikit.
Balikkan gerakan secara eksplosif dengan meluruskan pinggul, lutut, dan pergelangan kaki untuk mendorong tubuh ke atas, sambil mengayunkan dumbel di atas kepala.
Saat mendarat, redam benturan melalui kaki dan tarik dumbel mendekat ke dada sebelum melakukan repetisi berikutnya.
instructions_en: Allow the dumbbell to hang at arms length between your legs, holding it with both hands. Keep your back straight and your head up.
Swing the dumbbell between your legs, flexing at the hips and bending the knees slightly.
Powerfully reverse the motion by extending at the hips, knees, and ankles to propel yourself upward, swinging the dumbell over your head.
As you land, absorb the impact through your legs and draw the dumbbell to your torso before the next repetition.

name: Walking, Treadmill
instructions: Mulailah dengan naik ke atas treadmill dan pilih opsi yang diinginkan pada menu. Sebagian besar treadmill memiliki pengaturan manual atau program latihan. Masukkan usia dan berat badan untuk memperkirakan kalori yang terbakar. Kemiringan (incline) dapat disesuaikan untuk mengubah intensitas latihan.

Treadmill praktis, baik untuk kardio, dan umumnya memiliki benturan yang lebih kecil daripada berjalan di luar ruangan. Berjalanlah dengan kecepatan sedang hingga cepat, bukan santai. Meskipun intensitasnya lebih rendah, berjalan tetap memberikan manfaat besar. Pertahankan postur tubuh yang baik saat berjalan, dan hanya pegang pegangan saat diperlukan, seperti saat turun atau memeriksa detak jantung.
instructions_en: To begin, step onto the treadmill and select the desired option from the menu. Most treadmills have a manual setting, or you can select a program to run. Typically, you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned during exercise. Elevation can be adjusted to change the intensity of the workout.

Treadmills offer convenience, cardiovascular benefits, and usually have less impact than walking outside. When walking, you should move at a moderate to fast pace, not a leisurely one. Being an activity of lower intensity, walking doesn't burn as many calories as some other activities, but still provides great benefit. A 150 lb person will burn about 175 calories walking 4 miles per hour for 30 minutes, compared to 450 calories running twice as fast. Maintain proper posture as you walk, and only hold onto the handles when necessary, such as when dismounting or checking your heart rate.

name: Weighted Ball Hyperextension
instructions: Berbaringlah di atas bola latihan dengan dada menempel pada bola dan sejajar dengan lantai. Ujung kaki menekan lantai untuk menjaga keseimbangan. Letakkan piringan beban di bawah dagu atau di belakang leher sebagai posisi awal.
Angkat tubuh bagian atas secara perlahan dengan membungkuk di bagian pinggang dan punggung bawah. Hembuskan napas saat melakukan gerakan ini.
Tahan kontraksi pada punggung bawah selama satu detik, lalu turunkan kembali tubuh ke posisi awal sambil menarik napas.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang dianjurkan dalam program Anda.
instructions_en: To begin, lie down on an exercise ball with your torso pressing against the ball and parallel to the floor. The ball of your feet should be pressed against the floor to help keep you balanced. Place a weighted plate under your chin or behind your neck. This is the starting position.
Slowly raise your torso up by bending at the waist and lower back. Remember to exhale during this movement.
Hold the contraction on your lower back for a second and lower your torso back down to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions prescribed in your program.

name: Weighted Ball Side Bend
instructions: Berbaringlah di atas bola latihan dengan sisi kiri tubuh (pinggang, pinggul, dan bahu) menempel pada bola.
Letakkan kaki di lantai dengan posisi menyilang di samping bola. Pegang piringan beban dengan tangan kanan tepat di sisi kepala. Pastikan sisi halus piringan menempel di kepala.
Silangkan lengan kiri di depan dada dengan telapak tangan menyentuh otot obliques. Posisi siku membentuk sudut siku-siku. Ini adalah posisi awal.
Angkat sisi tubuh bagian atas dengan melakukan fleksi lateral pada pinggang sambil menghembuskan napas.
Tahan kontraksi selama satu detik dan turunkan kembali tubuh secara perlahan ke posisi awal sambil menarik napas.
Ulangi sebanyak jumlah repetisi yang ditentukan.
Ganti sisi tubuh dan ulangi latihan.
instructions_en: To begin, lie down on an exercise ball with your left side of the torso (waist, hips and shoulder) pressed against the ball.

Your feet should be on the floor while your legs are crossed and hanging from the ball. Hold a weighted plate with your right hand directly to the right side of your head. Tip: Make sure the smooth side of the plate is resting against your head.
Place your left arm across your torso so that your palm is on your obliques. There should be a right angle between your left forearm and upper arm. This is the starting position.
Raise the side of your torso up by laterally flexing at the waist while exhaling.
Hold the contraction for a second and slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Switch sides and repeat the exercise.

name: Weighted Bench Dip
instructions: Letakkan satu bangku di belakang dan satu di depan Anda. Posisikan bangku tegak lurus dengan tubuh, pegang tepi bangku dengan tangan terbuka selebar bahu dan posisi tangan dekat dengan tubuh. Luruskan lengan sepenuhnya.

Luruskan kaki ke depan di atas bangku yang lain. Kaki harus sejajar dengan lantai sementara tubuh tegak lurus. Minta bantuan partner untuk meletakkan dumbel di atas paha Anda untuk mencegah cedera. Ini adalah posisi awal.

Turunkan tubuh secara perlahan sambil menarik napas dengan menekuk siku hingga lengan atas dan bawah membentuk sudut sedikit di bawah 90 derajat. Jaga siku tetap dekat dengan tubuh. Lengan bawah harus selalu mengarah ke bawah.
Gunakan otot trisep untuk mengangkat tubuh kembali ke posisi awal sambil menghembuskan napas.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang dianjurkan.
instructions_en: For this exercise you will need to place a bench behind your back and another one in front of you. With the benches perpendicular to your body, hold on to one bench on its edge with the hands close to your body, separated at shoulder width. Your arms should be fully extended.

The legs will be extended forward on top of the other bench. Your legs should be parallel to the floor while your torso is to be perpendicular to the floor. Have your partner place the dumbbell on your lap. Note: This exercise is best performed with a partner as placing the weight on your lap can be challenging and cause injury without assistance. This will be your starting position.

Slowly lower your body as you inhale by bending at the elbows until you lower yourself far enough to where there is an angle slightly smaller than 90 degrees between the upper arm and the forearm. Tip: Keep the elbows as close as possible throughout the movement. Forearms should always be pointing down.
Using your triceps to bring your torso up again, lift yourself back to the starting position while exhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Weighted Crunches
instructions: Berbaring telentang dengan kaki menapak di lantai atau di atas bangku, lutut ditekuk membentuk sudut 90 derajat.
Pegang beban di depan dada atau luruskan di atas dada. Ini adalah posisi awal.
Buang napas, perlahan angkat bahu dari lantai sekitar 10 cm, jaga punggung bawah tetap menempel di lantai.
Di puncak gerakan, kontraksikan otot perut dan tahan sejenak.
Tarik napas, perlahan turunkan kembali tubuh ke posisi awal.
instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your feet flat on the ground or resting on a bench with your knees bent at a 90 degree angle.
Hold a weight to your chest, or you may hold it extended above your torso. This will be your starting position.
Now, exhale and slowly begin to roll your shoulders off the floor. Your shoulders should come up off the floor about 4 inches while your lower back remains on the floor.
At the top of the movement, flex your abdominals and hold for a brief pause.
Then inhale and slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position.

name: Weighted Jump Squat
instructions: Letakkan barbel ringan di bahu belakang. Anda juga bisa menggunakan rompi beban, sandbag, atau alat pemberat lainnya.
Pastikan beban cukup ringan agar tidak menghambat kecepatan gerakan. Posisikan kaki sedikit lebih lebar dari bahu, kepala tegak, dan dada membusung. Ini adalah posisi awal.
Lakukan gerakan squat setengah, lalu segera eksplosif melompat ke atas dengan mendorong pinggul, lutut, dan pergelangan kaki. Jaga postur tubuh tetap tegak.
Saat mendarat, serap benturan dengan menekuk kaki secara perlahan.
instructions_en: Position a lightly loaded barbell across the back of your shoulders. You could also use a weighted vest, sandbag, or other type of resistance for this exercise.
The weight should be light enough that it doesn't slow you down significantly. Your feet should be just outside of shoulder width with your head and chest up. This will be your starting position.

Using a countermovement, squat partially down and immediately reverse your direction to explode off of the ground, extending through your hips, knees, and ankles. Maintain good posture throughout the jump.
As you return to the ground, absorb the impact through your legs.

name: Weighted Pull Ups
instructions: Pasang beban pada sabuk pinggang. Genggam pull-up bar dengan telapak tangan menghadap ke depan, posisi tangan selebar bahu. Rentangkan lengan sepenuhnya.
Condongkan dada ke atas dan lengkungkan punggung bawah sedikit. Ini adalah posisi awal.
Buang napas, tarik tubuh ke atas hingga kepala melewati tangan. Fokus untuk merapatkan dan menurunkan tulang belikat di puncak gerakan.
Tahan sejenak, lalu tarik napas dan turunkan tubuh kembali perlahan hingga lengan lurus dan otot punggung (lat) teregang penuh.
instructions_en: Attach a weight to a dip belt and secure it around your waist. Grab the pull-up bar with the palms of your hands facing forward. For a medium grip, your hands should be spaced at shoulder width. Both arms should be extended in front of you holding the bar at the chosen grip.
You'll want to bring your torso back about 30 degrees while creating a curvature in your lower back and sticking your chest out. This will be your starting position.
Now, exhale and pull your torso up until your head is above your hands. Concentrate on squeezing yourshoulder blades back and down as you reach the top contracted position.
After a brief moment at the top contracted position, inhale and slowly lower your torso back to the starting position with your arms extended and your lats fully stretched.

name: Weighted Sissy Squat
instructions: Berdiri tegak, buka kaki selebar bahu, jinjitkan jari kaki. Satu tangan memegang rack, tangan lainnya memegang piringan beban di dada. Ini adalah posisi awal.

Sambil berpegangan, tekuk lutut dan turunkan tubuh ke arah lantai dengan mendorong pinggul dan lutut ke depan. Tarik napas saat turun, berhenti saat sudut paha dan betis hampir 90 derajat. Tahan posisi regangan sejenak.
Gunakan otot paha untuk mengangkat tubuh kembali ke posisi awal. Buang napas saat bergerak naik.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah yang disarankan.
instructions_en: Standing upright, with feet at shoulder width and toes raised, use one hand to hold onto the beams of a squat rack and the opposite arm to hold a plate on top of your chest. This is your starting position.

As you use one arm to hold yourself, bend at the knees and slowly lower your torso toward the ground by bringing your pelvis and knees forward. Inhale as you go down and stop when your upper and lower legs almost create a 90-degree angle. Hold the stretch position for a second.
After your one second hold, use your thigh muscles to bring your torso back up to the starting position. Exhale as you move up.
Repeat for the recommended amount of times.

name: Weighted Sit-Ups - With Bands
instructions: Ikat resistance band pada dasar bangku decline. Letakkan handle agar mudah dijangkau saat berbaring.

Kunci kaki pada bangku decline. Pegang handle dengan telapak tangan menghadap ke depan, dekatkan ke tulang selangka, lalu putar pergelangan tangan hingga menghadap tubuh. Jaga posisi lengan tetap statis selama latihan. Ini adalah posisi awal.
Buang napas, angkat tubuh hingga tegak lurus dengan lantai. Tahan kontraksi sejenak, lalu tarik napas sambil kembali ke posisi awal.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang disarankan.
instructions_en: Start out by strapping the bands around the base of the decline bench. Place the handles towards the inside of the decline bench so that when lying down, you can reach for both of them.

Position your legs through the decline machine until they are secured. Now reach for the exercise bands with both hands. Use a pronated (palms forward) grip to grasp the handles. Position them near your collar bone and rotate your wrist to a neutral grip (palms facing the torso). Note: Your arms should remain stationary throughout the exercise. This is the starting position.

Move your torso upward until your upper body is perpendicular to the floor while exhaling. Hold the contraction for a second and lower your upper body back down to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Weighted Squat
instructions: Posisikan dua bangku datar dengan jarak selebar bahu. Berdirilah di atasnya dan lilitkan sabuk beban di pinggang Anda dengan beban yang nyaman. Pastikan ujung kaki menghadap ke luar.
Setelah berdiri tegak dengan beban menggantung di antara kedua kaki, luruskan kedua lengan ke samping tubuh. Ini adalah posisi awal.

Tekuk lutut sambil menjaga postur tetap tegak dan kepala menghadap ke depan. Turunkan badan hingga sudut antara paha dan betis sedikit kurang dari 90 derajat (posisi paha sedikit di bawah sejajar dengan lantai). Tarik napas saat menurunkan badan. Tips: Pastikan bagian depan lutut segaris lurus dengan ujung kaki secara vertikal. Jika lutut melewati garis ini (melewati ujung kaki), Anda memberi tekanan berlebih pada lutut dan gerakan dilakukan secara keliru.
Dorong tubuh kembali ke atas dengan bertumpu pada bagian depan telapak kaki sambil meluruskan kaki ke posisi awal. Buang napas saat melakukan gerakan ini.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang dianjurkan.
instructions_en: Start by positioning two flat benches shoulder width apart from each other. Stand on top of them and wrap the weighted belt around your waist with the amount of weight you feel comfortable with. Make sure your toes are facing out.
Once you are standing straight up with the weight hanging in between your legs, position your arms so that they are fully extended to the side of your body. This is the starting position.

Begin by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up. Continue down until the angle between the upper leg and the calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below parallel to the floor). Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knees should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that are perpendicular to the front. If your knees are past that imaginary line (if they are past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.

Begin to move the body back up by pushing the floor of the flat bench with the ball of your foot mainly as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position. Exhale as you perform this portion of the exercise.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_id: Posisikan dua bangku datar dengan jarak selebar bahu. Berdirilah di atasnya dan lilitkan sabuk beban di pinggang Anda dengan beban yang nyaman. Pastikan ujung kaki menghadap ke luar.
Setelah berdiri tegak dengan beban menggantung di antara kedua kaki, luruskan kedua lengan ke samping tubuh. Ini adalah posisi awal.

Tekuk lutut sambil menjaga postur tetap tegak dan kepala menghadap ke depan. Turunkan badan hingga sudut antara paha dan betis sedikit kurang dari 90 derajat (posisi paha sedikit di bawah sejajar dengan lantai). Tarik napas saat menurunkan badan. Tips: Pastikan bagian depan lutut segaris lurus dengan ujung kaki secara vertikal. Jika lutut melewati garis ini (melewati ujung kaki), Anda memberi tekanan berlebih pada lutut dan gerakan dilakukan secara keliru.
Dorong tubuh kembali ke atas dengan bertumpu pada bagian depan telapak kaki sambil meluruskan kaki ke posisi awal. Buang napas saat melakukan gerakan ini.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang dianjurkan.

name: Wide-Grip Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Berbaringlah di atas bangku datar dengan kedua kaki menapak kokoh di lantai. Gunakan genggaman pronasi (telapak tangan menghadap depan) yang lebih lebar sekitar 3 inci dari lebar bahu untuk masing-masing tangan. Angkat barbel dari rak dan tahan lurus di atas dada dengan lengan terkunci. Barbel harus tegak lurus dengan torso dan lantai. Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.
Tarik napas, lalu turunkan barbel secara perlahan hingga menyentuh bagian tengah dada Anda.

Setelah jeda satu detik, dorong kembali barbel ke posisi awal sambil membuang napas menggunakan otot dada. Kunci lengan dan kencangkan dada pada posisi kontraksi, tahan selama satu detik, lalu turunkan kembali secara perlahan. Tips: Durasi penurunan beban harus minimal dua kali lebih lama daripada saat mengangkatnya.
Ulangi gerakan tersebut sesuai jumlah repetisi yang ditentukan.
instructions_en: Lie back on a flat bench with feet firm on the floor. Using a wide, pronated (palms forward) grip that is around 3 inches away from shoulder width (for each hand), lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms locked. The bar will be perpendicular to the torso and the floor. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on your middle chest.

After a second pause, bring the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out and push the bar using your chest muscles. Lock your arms and squeeze your chest in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.

name: Wide-Grip Decline Barbell Pullover
instructions: Berbaringlah di atas bangku penurunan (decline) dengan kedua kaki terkunci rapat pada posisinya. Raih barbel di belakang kepala dengan genggaman pronasi (telapak tangan menghadap ke luar). Pastikan pegangan tangan pada barbel lebih lebar dari lebar bahu. Perlahan angkat barbel dari lantai menggunakan lengan Anda.
Saat diposisikan dengan benar, kedua lengan harus lurus sepenuhnya dan tegak lurus dengan lantai. Ini adalah posisi awal.

Mulailah dengan menggerakkan barbel ke belakang dalam jalur melingkar seolah ingin meletakkannya di lantai, namun hentikan saat lengan sejajar dengan lantai. Tips: Jaga agar lengan tetap lurus sepanjang waktu. Gerakan hanya boleh terjadi pada sendi bahu. Tarik napas saat melakukan bagian gerakan ini.
Sekarang, bawa kembali barbel ke atas sambil membuang napas hingga kembali ke posisi awal. Pastikan Anda selalu mengontrol barbel dengan baik.
Ulangi gerakan ini sesuai jumlah repetisi yang ditentukan dalam program latihan Anda.
Setelah set selesai, turunkan kembali barbel secara perlahan hingga sejajar dengan kepala lalu lepaskan.
instructions_en: Lie down on a decline bench with both legs securely locked in position. Reach for the barbell behind the head using a pronated grip (palms facing out). Make sure to grab the barbell wider than shoulder width apart for this exercise. Slowly lift the barbell up from the floor by using your arms.
When positioned properly, your arms should be fully extended and perpendicular to the floor. This is the starting position.

Begin by moving the barbell back down in a semicircular motion as if you were going to place it on the floor, but instead, stop when the arms are parallel to the floor. Tip: Keep the arms fully extended at all times. The movement should only happen at the shoulder joint. Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement.
Now bring the barbell up while exhaling until you are back at the starting position. Remember to keep full control of the barbell at all times.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions of your training program.
When finished with your set, slowly lower the barbell back down until it is level with your head and release it.

name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: Duduklah pada mesin lat pulldown yang dilengkapi bar panjang pada katrol atas. Sesuaikan bantalan lutut mesin dengan tinggi badan Anda agar tubuh tidak terangkat oleh beban.

Genggam bar dengan telapak tangan menghadap ke depan sesuai lebar genggaman yang ditentukan. Catatan: Untuk genggaman lebar, letakkan tangan lebih lebar dari bahu. Untuk genggaman sedang, selebar bahu. Untuk genggaman sempit, lebih sempit dari lebar bahu.
Dengan kedua lengan lurus memegang bar, condongkan torso ke belakang sekitar 30 derajat sambil melengkungkan sedikit bagian bawah punggung dan membusungkan dada. Ini adalah posisi awal Anda.

Buang napas dan tarik bar ke bawah hingga menyentuh dada atas dengan menggerakkan bahu serta lengan atas ke bawah dan ke belakang. Tips: Fokuskan pada kontraksi otot punggung saat mencapai titik kontraksi penuh. Torso atas harus tetap diam dan hanya lengan yang bergerak. Lengan bawah hanya berfungsi sebagai pengait bar, jadi jangan menarik bar menggunakan tenaga lengan bawah.

Setelah menahan selama satu detik pada posisi kontraksi dengan merapatkan belikat, perlahan angkat kembali bar ke posisi awal hingga lengan lurus penuh dan otot latissimus merenggang maksimal. Tarik napas selama fase ini.
Ulangi gerakan ini sesuai jumlah repetisi yang ditentukan.
instructions_en: Sit down on a pull-down machine with a wide bar attached to the top pulley. Make sure that you adjust the knee pad of the machine to fit your height. These pads will prevent your body from being raised by the resistance attached to the bar.

Grab the bar with the palms facing forward using the prescribed grip. Note on grips: For a wide grip, your hands need to be spaced out at a distance wider than shoulder width. For a medium grip, your hands need to be spaced out at a distance equal to your shoulder width and for a close grip at a distance smaller than your shoulder width.

As you have both arms extended in front of you holding the bar at the chosen grip width, bring your torso back around 30 degrees or so while creating a curvature on your lower back and sticking your chest out. This is your starting position.

As you breathe out, bring the bar down until it touches your upper chest by drawing the shoulders and the upper arms down and back. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing the back muscles once you reach the full contracted position. The upper torso should remain stationary and only the arms should move. The forearms should do no other work except for holding the bar; therefore do not try to pull down the bar using the forearms.

After a second at the contracted position squeezing your shoulder blades together, slowly raise the bar back to the starting position when your arms are fully extended and the lats are fully stretched. Inhale during this portion of the movement.
Repeat this motion for the prescribed amount of repetitions.

name: Wide-Grip Pulldown Behind The Neck
instructions: Duduk pada mesin lat pulldown dengan palang lebar terpasang. Atur bantalan lutut agar pas dan menahan tubuh Anda tetap stabil saat menarik beban.
Pegang palang dengan telapak tangan menghadap ke depan. Gunakan pegangan lebar (lebih lebar dari bahu), sedang (selebar bahu), atau sempit (lebih sempit dari bahu) sesuai instruksi.
Rentangkan lengan di depan Anda, condongkan dada dan kepala sedikit ke depan agar posisi palang sejajar dengan tengkuk. Ini adalah posisi awal.

Buang napas saat menarik palang hingga menyentuh tengkuk. Fokuskan gerakan pada otot punggung dengan menarik bahu dan lengan atas ke bawah dan ke belakang. Jangan menarik menggunakan kekuatan lengan bawah.
Tahan selama satu detik di titik kontraksi maksimal (sambil merapatkan belikat), lalu kembalikan palang ke posisi awal secara perlahan sambil menarik napas hingga otot lat teregang penuh.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang ditentukan.

name: Wide-Grip Rear Pull-Up
instructions: Gantungkan tubuh pada pull-up bar dengan telapak tangan menghadap ke depan menggunakan pegangan lebar.

Tarik tubuh ke atas hingga bar mendekati tengkuk dengan menarik bahu dan lengan atas ke bawah dan belakang. Buang napas saat naik dan jaga tubuh tetap tegak. Fokuskan beban pada punggung, bukan lengan bawah.
Setelah menahan selama satu detik di atas, tarik napas dan turunkan tubuh perlahan ke posisi awal hingga lengan lurus dan otot lat teregang penuh.

Pull your torso up until the bar is near the back of your neck. To do this, draw the shoulders and upper arms down and back while slightly leaning your head forward. Exhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing the back muscles once you reach the full contracted position. The upper torso should remain stationary as it moves through space and only the arms should move. The forearms should do no other work other than hold the bar.
After a second on the contracted position, start to inhale and slowly lower your torso back to the starting position when your arms are fully extended and the lats are fully stretched.

name: Wide-Grip Standing Barbell Curl
instructions: Berdiri tegak, pegang barbel dengan pegangan lebar dan telapak tangan menghadap ke depan. Dekatkan siku ke samping tubuh.
Jaga lengan atas tetap diam, buang napas saat mengangkat beban dengan menekuk siku dan mengontraksikan otot bisep.
Lanjutkan hingga bisep berkontraksi penuh dan bar berada di setinggi bahu. Tahan selama satu detik dengan menekan otot bisep sekuat mungkin.
Tarik napas dan turunkan barbel kembali ke posisi awal secara perlahan.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang ditentukan.
instructions_en: Stand up with your torso upright while holding a barbell at the wide outer handle. The palm of your hands should be facing forward. The elbows should be close to the torso. This will be your starting position.
While holding the upper arms stationary, curl the weights forward while contracting the biceps as you breathe out. Tip: Only the forearms should move.
Continue the movement until your biceps are fully contracted and the bar is at shoulder level. Hold the contracted position for a second and squeeze the biceps hard.
Slowly begin to bring the bar back to starting position as your breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Wide Stance Barbell Squat
instructions: Gunakan squat rack untuk keamanan. Atur ketinggian rak, posisikan palang di atas bahu bagian belakang (tepat di bawah leher).
Pegang palang dengan kedua tangan, angkat dari rak dengan mendorong kaki dan menegakkan tubuh.
Melangkahlah mundur, buka kaki lebih lebar dari bahu dengan jari kaki sedikit mengarah ke luar. Jaga kepala tetap tegak dan punggung lurus.

Turunkan tubuh dengan menekuk lutut hingga posisi paha sedikit di bawah paralel dengan lantai (kurang dari 90 derajat). Tarik napas saat turun. Pastikan lutut tidak melewati jari kaki untuk menghindari cedera.
Buang napas saat bangkit berdiri dengan mendorong lantai menggunakan tumit kembali ke posisi awal.
Ulangi gerakan sesuai jumlah repetisi yang ditentukan.
instructions_en: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To begin, first set the bar on a rack that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, step under the bar and place the back of your shoulders (slightly below the neck) across it.
Hold on to the bar using both arms at each side and lift it off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.

Step away from the rack and position your legs using a wider-than-shoulder-width stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Keep your head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance, and also maintain a straight back. This will be your starting position.

Begin to slowly lower the bar by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up. Continue down until the angle between the upper leg and the calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below parallel to the floor). Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knees should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If your knees are past that imaginary line (if they are past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
Begin to raise the bar as you exhale by pushing the floor with the heel of your foot as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Wide Stance Stiff Legs
instructions: Awali dengan barbel di lantai. Buka kaki lebar, tekuk pinggul ke belakang untuk memegang barbel. Jaga kaki hampir lurus, punggung tetap rata, serta dada dan kepala tegak.
Dorong pinggul ke depan untuk berdiri tegak dengan lengan tetap menggantung lurus. Kembali ke posisi awal secara perlahan. Beban tidak perlu menyentuh lantai pada repetisi berikutnya.
instructions_en: Begin with a barbell loaded on the floor. Adopt a wide stance, and then bend at the hips to grab the bar. Your hips should be as far back as possible, and your legs nearly straight. Keep your back straight, and your head and chest up. This will be your starting position.

Begin the movement be engaging the hips, driving them forward as you allow the arms to hang straight. Continue until you are standing straight up, and then slowly return the weight to the starting position. For successive reps, the weight need not touch the floor.

name: Wind Sprints
instructions: Gantungkan diri pada pull-up bar dengan genggaman pronasi (telapak tangan menghadap depan). Lengan dan kaki lurus. Ini adalah posisi awal.
Angkat satu lutut dengan cepat setinggi mungkin. Jaga agar tubuh dan kaki tidak berayun.
Segera turunkan kaki tersebut kembali ke posisi awal sambil mengangkat lutut sisi sebaliknya setinggi mungkin.
Lanjutkan gerakan bergantian antar kaki hingga set selesai.
instructions_en: Hang from a pull-up bar using a pronated grip. Your arms and legs should be extended. This will be your starting position.
Begin by quickly raising one knee as high as you can. Do not swing your body or your legs. 3
Immediately reverse the motion, returning that leg to the starting position. Simultaneously raise the opposite knee as high as possible.
Continue alternating between legs until the set is complete.

name: Windmills
instructions: Berbaring telentang dengan lengan terbuka ke samping dan kaki lurus. Ini adalah posisi awal.
Angkat satu kaki dan silangkan dengan cepat ke sisi berlawanan, usahakan menyentuh lantai di dekat tangan yang berlawanan.
Kembali ke posisi awal, lalu ulangi dengan kaki sebaliknya. Lakukan secara bergantian sebanyak 10-20 repetisi.
instructions_en: Lie on your back with your arms extended out to the sides and your legs straight. This will be your starting position.
Lift one leg and quickly cross it over your body, attempting to touch the ground near the opposite hand.
Return to the starting position, and repeat with the opposite leg. Continue to alternate for 10-20 repetitions.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
instructions: Ini adalah peregangan tiga bagian. Mulailah dengan melakukan lunge ke depan, telapak kaki depan menapak rata di lantai dan bertumpu pada jempol kaki belakang. Tekuk lutut hingga hampir menyentuh lantai. Jaga dada tetap tegak, dan tahan posisi ini selama 10-20 detik.
Letakkan siku tangan dari sisi yang sama dengan kaki depan ke lantai di sebelah dalam kaki. Letakkan tangan satunya di lantai sejajar dengan kaki depan untuk menjaga keseimbangan.

Setelah 10-20 detik, letakkan kedua tangan di sisi kiri dan kanan kaki depan. Angkat ujung jari kaki depan dari lantai dan luruskan kaki (sesuaikan posisi kaki belakang jika perlu). Tahan selama 10-20 detik, lalu ulangi seluruh rangkaian gerakan untuk sisi sebaliknya.
instructions_en: This is a three-part stretch. Begin by lunging forward, with your front foot flat on the ground and on the toes of your back foot. With your knees bent, squat down until your knee is almost touching the ground. Keep your torso erect, and hold this position for 10-20 seconds.

Now, place the arm on the same side as your front leg on the ground, with the elbow next to the foot. Your other hand should be placed on the ground, parallel to your lead leg, to help support you during this portion of the stretch.

After 10-20 seconds, place your hands on either side of your front foot. Raise the toes of the front foot off of the ground, and straighten your leg. You may need to reposition your rear leg to do so. Hold for 10-20 seconds, and then repeat the entire sequence for the other side.

name: Wrist Circles
instructions: Berdiri tegak dengan kaki dibuka selebar bahu. Rentangkan kedua lengan ke samping hingga lurus sejajar lantai dan setinggi bahu (membentuk huruf 'T'). Telapak tangan menghadap ke bawah. Ini adalah posisi awal.
Jaga tubuh tetap diam dan hanya gerakkan pergelangan tangan. Putar kedua pergelangan tangan ke depan secara melingkar (bayangkan sedang melukis lingkaran dengan tangan). Bernapaslah secara normal.
Ulangi sebanyak repetisi yang dianjurkan.
instructions_en: Start by standing straight with your feet being shoulder width apart from each other. Elevate your arms to the side of you until they are fully extended and parallel to the floor at a height that is evenly aligned with your shoulders. Tip: Your torso and arms should form the letter "T: Your palms should be facing down. This is the starting position.

Keeping your entire body stationary except for the wrists, begin to rotate both wrists forward in a circular motion. Tip: Pretend that you are trying to draw circles by using your hands as the brush. Breathe normally as you perform this exercise.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Wrist Roller
instructions: Berdiri tegak dengan kaki selebar bahu, pegang alat wrist roller dengan genggaman pronasi (telapak tangan menghadap bawah).
Angkat kedua lengan lurus ke depan sejajar lantai. Pastikan tali belum melingkar pada roller dan tubuh bagian lain tidak bergerak selain lengan bawah. Ini adalah posisi awal.
Putar pergelangan tangan secara bergantian ke atas untuk menggulung tali dan mengangkat beban ke arah batang pegangan.
Setelah beban mencapai atas, turunkan kembali secara perlahan dengan memutar pergelangan tangan ke arah sebaliknya hingga beban kembali ke posisi awal.
Ulangi sesuai jumlah repetisi yang ditentukan dalam program Anda.
instructions_en: To begin, stand straight up grabbing a wrist roller using a pronated grip (palms facing down). Your feet should be shoulder width apart.

Slowly lift both arms until they are fully extended and parallel to the floor in front of you. Note: Make sure the rope is not wrapped around the roller. Your entire body should be stationary except for the forearms. This is the starting position.
Rotate one wrist at a time in an upward motion to bring the weight up to the bar by rolling the rope around the roller.
Once the weight has reached the bar, slowly begin to lower the weight back down by rotating the wrist in a downward motion until the weight reaches the starting position.
Repeat for the prescribed amount of repetitions in your program.

name: Wrist Rotations with Straight Bar
instructions: Pegang barbel dengan kedua tangan, telapak tangan menghadap ke bawah, selebar bahu. Ini adalah posisi awal.
Secara bergantian, gerakkan pergelangan tangan ke atas seperti sedang menggulung koran. Lakukan terus secara bergantian hingga lelah.
Balikkan gerakan dengan menekuk pergelangan tangan ke arah sebaliknya. Lakukan terus hingga lelah.
instructions_en: Hold a barbell with both hands and your palms facing down; hands spaced about shoulder width. This will be your starting position.
Alternating between each of your hands, perform the movement by extending the wrist as though you were rolling up a newspaper. Continue alternating back and forth until failure.
Reverse the motion by flexing the wrist, rolling the opposite direction. Continue the alternating motion until failure.

name: Yoke Walk
instructions: Yoke biasanya menggunakan alat khusus, namun bisa dilakukan dengan beban berat lainnya.
Posisikan beban di atas bahu belakang. Dengan kepala menghadap ke depan dan punggung tegak, angkat beban dengan mendorong menggunakan tumit.
Berjalanlah secepat mungkin dengan langkah pendek dan cepat. Anda boleh memegang sisi tiang beban untuk menjaga keseimbangan. Lakukan sejauh jarak yang ditentukan, biasanya sekitar 25-30 meter.
instructions_en: The yoke is usually done with a yoke apparatus, but is sometimes seen with refrigerators or other heavy objects.
Begin by racking the apparatus across the back of the shoulders. With your head looking forward and back arched, lift the yoke by driving through the heels.

Begin walking as quickly as possible using short, quick steps. You may hold the side posts of the yoke to help steady it and hold it in position. Continue for the given distance as fast as possible, usually 75-100 feet.

name: Zercher Squats
instructions: Gunakan squat rack untuk keamanan. Atur ketinggian bar antara pinggang dan dada. Setelah beban terpasang, kunci kedua tangan dan letakkan bar di lipatan siku (antara lengan bawah dan lengan atas).
Angkat bar agar bertumpu pada lengan bawah. Posisi lengan harus terlihat seperti menyilang menahan bar.
Jauhi rak, buka kaki selebar bahu dengan jari kaki sedikit mengarah keluar. Jaga kepala tetap tegak dan punggung lurus sebagai posisi awal.

Turunkan badan dengan menekuk lutut sambil menjaga punggung tetap tegak. Lanjutkan hingga paha sedikit di bawah sejajar lantai. Tarik napas saat turun. Pastikan lutut tidak melewati garis ujung jari kaki untuk menghindari cedera.
Buang napas saat kembali ke posisi berdiri dengan mendorong lantai menggunakan bagian depan telapak kaki.
Ulangi sesuai jumlah repetisi yang disarankan.
instructions_en: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To begin, first set the bar on a rack that best matches your height. The correct height should be anywhere above the waist but below the chest. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, lock your hands together and place the bar on top of your arms in between the forearm and upper arm.
Lift the bar up so that it is resting on top of your forearms. If you are holding the bar properly, it should look as if you have your arms crossed but with a bar running across them.

Step away from the rack and position your legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Keep your head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a straight back. This will be your starting position. (Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances discussed in the foot stances section).

Begin to lower the bar by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up. Continue down until the angle between the upper leg and the calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below parallel to the floor). Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knees should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If your knees are past that imaginary line (if they are past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
Begin to raise the bar as you exhale by pushing the floor with the ball of your foot mainly as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Zottman Curl
instructions: Berdiri tegak dengan memegang dumbbell di kedua tangan. Siku tetap menempel di samping tubuh.
Pastikan telapak tangan saling berhadapan sebagai posisi awal.
Tekuk lengan (curl) dengan mengontraksikan bisep sambil membuang napas. Putar pergelangan tangan ke arah supinasi (telapak menghadap ke atas) hingga dumbbell sejajar bahu.
Tahan posisi kontraksi selama satu detik.
Dalam posisi tersebut, putar pergelangan tangan hingga telapak menghadap ke bawah (pronasi), dengan posisi ibu jari lebih tinggi dari kelingking.
Turunkan beban perlahan dengan posisi telapak menghadap ke bawah.
Saat beban mendekati paha, putar kembali pergelangan ke posisi netral (telapak menghadap ke tubuh).
Ulangi sesuai jumlah repetisi.
instructions_en: Stand up with your torso upright and a dumbbell in each hand being held at arms length. The elbows should be close to the torso.
Make sure the palms of the hands are facing each other. This will be your starting position.

While holding the upper arm stationary, curl the weights while contracting the biceps as you breathe out. Only the forearms should move. Your wrist should rotate so that you have a supinated (palms up) grip. Continue the movement until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a second as you squeeze the biceps.
Now during the contracted position, rotate your wrist until you now have a pronated (palms facing down) grip with the thumb at a higher position than the pinky.
Slowly begin to bring the dumbbells back down using the pronated grip.
As the dumbbells close your thighs, start rotating the wrist so that you go back to a neutral (palms facing your body) grip.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Zottman Preacher Curl
instructions: Pegang dumbbell dan letakkan lengan atas di atas preacher bench. Posisi awal: siku tertekuk dan telapak tangan menghadap ke bawah di ketinggian bahu.
Sambil menarik napas, turunkan dumbbell perlahan hingga lengan lurus dan bisep teregang sepenuhnya.
Di posisi bawah, putar pergelangan tangan hingga telapak menghadap ke atas.
Sambil membuang napas, angkat beban menggunakan bisep hingga kontraksi penuh. Pastikan posisi kelingking lebih tinggi dari ibu jari.
Remas bisep selama satu detik di posisi atas, lalu putar kembali pergelangan tangan hingga telapak menghadap ke bawah.
Ulangi sesuai jumlah repetisi.
instructions_en: Grab a dumbbell in each hand and place your upper arms on top of the preacher bench or the incline bench. The dumbbells should be held at shoulder height and the elbows should be flexed. Hold the dumbbells with the palms of your hands facing down. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe in, slowly lower the dumbbells keeping the palms down until your upper arm is extended and your biceps are fully stretched.
Now rotate your wrists once you are at the bottom of the movement so that the palms of the hands are facing up.

As you exhale, use your biceps to curl the weights up until they are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder height. Again, remember that to ensure full contraction you need to bring that small finger higher than the thumb.
Squeeze the biceps hard for a second at the contracted position and rotate your wrists so that the palms are facing down again.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: Standing Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Pasang single handle (d-handle) pada katrol kabel di posisi paling bawah (low pulley). Berdirilah tegak di samping mesin katrol.
Pegang handle dengan tangan yang berada di sisi luar (menyilang di depan badan atau dari samping). Jaga tubuh tetap tegak, dada membusung, dan siku sedikit ditekuk.
Angkat lengan ke samping hingga setinggi bahu atau sejajar dengan lantai. Buang napas saat mengangkat dan rasakan kontraksi penuh pada deltoid samping.
Turunkan kabel secara perlahan dan terkontrol kembali ke posisi awal sambil menarik napas.
Ulangi sebanyak repetisi yang ditentukan, lalu lakukan hal yang sama pada sisi lengan lainnya.
instructions_en: Attach a single handle to the low pulley of a cable machine. Stand upright beside the pulley.
Grasp the handle with the far arm across your body. Keep your torso steady and your elbow slightly bent.
Raise your arm out to the side until it is parallel to the floor and at shoulder level. Exhale and hold the contraction at the top.
Slowly lower the cable back down to the starting position under control as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of reps, then switch to the other arm.
